description:

name: « Les secrets de Rodez » : partez pour une aventure avec l’escape-bag
description:
"Some time ago, a passionate archivist, Cédric Matta, overheard a strange conversation about a treasure hidden in the streets of Rodez. His curiosity led him to an isolated cabin? The secret lair of a mysterious organization: the Vautours Noirs. Since getting his hands on their plans and equipment, Cédric has disappeared without a trace. It's up to you to pick up where he left off."  
With family or friends, set off in search of the lost treasure by solving riddles and exploring the city's nooks and crannies, with your escape-bag on your back! A fun and mysterious adventure for everyone aged 7
tldr: Résolvez des énigmes historiques en explorant Rodez avec un escape-bag, une aventure immersive et ludique.

name: "Au cœur de soi", séances de bien-être

These sessions are for everyone. Accessible to all, no level required.
Don't hesitate to contact me for more information?
tldr: Séances de bien-être mêlant yoga, méditation et relaxation sonore pour retrouver équilibre et harmonie.

name: "Ferme Bêle & Bio", produits laitiers de brebis
description:
The quality of our ewes' milk, combined with our know-how, gives us a yogurt that's recognized for its smoothness and creaminess.
Our tome is an uncooked pressed cheese made from raw milk. This is a real commitment on our part, as it requires us to produce high-quality milk. Maturation lasts a minimum of 12 weeks in our cellars. Each week they are rubbed with salt water (morgeage) to form a characteristic "orange" rind.

Unlike tree climbing courses, tree climbing is an ephemeral and itinerant activity, the ropes used are removed at the end of each activity in order to limit our impact as much as possible.

You are supervised throughout the session by a qualified instructor.

A family farm since 1730, we are located in Hyelzas, Lozère.

Our family has always strived to maintain local, high-quality production, with respect for the environment, animals and people. They have passed on their love of the land to us. Now organic, we'd like to pay tribute to our grandparents through our range of desserts and ice creams, naming them "Armand et Marie".
The Armand et Marie farm ice-cream parlour brings you organic ice creams made with ew
tldr: Découvrez une ferme familiale depuis 1730, entre Gorges du Tarn et Causse Méjean, avec élevage d'ovins et bovins.

name: Abbatiale Sainte-Foy de Conques
description:
DESCRIPTION
The abbey church of Sainte-Foy was built between the 11th and 12th centuries. On its facade is the Tympanum of the Last Judgment from the same period. It is illuminated from May to October during the "Nocturnes de Conques" to discover a revisited polychromy.
The interior of the church houses 250 Romanesque capitals spread over two levels: the lower part and the Tribunes. The latter are accessible during the Nocturnes to be closer to the medieval capitals and the contemporary stained glass windows of Pierre Soulages.
Self-guided or guided tour with the Heritage Department - Conques
tldr: Admirez le tympan roman du Jugement Dernier, chef-d'œuvre sculpté du XIIe siècle, illuminé en été.

name: Abbaye de Bonneval
description:
The nuns earn their living by working with their hands, and make an excellent chocolate: the famous Bonneval chocolate.
What to see and do at Bonneval Abbey?
- the entrance pavilions and their listed Madonna and Child (12th century),
- the ramparts, the church,
- the valley, the forest, the typical Cistercian site,
- the store, where you'll find Bonneval chocolates, books, children's albums and a variety of monastic products.
- a 25-minute film on the history and life of the community is shown.
The chocolate factory and the community's living quarters are not open to the public.
tldr: Visitez une abbaye bénédictine et goûtez leur chocolat artisanal, fabriqué par les sœurs depuis des générations.

Newly renovated, cool in summer.
Kitchen opening onto living room, separate toilet, bedroom suite with storage cupboard and walk-in shower, office space.
Private garden, free parking and space for 2-wheelers in the courtyard.

name: AH Âmazir
description: Franco-Moroccan cuisine (Berber recipes): "cuckoos - tagines - briks - pastilla".

name: AICI - Chocolaterie & pâtisserie - Matthieu Clot
description: Matthieu Clot, Maître Artisan chocolatier pâtissier, offers you a selection of the finest raw materials for his chocolates, pastries and confectionery, with the greatest respect for traditional craftsmanship.
tldr: Dégustez des chocolats et pâtisseries artisanales fabriqués avec des matières premières d'exception.

name: Aigue Vive (groupes)
description:
3 canoe/kayak courses :

* Les Vignes - le Rozier 11 km: The course begins with a toboggan, and the whole descent is a succession of rapids and calm waters. Halfway down, you'll see the village of La Sablière on your left, and a little further down on the right, the troglodyte villages of Saint Marcelin and Eglazine. At your own pace, you'll arrive at the base where your vehicle is waiting.

* Le Rozier - Peyrelade 7 km (easy) : A pleasant, leisurely family descent. Accessible from age 6 (provided you're in good physical condition and can swim at least 25 m underwater).

* Les Vignes - Peyrela

name: Aigue Vive canoe kayak
description:
Canoeing - kayaking: 3 courses
Les Vignes - le Rozier 11km: the course begins with a slide and you will alternate between rapids and calm water. 
Le Rozier - Peyrelade 7km (without any difficulty): family course, quiet and calm. Available from 6 years old (it is important to know how to swim and to be able to swim on a distance of 25m). 
Les Vignes - Peyrelade 18km: about 5h of sailing, mix of sensations and calm for a sporty day.
tldr: Descendez les gorges du Tarn en canoë, entre rapides et eaux calmes, pour une aventure nature inoubliable.

name: Aigue Vive rafting
description: Rafting: *10 km trip* Les Vignes - le Rozier, accessible to everyone.
tldr: Raftez en groupe sur 10 km dans les gorges du Tarn, une descente accessible à tous pour des sensations fortes.

name: AIR DES LACS
description: Microlight hydro base at Villefranche-de-Panat. Taster flights, introduction and training on water and land microlights.
tldr: Prenez les commandes d'un ULM ou d'un hydravion pour survoler les lacs et paysages du Lévézou.

name: Air Globe (groupes)
description: Provider of outdoor activities: Off Road (motorcycle), Fun ebike (mountain bike/electric motorcycle) and Vintage Trail (motorcycle).

Official HONDA FRANCE motocross school for children and adults in Aveyron, Occitanie region.

Taking your first turns on the wheel with the advice of a trained "motorcycle" instructor is essential to ensure rapid and lasting progress and to avoid dangerous situations.


The motorcycle driving school :

Motorcycles can be learned from 5 years old on machines adapted in size and power.

Motocross and off-road training
- Motocross courses with family and friends, from 7 years old, you will ride our Honda CRF
tldr: Apprenez les bases du pilotage moto ou quad sur circuit sécurisé avec des moniteurs professionnels.

name: Air Globe - Fun e-bike (groupes)
description:
We offer you the chance to experience the thrills and sensations of a lifetime.
A range of hikes or customized packages to meet your requirements will be proposed for your company seminars in Aveyron.


Motocross and off-road courses
- Motocross courses for families and friends, from age 7 upwards, on our Honda CRF motorcycles.


Two formulas accessible to all: 1-hour discovery and 2-hour initiation.



- All-terrain rides on our Honda CRF motorcycles.


Whether you're a beginner or an experienced rider, set off at your own pace!



From one day to four days on the roads and tracks of Aveyron

name: AIR GLOBE - FUN EBIKE

Start an electric bike or quad circuit, jump from tree top to tree top, ride a mountain bike and much more... Top animation: the Fun Bike, a hybrid between mountainbike and motorcycle, fully electrical with a minimum ecological impact. Accessible to all from 14 years upwards, fun and playful from 1h to 1 day.

name: AIR GLOBE - FUN EBIKE
description:
Know how to start and stop safely, know how to do precision braking

Know how to slalom, climb and descend.

Know how to master balance, concentrate and have fun in order to complete different courses according to the group's level.

Calling on the skills of a motorcycle sports instructor is a guarantee of success and safety.
Indeed, at the end of our training, we are able to propose situations allowing everyone to progress in the best conditions.

name: AIR GLOBE - OFF ROAD
description:
Air Globe is also involved in the organization and finisher of the DAKAR rally raid since 2009.
Our formulas:
- Randos and Raids all ground:
Come with your motorcycle or our rental motorcycles HONDA CRF 250 L.
Air Globe guides you to the discovery of Aveyron off the beaten track, for hikes or raids enduro, motorcycle trail, framed by real passionate professionals. - Improvement courses :
For peopl

name: AIR GLOBE - VINTAGE TRAIL
description: Air Globe has concocted several tours on wild and picturesque roads of the Aveyron. Ride our HONDA CRF 250 and 300 L and discover with our guide a beautiful region with wide open spaces AUBRAC/LARZAC.
tldr: Découvrez les routes sauvages de l'Aveyron à moto, paysages grandioses et grands espaces garantis.

name: Air Magic Parapente
description:
Discover flights with a tandem paraglider (initiation and improvment. Discovery Days (initiation + teaching flight) on different sites around Millau and the Viaduc. 

Family Pack (2 adults + 2 children) with €5 off per flight. 
2 pictures bought, 2 more offered.
tldr: Tandem parapente au-dessus de Millau et du Viaduc : sensations fortes et paysages à couper le souffle.

name: Aire  municipale de service pour camping-car de Saint-Cyprien
description:
Services:
Free parking (stable ground) / 12 spaces (dimensions: 50 and 70 m²)
Blue Float terminal 

- clean water / cassette emptying / waste water emptying (2€ per 20 min)
- 220 v terminal (1€ for 2h)
Close to the communal sports facilities, the campground, the inter-communal swimming pool and a stone's throw from the shops and services.
tldr: Stationnez votre camping-car gratuitement à Conques, avec services d'eau et d'électricité pour une pause pratique.

name: Aire Camping-Car Park d'Espalion
description:
Espalion is an essential stopover on the UNESCO World Heritage Pilgrimage Route of St Jacques de Compostelle (GR65), linking Le Puy en Velay to Conques.
Let yourself be seduced by the town's heritage and history: the Romanesque church of Perse, the Château de Calmont d'Olt, its museums: the Musée des Arts et Traditions Populaires, the Musée du Scaphandre, the Chapelle des Pénitents...
It's also the starting point for your hikes, notably along the old railroad line between Espalion and Bertholène, passing through Bozouls and its famous canyon.
tldr: Faites étape sur la route de Saint-Jacques-de-Compostelle et explorez le patrimoine d'Espalion.

name: AIRE D'ACCUEIL AUX SAVEURS D'AUTRE FOIE
description: Maison Aulas : Taste the local specialities (duck, farm foie gras, etc.)
tldr: Dégustez foie gras et spécialités locales à la Maison Aulas, dans un cadre authentique.

name: aire de camping car à La ferme les Mamours
description:
Pitch 4 m x 9m free height 3,40 m


Electricity supplied


Visit of the farm


Access to the store of local products


Table d'hôtes on reservation


Listed on Park4night
tldr: Passez la nuit à la ferme, visitez l'élevage et goûtez les produits locaux en pleine campagne.

name: Aire de Camping Car Ferme le Mont Fleurie
description: wooded and flowered grounds
tldr: Dormez au milieu des fleurs et des arbres dans un camping-car friendly, au calme absolu.

name: Aire de camping car municipal
description:
An area is now operational to accommodate campers.
The area has 3 pitches, free electricity, drinking water and a dumping area.
Direction La Capelle Bleys, near the public college parking lot.
tldr: Aire municipale avec électricité et services pour camping-cars, idéale pour une halte pratique.

name: Aire de camping de Pruines
description: Tent/caravan/camping-car pitch.

name: Aire de camping-car : 6 emplacements à la ferme
description:
Hardstanding, earthen site with a green area. Beautiful 360-degree view. No emptying possible.
Farm store.
Meals on the farm with farm produce every Thursday lunchtime from July 1 to August 20, preferably booked the evening before.
Fast food on site, by reservation, by noon at the latest for the same evening from June to September.
Dry toilet on site.
tldr: Pique-niquez avec vue à 360° sur le Lévézou, puis dégustez des plats fermiers le jeudi en été.

name: Aire de camping-car à la ferme du Vialaret
description: On-farm sales of our products: pâtés/terrines/salaisons/ready-to-cook poultry. Collective work by 6 partners. Our breeding principles: free-range/slow-growth - phytotherapy care - grain-based feed.
tldr: Achetez charcuteries et volailles fermières, issues d'un élevage en plein air et soigné par phytothérapie.

name: Aire de camping-car au Mas d'Herens
description: Quiet, shaded and flat pitches with a view. On reservation. Possibility of visiting the farm and tasting by appointment. Micheline and her husband raise calves and young cattle.
tldr: Passez une nuit ombragée à la ferme, avec visite des étables et dégustation sur réservation.

name: Aire de camping-car de la Combe d'Issart
description:
We welcome motorhomes, vans and caravans to our property in the heart of the countryside, with a breathtaking view over the Ségala valleys.
A green setting that calls for calm and serenity.
- Hard or grass pitches.
- Motorhomes with trailers or trucks welcome.
- Bread and pastries baked on site and delivered for breakfast (reservation required).
- Pets welcome.
Open all year round.
tldr: Dormez au cœur des collines du Ségala, bercé par le silence et une vue imprenable sur les vallées.

name: Aire de camping-car de la Vallée du Rance
description: This area offers motorhome owners a very pleasant setting, overlooking the River Rance, close to the leisure center and the village center. The area offers all the services of the campsite (sanitary facilities, wifi, etc.).
tldr: Bivouquez au bord de la Rance, à deux pas du centre de Saint-Sernin-sur-Rance et de ses commodités.

name: Aire de camping-car de Saint-Côme d'Olt
description: Free access area.
tldr: Aire gratuite et libre d'accès pour une pause improvisée près de Saint-Côme-d'Olt.

name: Aire de camping-car La Planque
description:
Take a break in the Lot valley, surrounded by lush greenery and peaceful surroundings.
26 pitches 900 m from the village and its shops
Authorized all year round for motorhomes and in high season for caravans, tents and vans.
Sanitary facilities (from 01/07 to 31/08) with WC, showers, washbasins, washing-up and laundry basins. Drainage, water, electricity.
Shady grounds near the Nayrac fishing and leisure lake
Children's playground, tennis court, bowling, pétanque...
tldr: 26 emplacements en bord de Lot, à 900 m du village, pour une halte verte et tranquille toute l'année.

name: AIRE DE CAMPING-CAR MUNICIPALE

tldr: Aire gratuite à Arvieu : vidange, eau et wc sans électricité, pour une pause courte et sans frais.

name: Aire de camping-car municipale de Campuac

Price per night from 9 ? includes 24-hour parking with electric hook-up, drainage, water + tourist tax to be paid on site.

Other grass pitches available.

Payment by credit card at the entrance.
tldr: Dormez au bord du lac de Salagou avec services complets pour camping-cars à prix doux.

name: Aire de camping-car municipale de Pont-de-salars

You'll be right in the village, close to the tourist office and restaurants... The Pont de Salars lake is also within walking distance, with a promenade along the lake for a leisurely stroll. Parking available all year round. Water service from April to November.
5? water tokens (80 liters) available from the tourist office, the Maison de Presse on Avenue de Rodez (open 7am-12pm and 5pm-7pm) and the Hôtel-Restaurant des Voyageurs. Emptying service.
tldr: Stationnez en centre-bourg près du lac de Pont-de-Salars, à deux pas des commodités.

name: Aire de camping-car municipale de Salles-Curan

The Salles-Curan motorhome park offers you the chance to spend a holiday by the lake, close to restaurants and the supervised beach at Les Vernhes (2km away). The beach is located 3km from the village, where you'll find all the major shops. You can hike up to the Vierge des lacs (Virgin of the Lakes) overlooking the lake and admire a magnificent panorama.
Barrier entry/exit, payment by credit card only. No possibility of advance booking. Drain terminal. Personal code for daytime entry and exit.

Rate: 14? for 24 hours (water, 6A electricity, waste disposal included). Payable from one hour. Dum
tldr: Profitez d’un séjour lacustre avec accès à une plage surveillée à 2 km du village.

name: Aire de camping-car municipale de Ségur
description:
It is equipped with showers and toilets. Tokens for the shower can be purchased at the grocery store or at the town hall. Free participation.
On the spot: bakery-grocery, bar-restaurant, post office, garage, automatic gas station. The village has beautiful churches : Ségur, St-Agnan, St-Julien de Fayret, St-Étienne-de -Viauresque, chapel of Bergounhoux.
Also the farm of Vialaret : free visit of the farmyard animals, purchase of farm products.
tldr: Aire équipée de douches (jetons en mairie) et commerces à proximité pour une halte pratique.

name: Aire de camping-car municipale de Trémouilles
description: Services: drainage, water and electric plug. WC.
tldr: Services essentiels pour camping-cars dans un cadre calme et vert près de Trémouilles.

You'll be close to the shops and the "voie verte", ideal for walking and cycling. Set in the heart of the Parc Naturel Régional des Grands Causses, this site offers 30 comfortable pitches. Take advantage of practical services such as electricity, drainage and drinking water. Please note that there are no sanitary facilities.
For a moment of relaxation, head to the La Gravière natural leisure park, less than 5 km away, where you can swim on a supervised sandy beach, or enjoy family activities such as children's games, beach volleyball, table tennis and much more. You're also just a stone's thro
tldr: 30 emplacements confortables en plein Parc des Grands Causses, idéal pour randonneurs et cyclistes.

name: Aire de camping-cars
description:
Near the parking of the Commanderie Templière et Hospitalière.
Restaurants and small shops nearby.
tldr: Stationnez près de la Commanderie Templière et profitez des restaurants du village.

name: AIRE DE CAMPING-CARS DU CAMPING BRUDY

Between Lozére and Aveyron, in a majestic Grand Site classified as a UNESCO World Heritage Site "Causses-Cévennes", at the confluence of the Gorges of the Tarn and the Jonte, the Brudy-Brudy plage ** campsite welcomes you for a relaxing stay, with your family, pleasant, friendly and rich in discoveries. Hiking, cycling, mountain biking, climbing/slack-line, caving/canyoning. Canoe/rafting rentals, near the campsite. Swimming from our private beach. Or simply take a nap in the shade of our poplars. Our ambassadors will welcome you in the best possible conditions.
Possibility of bivouacs, recept
tldr: Entre Tarn et Jonte, halte majestueuse au cœur des Gorges classées UNESCO.

Ideally located close to a greenway, it offers safe access to the town of Saint-Affrique on foot or by bike. Enjoy 25 pitches, some with shade, just a stone's throw from a leisure area with playground and city stadium. Free parking for 48 consecutive hours. Drinking water, wastewater disposal and garbage cans are available free of charge for a comfortable stay. No electricity.

Explore the village via two interactive trails available on the Guidigo application, enriched with photos, videos and quizzes, for a fun immersion in local history. Take a step up to the Peyralbe Interpretation Table.
E
tldr: 25 emplacements à deux pas d’une voie verte et d’une aire de jeux pour une pause active.

name: Aire de camping-cars municipale
description:
Nestled in a peaceful, green setting, this area offers 12 spacious pitches for just 11? per night. You'll find all the essentials: drinking water, electricity and sewage disposal. A children?s play area will delight the youngest, while the nearby shops, inn and gas station will make your daily life easier.
Take advantage of your stopover to discover the Château de Saint-Izaire, an impressive historic site bearing witness to a medieval past, or the mysterious statue-menhirs dotting the village, fascinating relics of prehistory.
tldr: 12 emplacements spacieux à 11€ la nuit, avec aire de jeux et cadre verdoyant.

name: Aire de camping-cars municipale
description:
Located on the Route de Martrin, just behind the service station, the Coupiac motorhome park offers a free, ideal stopover for travelers seeking comfort and tranquility.
Set in partially shaded grounds, it offers 10 pitches with drinking water and a wastewater disposal point. No electricity.
Its main asset? An unobstructed view of the Château de Coupiac, a jewel of the local heritage, and immediate proximity to the village, providing easy access to shops and services.
tldr: Aire gratuite et ombragée derrière une station-service, idéale pour une pause rapide.

name: Aire de Camping-cars municipale de Villefranche de Panat
description:
30 pitches 100 meters from the lake. Electricity terminals with 4 sockets (10A), water, WC, Wi-Fi access, drainage. The Villefranche de Panat motorhome park welcomes you for a peaceful stay in the Lévézou region.
Payment by credit card
tldr: 30 emplacements à 100 m du lac, avec Wi-Fi et drainage pour un séjour paisible.

name: Aire de Foncouverte
description:
Near St-Rome-de-tarn, enjoy a convivial gourmet break. A picnic area with tables is available for you to enjoy a well-deserved break. You'll find yourself near a dolmen for a trip back in time, witness to the ancestors of our territory.
Don't miss the village of St-Rome-de-Tarn on your way out, and discover its typical narrow streets, its beach and why not its emblematic Cascade des Baumes!
tldr: Pique-niquez près d’un dolmen millénaire après une balade gourmande en bord de Tarn.

name: Aire de jeux du Pourtalou
description:
Its large wooden castle, slides and spring-loaded games stimulate children?s imagination and motor skills in a safe, shady setting.
The soft, colorful floor ensures comfort and safety, while the surrounding trees bring coolness and serenity to families.
A fun and friendly place to stop off between two discoveries of the Templar and hospital heritage of Larzac.
Please note: Two picnic tables available. WC, drinking water, garbage cans and parking on site.
tldr: Aire de jeux en bois avec château et trampolines pour une pause ludique et sécurisée.

name: Aire de l'espace Jean Gaven

Benches and tables are available.

This leisure and walking area is forbidden to camping and caravanning because of the risk of flooding.

name: Aire de la Buobe
description: swimming prohibited on site

name: Aire de la Frégère

tldr: Table de pique-nique à 6 km de Broquiès pour une pause gourmande en pleine nature.

name: Aire de La Mouline

On the outskirts of Prévinquières, near the bridge over the Aveyron river:
6 camping pitches
- 8 picnic tables (4 to 6 places per table),
- barbecue,
- children's play equipment (slide tower, swing, seesaw),
- garbage cans throughout the site and in the waste disposal area, with selective sorting and glass container,
- toilets and WC for PRM,
- washbasins in the reception building,
- petanque court,
- access via 4 wooden staircases to the river for fishing. Handipêche pontoon.

name: Aire de la statue Menhir
description:
Near Broquiès, picnic tables are available for you to enjoy a convivial gourmet break.
It's also the perfect opportunity to discover the menhir statue and let yourself be transported back in time, many years earlier in the history of our region...
tldr: Découvrez le menhir de Broquiès, témoin silencieux de l'âge du bronze, lors d'une pause gourmande en pleine nature.

name: Aire de loisirs de la Gazonne
description:
Picnic tables and barbecues await you. All you need to bring is charcoal... and grills! Enjoy your meal in this beautiful green setting.
A disc-golf and foot-golf course will entertain young and old alike (Frisbee available for hire from the pool or tourist office).
To cool off, take a dip in the Lézert river or, even better, enter the Sauveterre de Rouergue swimming pool (open in summer).
The more adventurous will appreciate the hiking trails in the wilderness.
Here, the telephone network is hard to get through, so it's a good opportunity to get away from it all!
tldr: Jouez au disc-golf ou foot-golf dans un cadre verdoyant, idéal pour une pause active en famille.

name: Aire de loisirs du Moulin de l'Horte
description:
A few steps from the campsite and the swimming pool.

Children's games, a tennis court and the soccer stadium are at your disposal, so that your children can stretch their legs in complete safety, as well as a barbecue area for your grills.
tldr: Tennis, foot, jeux pour enfants : tout est réuni pour occuper petits et grands en sécurité près du camping.

name: Aire de loisirs du village de Lassouts
description:
This landscaped leisure area is ideal for fun and relaxation.
Picnic tables, children's games, bowling and soccer pitches.
Toilets, parking.
tldr: Bowling, foot, jeux d'enfants : une aire conviviale pour se détendre en famille dans un cadre paisible.

name: Aire de loisirs intercommunale
description:
Enjoy a green setting for a picnic on the leisure area of Compolibat. There are: health courses, games for children, tennis and volleyball courts, table tennis, picnic area with barbecues, mini-golf and outdoor bowling and an orientation course. A reception building is available with toilets and running water. Inter-communal area open all year. 


Dive into the refreshing water of the Aveyron River. Unsupervised swimming allowed.
tldr: Mini-golf, tennis, parcours santé : profitez d'un espace vert pour une pause sportive et ludique.

name: Aire de notre Dame du Désert
description:
The peace that reigns here is disconcerting. This chapel perched on a cliffside overlooks the Gorges des Raspes and offers you an unobstructed view of the emerald waters of the Tarn and the Verdale suspension bridge which links the two banks of the river.


Parking and picnic tables available.
tldr: Chapelle perchée sur une falaise, vue imprenable sur les gorges du Tarn et la Verdale : un havre de paix.

name: Aire de Pinsac
description:
Close to the Costes-Gozon village, enjoy a gourmet break on a site brimming with treasures for young and old...
L'espace du Sabel is a site containing numerous relics left by our ancestors throughout history. A historical discovery trail and an orienteering course are available.
The free "Balades des Grands Causses" app also offers a modern, fun way to discover the site.

name: Aire de pique nique à côté de l'église de Cruéjouls
description: Let yourself be guided by the "Coeur de Villages" circuits to discover our territory, rich in landscapes and history.

name: Aire de pique nique de Briounas

name: Aire de pique-nique
description:
Two semi-shaded tables available.
River nearby.
Parking at "La Jasse".
Garbage cans available.
tldr: Deux tables semi-ombragées au bord de la rivière, parking à proximité pour une pause nature simple.

name: Aire de pique-nique

tldr: Table de pique-nique avec aire de jeux pour enfants, eau et toilettes : une pause familiale sans souci.

name: Aire de pique-nique

description:
Before enjoying your meal, why not visit the small village of Buzeins? Its church and various buildings with typical Rouergate architecture add to its traditional charm. You won't want to miss the beautiful Théron fountain in the picnic area.
Not far from Buzeins, dolmens bear witness to a distant past. Before setting off to meet them, a visit to the Maison des Dolmens is a must. Located in Buzeins, the second floor of the Maison des Dolmens features an exhibition designed to give visitors a better understanding of these megalithic monuments. Access is free all year round, and no reception is

name: Aire de Pique-nique - Les Passes à Recoules-Prévinquières
description:
The place owes its name to the bridge built over the river Olip. It links Recoules-Prévinquières to the Chemin Royal. It is one of the last slab bridges on the Aveyron. Almost universally unsuitable for farming equipment, they have been demolished and replaced by concrete footbridges.
The picnic area is close to the La Vallée de l'Olip hiking trail. This 12.5 km hike takes in the valley landscape, the Vallée Clause chapel, the hamlet of St Grégoire and its church (listed as a Monument Historique).

name: Aire de Pique-nique - Maison des Dolmens à Buzeins
description:
As soon as you arrive in Buzeins, discover this ideal picnic spot for the whole family, with a playground for the little ones.
Come and immerse yourself in an atmosphere of calm and green nature!
For fans of megalithic monuments, head towards the D582 and you'll find the Restous Dolmen just waiting for you!
On the second floor of the Maison des Dolmens, next to the site, you'll find an exhibition presenting these witnesses to the distant past. Access is free all year round, no reception required!  

The Maison des Dolmens is also a starting point for two tours:

- a walking circuit to discover

For your safety, all our routes are equiped with a continu life line. It means that you are linked to the lifeline from the beginning of the route untill the end, with no possibility to open your carabiner. 
We offer 9 different routes :

Pitchoun Aventure (net route, without harness)

Mini Junior, Green, Blue, Purple, Red, Black, Aquatic Zipline and Zipline route.


Other activities suggested : via ferrata, canyoning, bungee jumping, climbing, caving, water rambling.
tldr: Parcours aventure dans les arbres avec ligne de vie permanente, sécurisé et accessible à tous les niveaux.

name: Antipodes Canyoning
description:
We also offer water rambling which is more accessible for kids (from 8 years old) as there is no abseiling.
Canyoning and water rambling last half a day, with around 2h30 in the water.
Other activities : via ferrata, bungee jumping, tree adventure, climbing, caving
tldr: Découvrez les gorges en canyoning ou randonnée aquatique, accessible aux enfants dès 8 ans sans équipement technique.

name: Antipodes escalade
description: Here, this activity is adapted for all ages and level. You can find more than 1200 climbing routes around here. From discovery with 20 meters routes to sensation with more than 100 meters routes, everyone will enjoy!
tldr: Plus de 1200 voies d'escalade adaptées à tous, des débutants aux grimpeurs confirmés, dans un cadre naturel exceptionnel.

name: Antipodes Randonnée aquatique
description:
We offer water trekking, an activity similar to canyoning but without abseiling, and therefore more accessible to families with children from 8 years old.


 The aquatic hike lasts half a day, with about 2h30 in the water.

You must be able to swim.

Other activities proposed : canyoning, via ferrata, bungee jumping, accrobranche, climbing, speleology, and in partnership canoeing and paragliding.
tldr: Randonnée aquatique sans rappel, idéale pour les familles : explorez les gorges en marchant et nageant en toute sécurité.

name: Antipodes saut à l'élastique
description:
Information :

- Minimum / maximum weight :33 kg / 138kg

- Parents agreement for minors
- Contraindication : epilepsy, pregnancy, heart problems, diabetes
- medical certificate for people over 55 
- closed shoes compulsory !!


- a photographer will be there to immortalize your jump ! you can see and/or buy pictures on site.







Other activities : via ferrata, canyoning, tree adventure, climbing, caving, water rambling.
tldr: Sautez du viaduc de Millau, une expérience unique et vertigineuse, encadrée par des professionnels.

name: Antipodes via ferrata
description:
We suggest you two sites : Liaucous in gorges du Tarn and Le Boffi in gorges de la Dourbie.
Both sites offer an easy route and a difficult one, so you can choose the one adapted to your level and even change during the activity.
The minimum age is 8 years old, maximum weight is 100 kg.
You need a half day for this activity.
For experienced persons, we also rent the material so you can go on the via ferrata by yourself.
Other activities : bungee jumping, canyoning, tree adventure, caving, climbing, water rambling.
tldr: Via ferrata dans les gorges du Tarn ou de la Dourbie : deux sites, deux niveaux, pour une aventure verticale accessible.

name: Apicole
description:
Its 100% natural honey, harvested in an artisanal way by this beekeeper of Salarsipont, will make your breakfasts enriching for a flourishing day.
Made from a large number of varieties of flowers from Levezou, this artisanal honey from local plants has a creamy and smooth consistency.
It gives off fresh aromas as well as a sweet and subtle flavor in the mouth.
Its color, varying from light yellow to dark brown, depends on the nature of the flowers harvested.
The products are also available at the Halles du Lévezou in Pont de Salars
tldr: Dégustez un miel 100% naturel et artisanal, récolté par un apiculteur passionné dans les alentours de Pont-de-Salars.

name: ARCS DE SAINT-PIERRE
description:
The site of Les Arcs de Saint-Pierre is located at the south-western tip of the Causse Méjean, between the Tarn and Jonte valleys. It is
a ruiniform and chaotic landscape of natural vaults, prehistoric caves and dolomitic rocks.
The site is rich in flora and fauna due to the presence of dolomitic sands within a mosaic of dry grasslands, cliffs and dolomitic rocks. This dolomitic substratum allows the development of particular and determining species.
The Grey Fox, a remarkable southern bat, frequents the site of Les Arcs as much in open or semi-open environments as in the karstic environment.
tldr: Paysages ruiniformes spectaculaires entre Tarn et Jonte, sculptés par l'érosion, un décor de cinéma naturel.

A passion for agriculture

Our family has always strived to maintain local, high-quality production, with respect for the environment, animals and people. They have passed on their love of the land to us. Now in organic farming, we'd like to pay tribute to our grandparents through our range of ice creams, naming them "Armand et Marie".

tldr: Portez des bijoux uniques, inspirés par la lithothérapie et la nature, créés par une artisan passionnée.

Ideally positioned in the midst of exceptional natural sites, just a stone's throw from the Norwegian fjord-like Gorges des Raspes, the Cascade des Baumes with its 18-meter-high waterfall, and a stopover point on the famous GR736 Gorges et Vallée du Tarn, adventure is within everyone's reach
Here, we offer traditional cuisine based on fresh, locally-sourced produce, with no tricks or gimmicks, just the intention of sublimating the quality of local produce.
tldr: Cuisine locale et cadre exceptionnel près des Gorges des Raspes et de la Cascade des Baumes.

Located in the quiet Bourran district, just a short walk from the city center, our 3-star hotel is the perfect starting point to explore Rodez, its stunning cathedral, the Soulages Museum, and the scenic Aveyron region. You'll be less than 20 minutes on foot from the historic heart of the city, and just 15 minutes by car from the airport.

name: B&B Manoir de La Fabrègues
description:
Beautiful monumental fireplaces, medieval vaulted ceilings, exposed stone walls, the Manoir subscribes as much to tradition as the contemporary.
It is here that adorable rooms are the accomplices of their environment, sometimes with sloping ceilings under century old lauzes (stone roofing tiles). A silent patio where the whisper of a fountain and luxurious vegetation welcome guests. SPA area : jacuzzi and sauna.
tldr: Découvrez des cheminées monumentales et des voûtes médiévales dans ce manoir aux pierres apparentes.

name: Babines de l'Aubrac
description:
Welcome to our delicatessen and wine cellar, a gourmet place where terroir and refinement meet!
At Babines, we give pride of place to local produce and exceptional products. We've selected the treasures of the land, artisanal sweets and rare specialties to delight both curious and discerning palates.
Cheeses, charcuterie, home-cooked dishes, local meats, world coffees, loose teas, artisanal ice creams, aperitif cakes, chocolates and many other surprises...
In the cellar, you'll find over 300 references, with the crème de la crème of French winemakers well represented: red, white and rosé wines
tldr: Dégustez charcuteries et vins locaux dans une cave dédiée aux trésors du terroir aveyronnais.

name: Baignade surveillée du lac des Galens
description:
Supervised swimming from Saturday, July 4, 2026, through Sunday, August 30, 2026, inclusive. On-site: water games, a relaxation area, and a picnic area.
For the first time, the Saint-Gervais Lake beach, located in Saint-Symhorien-de-Thénrières, has been awarded the international “Blue Flag” certification. It is one of 384 beaches authorized to fly the Blue Flag throughout the 2026 season, a symbol of its commitment to sustainable tourism.
tldr: Baignade surveillée, jeux aquatiques et détente au bord du lac des Galens en été.

name: Balade au bord de l'Ouche à Conques

tldr: Flânez le long de l’Ouche à Conques, sur un sentier ombragé de 1,2 km au départ de La Salesse.

The historical walking tour will take place on Saturday, July 18, 2026.
We’ll meet at 10 a.m. on the church square to begin the tour.
On the agenda:
Morning: Explore the castle town and take a walk along the banks of the Lot River.
Lunch: A friendly potluck picnic. Drinks will be provided by the association.
Afternoon: a tour of the church and a walk through the outlying neighborhoods.
We hope to see many of you there to share this enjoyable day filled with history, heritage, and good company.
tldr: Explorez le bourg castral de Saint-Laurent-d’Olt avec un guide pour percer ses secrets médiévaux.

name: Balade Numérique au Viala-du-Tarn
description: Between the valleys of the Causse Rouge and the canyons of the Raspes, between the banks of the Tarn and the Lévézou massif, Viala du Tarn welcomes you in its landscape of varied reliefs. Le Viala du Tarn is the village with seven bell towers, sometimes nestled at the bottom of steep valleys, sometimes on a hillock. This digital walk offers you to discover the village of Le Viala du Tarn and the unexpected medieval village of Le Minier, with its gothic style houses. Welcome to the heart of a rural village full of charm and vitality!
tldr: Découvrez les reliefs variés du Viala-du-Tarn via une balade numérique entre causses et canyons.

description:
The formation of the Tarn gorges has created magnificent monuments, such as this impressive arch, "la baousse del biel", in Occitan, "the bump of the old man".

This natural arch is 40 meters high, the opening is 27 meters high and 25 meters wide.
tldr: Admirez l'impressionnant arc naturel de 40 mètres de haut, sculpté par les gorges du Tarn : un spectacle géologique rare.

The tourist information office's trilingual advisors are trained to meet your every need. They know the Gorges du Tarn and Cévennes region and its tourist facilities, so they can help you prepare for your stay.

name: BUREAU DES ACCOMPAGNATEURS
description:
The guides' office is specialized in the supervision of sports activities and outdoor stays for groups.

The via ferrata is a course of cables and iron ladders hung on the cliffs of the Gorges du Tarn. Enjoy one of the sites in the region; Boffi in the Doubie Gorges, Liaucous in the Tarn Gorges or La Canourgue in the Lot Valley.

The climbing trips for groups take place on the natural sites of the region or indoors. Abseiling, Tyrolean traverse, belaying!

The qualified instructor adapts to the group to offer you a course at your level in complete safety.
tldr: Grimpez aux Gorges du Tarn sur des parcours équipés de câbles et échelles, avec vue vertigineuse.

name: BUREAU DES ACCOMPAGNATEURS
description:
Discover the flight window by playing with wings of different sizes.
We go to natural areas.
The activity provides a feeling of well being in tune with the elements and a surprising pulling force
You are supervised by qualified instructors.
tldr: Testez le vol en wingsuit dans les gorges, une expérience unique entre ciel et falaise.

name: BUREAU DES ACCOMPAGNATEURS
description:
Learn how to easily recognize stars and constellations with companions.
Playful initiation with projection of a starry sky on a screen followed by a field trip
 to recognize the main stars and constellations with star pointers.

We will travel to the location of your choice.
tldr: Apprenez à reconnaître les étoiles avec des guides, entre projection et observation nocturne.

name: Bureau des Accompagnateurs – Astronomie
description:
A fun introduction with a starry sky projected on a screen, followed by a field trip to identify the main stars and constellations with mountain guides.
We come to the location of your choice for groups and groups only.
tldr: Initiez-vous à l'astronomie avec des guides, entre projection immersive et balade sous les étoiles.

name: Bureau des accompagnateurs – Canoë-kayak
description: Acitivity canoeing and kayaking introduction, descent and improvement. Sport suitable for people with deficiencies. Bivouac in canoes. Rafting and swimming in white water with a qualified instructor who will guide you all along the descent.
tldr: Descendez les Gorges du Tarn en canoë, avec bivouac ou rafting encadré par des professionnels.

name: Bureau des Accompagnateurs – Canyoning
description:
Follow your instructor through a natural canyon in the Cevennes.


Tapoul, Haut Tarn... Jumps, slides, abseils...


The aquatic hike is more accessible for less athletic people.


You must be able to swim.


For groups and communities.
tldr: Explorez des canyons naturels en sautant, glissant et descendant en rappel avec un guide.

name: Bureau des Accompagnateurs – Escalade et via ferrata
description:
The Via Ferrata courses are located in the Gorges du Tarn (Liaucous, le Boffi). They are artificial sites (bars and ladders) built on the cliffs with a magnificent view. The courses have different levels and are accessible to all. Possibility of big abseils or dry canyon.
Learn to climb on the cliffs by letting yourself be guided by the instructor.  (Site initiation, big way).
Our activities are proposed to groups and communities already constituted.
tldr: Escaladez des falaises équipées ou testez la via ferrata dans les Gorges du Tarn, avec vue imprenable.

name: Bureau des Accompagnateurs – Géologie
description:
We use field observations and tests on different outcrops: magmatic, sedimentary or metamorphic rocks.
We trace the different geological formations of the region: Grands Causses, Cévennes, Aubrac... for groups or individuals only.
tldr: Découvrez les paysages géologiques des Grands Causses et de l'Aubrac en observant roches magmatiques, sédimentaires et métamorphiques sur le terrain.

name: Bureau des Accompagnateurs – Orientation

tldr: Initiez-vous au canoë, à la marche ou à l'orientation avec des trésors cachés, encadré par des professionnels.

name: Bureau des accompagnateurs des Monts d'Aubrac - Groupes
description:
Bureau des Guides Accompagnateurs des Monts d'Aubrac.

Our association of 6 mountain guides offers guided hikes, à la carte, in all seasons (pedestrian, mountain bike, scooter, snowshoe) on the Aubrac plateau.
The pace of our hikes, adapted to each type of public (groups, families, schools, seminars ....), allows immersion in the protected Aubrac environment.
The main themes are the discovery of flora and fauna through the seasons, geology, history and agro-pastoralism.

For larger groups, we can also offer tours of the Plomb du Cantal, the Margeride plateau or Mont Lozère
tldr: Explorez l'Aubrac à pied, à VTT ou en trottinette, guidé par des accompagnateurs de montagne expérimentés.

Behind the thick basalt walls, well protected from the burle and the winds, you will appreciate the soft and restful atmosphere of the buron. You will plunge into the history of this heritage, you will imagine the life of the buronniers, who spent 5 months of the year there.

tldr: Visitez un buron traditionnel de l'Aubrac, ancien lieu de fabrication de la fourme, avec ses murs épais en basalte.

tldr: À deux pas du Viaduc de Millau, profitez d’un camping paisible avec accès direct à une plage de rivière pour vous baigner.

tldr: Passez une nuit à la ferme avec accès à une cuisine équipée, un barbecue et un jardin pour un séjour convivial et authentique.

tldr: Les enfants s’amuseront dans un espace dédié avec toboggan, balançoire, trampoline et cabane dans les arbres.

name: CAMPING BEAU RIVAGE - Lac de Pareloup

Chalets and mobile homes for rent. Entertainment, snack bar. Heated swimming pool. Don't miss the magnificent sunset over the lake!

description: Camping Bellerive is located 200 meters from the main square of St Côme d'Olt, one of the most beautiful villages in France with a twisted steeple (flamed) ranked at the level of Europe, on the way to St Jacques de Compostela. tldr: Dormez à deux pas du village médiéval de Saint-Côme-d'Olt, classé parmi les plus beaux de France.

tldr: Découvrez Aubin, ancienne ville minière, où les roches ont façonné l’architecture et le paysage local.

The downstream hydroelectric power station, equipped with five Francis turbines, generates around 105 GWh per year, making a significant contribution to the local energy supply.

tldr: Découvrir la 'petite Venise' du Rouergue, ses canaux médiévaux et son patrimoine fluvial.

name: Chapelle d'Aurelle
description:
Chapelle d'Aurelle, built in the 14th century, then renovated by a team of volunteers and listed as a historic monument in the 1980s, is home to a colony of the "grand rhinolophe", a protected species of bat.
Today, it is the largest breeding colony for this species in Occitanie.

Under a municipal decree, the Chapelle d?Aurelle will be closed to the public from May 1 to September 30, 2026
to protect a colony of bats (Grand Rhinolophe) during the breeding season, in accordance with article L411-1 of the
Code de l?environnement, which prohibits the destruction or disturbance of protected specie
tldr: Découvrez une chapelle médiévale abritant une colonie de rhinolophes, chauves-souris protégées, dans un lieu chargé d'histoire.

The Vezins who protected the place maintained it: in 1431 Vezian de Vezins had a chapel built containing a Piéta from the early 16th century.
tldr: Visitez un lieu de pèlerinage oublié, lié à un duc de Bourgogne égaré, perdu dans les bois en route pour Compostelle.

Frightened, she implored the Virgin Mary to come to her rescue. Mary appeared to her and crushed the snake's head. In gratitude, the noblewoman built a chapel dedicated to the Virgin Mary, near a fountain that gave its name to the place ("fons currens" meaning running fountain, later became Notre Dame de Foncourrieu).

tldr: Admirez une chapelle liée à une légende médiévale où une noble dame affronte un serpent géant dans une lande hostile.

The interior was massively restored by the heritage association: cracks filled, renderings redone and many other renovations that enabled the Chapel to recover her historical charm. tldr: Explorez une chapelle du XIe siècle, témoin d'un passé viticole, avec une chapelle latérale dédiée à Saint Clair.

Indeed, the former hamlet of Villelongue was ideally located for access to the nearby Lucante parachute drop zone.
This chapel-museum features explanatory panels enriched with archive documents and objects, all under the protective umbrella of a deployed parachute.

During the Second World War, from May 1944 onward

The miller climbs up a ladder to the indicated place and discovers, in the middle of the box trees, a coarsely carved stone statue representing the Virgin Mary

name: Chapelle Saint-Vincent de Lugan
description:
This Romanesque chapel has been restored several times: in 1643, as indicated by an engraved stone above the portal, and again in 1960.
A foretaste of what you'll see?
Unlike that of Saint-Clair de Verdun, it has kept its furnishings, some of which date back to the 17th century: a carved and painted wooden altar and tabernacle, an altarpiece depicting a crucifixion, the Virgin and Saint Vincent (martyr and patron saint of winegrowers), and a gilded wooden statue of the Virgin. The furnishings, both Baroque and naive, give the church a very special atmosphere.

tldr: Chapelle romane restaurée, avec une pierre gravée de 1643 et une architecture préservée depuis des siècles.

name: Chapelle St André de Clauzelles
description:
It contains a statue of the Virgin, a copy of Notre-Dame dite des Embergues (14th century) and a Gothic wooden statue of Saint Stephen. The choir flanked by 4 cylindrical buttresses is the oldest part. The small chapel was then fitted out in 1784 with a colourful wooden country altarpiece.
The chapel is open to the public, each house in the village of Clauzelles has a key (opening on request). Historical details in the building.
tldr: Découvrez une chapelle gothique méconnue abritant une Vierge du XIVe siècle et un rare Saint-Étienne en bois sculpté.

name: Chapelle St Ferréol
description:
St Ferréol, a Roman tribune born in Vienne, was martyred in Brioude in the 3rd century. His protection, invoked here in a certain way since 1525, is particularly exercised towards soldiers and children. In the past, people used to come here at the beginning of the season, in order to obtain the right weather for the needs of the land. The chapel apparently had a bell tower. But 'lou clouquier' was the victim of some medieval war, and was sent to the bottom of an abyss. Long afterwards, some people still claimed to have heard the bells ringing from the bottom of the hole.

tldr: Venez prier saint Ferréol, martyr romain invoqué depuis 1525 pour protéger soldats et enfants dans cette chapelle discrète.

name: Chapelle St-Cyrice et Sentier d'interprétation
description:
On the road to Villefranche de Panat, close to the Village du Truel, hidden by a small valley, stands the Romanesque chapel of St Cyrice. Magnificent small building of schist with roofs of lauzes bordered by a small brook. The legends are still very present.
This small church is the ideal place for a nature break with a short walk included!
A small brook, cool in summer, panels and interpretation trail installed by the Parc Naturel Régional des Grands Causses.
tldr: Admirez cette chapelle romane en schiste cachée dans un vallon, aux toits de lauze et à l'atmosphère paisible.

name: CHATEAU DE CANILHAC
description:
The medieval castle of Canilhac is located in the Lot Valley, in the commune of Canilhac in Lozère. Only the ruins of the castle remain, which bear witness to a rich and ancient history.

Belonging to the barons of Canilhac, the castle dates from the 12th century during the dominance of the county of Aragon on the Gévaudan. It was the seat of the oldest barony of the Viscounty of Gévaudan. Today you can see the restored keep built in opus spictum or fishbone. In the current church, the former chapel of the castle is the emblem of the carved coat of arms of Canilhac: a greyhound.

Today, the tour allows visitors to discover the history of the site, its unique architecture, as well as the extensive restoration and excavation work undertaken over the past 30 years.

tldr: Explorez les vestiges d'une forteresse médiévale juchée sur un piton rocheux, offrant des vues imprenables sur les gorges du Tarn.

It is a reference in Romanesque architecture (abbey church and tympanum of the Last Judgement), medieval goldsmith's art (Treasure of Saint Foy) and contemporary art (stained glass windows by Pierre Soulages).

tldr: Conques, joyau médiéval classé, allie art roman, orfèvrerie et art contemporain dans un village préservé.

description:

Your guide will explain everything from the history of the site to its architecture and Romanesque art. An essential visit to Conques and its thousand-year-old history.

Accessibility: inclined planes in the church, tactile and Braille supports and booklets.
tldr: Explorez l'abbatiale romane et son tympan sculpté de 124 figures, chef-d'œuvre de l'art médiéval.

name: Coupiac Castle and Rural Wood Museum
description:
The Castel de Coupiac presents a set of rooms that allow visitors to experience our history from the 15th to the 18th century on a daily basis. Many exhibitions allow you to discover daily life in the Middle Ages (the ages of life, costumes, calligraphy, etc.) A game for children and the possibility of dressing up enhance the visit. During the summer, nocturnal shows in the castle on Monday evenings and medieval entertainment on certain days during the day.


During the Easter and All Saints holidays, treasure hunts for families.
A little extra: the Rural Wood Museum: wood and forest, nature,
tldr: Visitez un château présentant la vie quotidienne du XVe au XVIIIe siècle à travers des expositions.

name: Cours et stages de dessin et de pratiques plastiques avec Laure Sadaka
description:
WEEKLY CLASSES
Laure Sadaka offers courses in drawing and, more broadly, plastic arts.
Classes are tailored to students' needs, with a focus on the fundamentals of the visual arts, namely drawing from models: fruit, baskets, flowers, shoes, pots, vases and other objects, or reproduction from images (art photographs, sketches or paintings by masters). The aim is to train your eye by learning the basics: framing, proportions, values, composition, chromaticism?
Media: charcoal, pencil, pastel, paint (gouache, acrylic, oil), ink.
Public: teenagers and adults.
Thursday: 7pm-9pm
Friday: 6.15pm-8.15p
tldr: Apprenez le dessin et les arts plastiques avec une artiste dans un cadre inspirant.

name: Course d'orientation à Salles-la-Source
description:
Orienteering is a fun way to discover the most beautiful corners of our region.

How does it work? You've got a map, your legs and your brain.
The aim is to move from marker to marker, using the map to complete the loop back to the starting point.
The markers are always well placed, allowing you to discover the little hidden treasures of our territory.

We can also create orienteering races at your request, if you'd like to treat your friends or colleagues.

At the BUREAU DES MONITEURS, we look forward to seeing you!
tldr: Parcourez la nature en résolvant des énigmes avec une carte et une boussole.

name: Coutellerie & Forge Honoré Durand
description:
With our two trades, forging and cutlery-making, our workshop carries out every stage in the production of a Laguiole knife—whether folding knives or tableware—entirely within our facilities located in Laguiole. We were the first company to be certified with the Laguiole Knife Geographical Indication, an official recognition of the authenticity and quality of our craftsmanship.
We invite you to discover this excellence in traditional craftsmanship through our free guided visits, offered throughout the year.
1 – Main Visit: The Cutlers’ Workshop
The first part takes place in an air-conditioned
tldr: Assistez à la fabrication complète d’un couteau Laguiole, de la forge à l’assemblage.

Great names are involved in our knife making: Philippe Starck, Ora Ïto, Andrée Putman, Hermès, Sonia Rykiel, ... great chefs such as Michel Bras and Anne-Sophie Pic dress their tables with them. The Forge de Laguiole can be visited in its entirety every day.

name: Croix de Bleyssol à Vabre-Tizac
description:
Come and discover the ancient cross in the village of Bleyssol ! 

This cross is built with a molded octagonal column. The ends of the handle and the crossties are covered in foliage elements and curly cabbage. On the front is sculpted a Virgin and the child whilst you can observe a Pietà in the back. A coat of arms holding weapons testifies that this cross was a seigneurial donation.
tldr: Admirez une croix ancienne aux motifs végétaux sculptés, témoin du patrimoine rural du Ségala.

name: CROIX LAC SAINT-ANDÉOL
description:
The lake of Saint-Andéol is one of the strongest symbols of Aubrac being the only lake of the plateau to be endowed with a surprising history
Called the "Christianized pagan lake", the lake of Saint-Andéol hosted, during Antiquity and at least since the 3rd century, particular processions. The legend says that Saint Andéol undertook to Christianize the local populations to make them abandon pagan customs in this place. However, despite this intervention, these processions were still taking place at the end of the 19th century with clothes and food being thrown into the lake
A 19th century cros
tldr: Promenez-vous autour du lac Saint-Andéol, symbole mystérieux de l'Aubrac, entre histoire et paysages.

Through the subtle, intimate relationship between trees and living things, you'll find the space to gently plunge into the heart of yourself and rediscover greater harmony. By reconnecting with nature, you'll find it easier to cultivate a constructive relationship with your needs and inner nature.

You'll leave with your senses awakened, renewed self-confidence, a sense
tldr: Marchez lentement en forêt, éveil des 5 sens : un moment rare pour se ressourcer, guidé par un professionnel.

In our hectic world, stress and anxiety predominate and take their toll on the health of our bodies. To change this dynamic, it's essential to take a break, both mentally and physically. It's in this pause that massage becomes an invaluable tool, offering relaxation and harmony.
Swedish massage

Through a combination of subtle, sensory touch, I help you to relearn how to express your sensuality to the full, to better understand your emotions, to get to know yourself better, to rediscover a sense of well-being and pleasure with yourself and your body. Th

name: DE ROQUEFORT AUX ROUGIERS MOUNTAIN BIKING BASE
description: The mountain bike base at Roquefort aux Rougiers takes you through a variety of landscapes on the stony, technical paths of the Causses and the playful paths of the Rougiers, enough to satisfy family, technical and sporting enthusiasts all year round.
tldr: Partez en VTT sur des sentiers techniques des Causses ou ludiques des Rougiers, paysages variés garantis.

name: Découverte de l'Atelier sculpture sur bois
description: Francis Lecouls, woodcarver, opens the doors of his workshop and park. Come and discover characters, animals and models. He'll be happy to answer visitors' questions. By appointment: 06 08 76 47 69 or 06 82 35 01 58.
tldr: Rencontrez un sculpteur sur bois, explorez son atelier et son parc peuplé de personnages et d'animaux, sur rendez-vous.

name: Découverte de la vieille ville d'Entraygues
description: From whatever direction you come in, via charming meandering roads, you arrive in Entraygues. And what a recompense, the beauty of the site amazes you. This town with its numerous mediaeval vestiges lying between the Lot and the Truyère, offers us its old streets, its cantous fireplaces and ganelles, superb timber-framed houses dating from the 15th and 16th centuries, its château and its 13th century bridges... And above the town, the small village of Ginolhac with its vast horizons...
tldr: Plongez dans le Moyen Âge en découvrant les vestiges de cette cité médiévale lovée dans un méandre de la Truyère.

name: Découverte de la vieille ville d'Espalion
description: L'esplanade du Foirail: a former livestock fairground on the banks of the River Lot; the 8-pin bowling green: an emblematic Aveyron game. From the foirail: breathtaking traditional views of the Renaissance Vieux-Palais, former residence of the Governors of Espalion, listed as a Historic Monument. The Pont Vieux (Old Bridge), built of pink sandstone in the 11th century, is a listed historic monument and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The old tanneries: tanners' houses with covered galleries on the right bank of the Lot. Up the Rue Droite, the oldest street in Espalion, discover the Place du Marc
tldr: Flânez sur l'esplanade du Foirail, admirez les vues traditionnelles sur le Renac et jouez à la quille de 8 à Espalion.

name: Découverte du village d'Estaing
description:
On the Via Podensis of the Chemins de Saint-Jacques-de-Compostelle, Estaing, one of Aveyron's Most Beautiful Villages in France, reveals its secrets on this tour of the village's main buildings: the Gothic bridge - a UNESCO World Heritage Site - the Collège - a Renaissance house bearing the Estaing coat of arms - the Saint Fleuret church with its remarkable altarpieces and stained-glass windows... In the heart of northern Aveyron, in the Lot Valley, the history of the fiefdom of the Counts of Estaing is both short and long!

In July and August, discover the village in a whole new way with nigh
tldr: Suivez les pas des pèlerins sur la Via Podensis et explorez les joyaux architecturaux de ce village classé.

name: Découverte du village de St-Côme d'Olt
description:
Situated on the route de Saint-Jacques-de-Compostelle from Le Puy (via Podensis, now GR65), the village of Saint-Côme d'Olt is home to a number of well-preserved or restored 15th and 16th century houses. The village is also home to a number of well-preserved or restored 15th- and 16th-century houses, including several "Philibert" roofs, named after their designer Philibert Delhormes, architect to King Henri II. A stroll around the grounds reveals a number of fine relics of the past.
The church
Built in the 16th century by architect Jean Salvanh, who also designed the bell tower of Rodez cathed
tldr: Découvrez des maisons du XVe et XVIe siècles préservées sur le chemin de Compostelle, entre nature et histoire.

name: Découverte du village de Villecomtal
description:
A document on visiting the village is available from the Point d'Accueil (and others Information Center) in the summer season and from the Mairie (Head Office) out of season.
Discover more about the history of his castle ((15th century dungeon, with vestiges of curtain walls and towers with arrow slits, and 18th century corps de logis) and the Enfarinés former community.
Selguided tour of the Vihn Luu botanical garden close to the Maison de santé.

name: Découvrez le Pont de Cirou
description:
Once a stopover on the pilgrims' route to Santiago de Compostela, the Pont de Cirou is a must-see, with its 6 semi-circular arches spanning the river from the 14th to 15th centuries.
A special feature of this bridge is its access: the roads on both the Tarn and Aveyron sides converged at right angles. As early as the end of the 17th century, plans were made to change this situation and, as everything comes to those who wait, work was carried out to this effect in... 1992.
Discover the village with your family on the "La Magie de la pierre" treasure hunt, or enjoy a picnic by the river at one o
tldr: Traversez ce pont médiéval à 6 arches, étape historique des pèlerins de Saint-Jacques-de-Compostelle.

name: Découvrez le Pont de Grand-Fuel
description:
Thanks to the intervention of the mountain judge and the 4 châtellenies, the inhabitants of Rodez and Cassagnes-Bégonhès were exempted from the toll imposed by the lord of Salmiech: Arnal de Landorre.
The 55-meter-long bridge is built of schist and sandstone, and now has a paved road. Its existence is mentioned as early as 1302-1305 (it must have been made of wood before then).

tldr: Explorez Saint-Geniez-d'Olt en famille avec un jeu-questionnaire ludique, à la rencontre des habitants et de la marmotte.

If you like speed and dynamic maneuvers, hang-gliding is for you!
Lying back like a bird, you'll enjoy an aerial escape with a breathtaking view of the spectacular Aveyron countryside.
An experience accessible to all: Enjoy a tandem flight with a state-qualified instructor for a 100% safe adventure.
For an exceptional aerial experience, fly over one of the most beautiful landscapes in France?
Flights take place in July and August with Deltalib.
Book your flight on 06.32.80.01.12
tldr: Vivez l'adrénaline du parapente pour des sensations fortes et une vue imprenable sur les paysages aveyronnais.

tldr: Dégustez des glaces artisanales au lait de brebis bio, une spécialité crémeuse et originale à Salles-Curan.

name: Discover the Viaur Viaduct
description:
Let this construction of genious carry you away...
Between Aveyron & Tarn, in the heart of the Ségala, the Viaur Viaduct & its 3,800 tons of steel, seems to lay down, as light as a feather, on the hillsides of the Viaur Valley.
It is a remarkable metal work of the engineer Paul Bodin : steel girders, arches, a million of rivets... This aerial lace is 166m high & 460m long, with a 220m-wingspread central arch.
You will be amazed by the harmony between technique & nature.
... & its innovative technique!
The Viaur Viaduct was subject to an architecture competition in 1887, open to engineers: 8 dr
tldr: Admirez ce géant d'acier de 3 800 tonnes, chef-d'œuvre d'ingénierie ferroviaire entre Aveyron et Tarn.

name: Distillerie du Domaine Laurens
description:
PEASANT - WINEGROWER - DISTILLATOR


The Laurens family has been established in the village of Clairvaux d'Aveyron for several generations in the heart of the Marcillac valley.

With our traditional copper still, we concentrate all the taste richness offered by our terroir. Poire William, Reine Claude, Marc de Marcillac, Wild plums, Sorbier, Gentian.... but also Gins, whiskeys and rum, and of course our Ratafias!

We welcome you to the estate where we will introduce you to our white, rosé and red wines AOP Marcillac and IGP Aveyron, as well as our local aperitifs and spirits.
tldr: Découvrez les spiritueux artisanaux de la famille Laurens, vignerons-distillateurs depuis des générations en Marcillac.

description: Tumulus de 15 m sur 9 m, dolmen au nord-est.
tldr: Découvrez ce tumulus néolithique de 15 m, dolmen inclus, témoin silencieux de 5000 ans d'histoire.

name: Dolmen de la Plaine
tldr: Un dolmen solitaire perdu dans les bois, à explorer lors d'une balade hors des sentiers battus.

name: Dolmen de la Tacherie
tldr: Ce dolmen discret, enfoui dans la végétation, offre une plongée dans le passé préhistorique de la région.

name: Dolmen de la Vitarelle III
description: Tumulus allongé de 25 m sur 11 m orienté sud-est. Ce dolmen construit à la fin du Néolithique (Néolithique final-Chalcolithique). Ce monument mégalithique s'apparente aux longs tumuli à dolmen décentré.
tldr: Tumulus de 25 m orienté sud-est : un long couloir mégalithique à arpenter pour toucher l'histoire.

name: Dolmen de la Vitarelle IV
description: Situé sous une cazelle. Les pilliers arasés sont visbles ainsi qu'un fragment de table. Tumulus 30 m sur 11 m sur 0,8 m, allongé postérieurement et réutilisé sur son pôle ouest comme tumulus non mégalithique. Dolmen simple orienté Az. 97, Dec. -4.
tldr: Sous une cazelle, ce dolmen oublié révèle des piliers arasés et un fragment de table, mystère archéologique.

name: Dolmen de Lugans (A)
description: Signalé comme détruite en 1975, il a été sans doute reconstruit depuis. Un des supports n'est visiblement pas une pierre d'origine.
tldr: Un dolmen 'reconstruit' avec une pierre non d'origine : curiosité archéologique et énigme à résoudre.

name: Dolmen de Lugans (B)
description: Dolmen sans dalle de couverture situé à 750 m à l'ouest de Lugans, en bordure sud d'un chemin (cadastre E 463). Les supports latéraux sont très longs (3,50 m et 4 m); la dalle de chevet est peu élevée.
tldr: Dolmen sans couverture, aux supports géants (jusqu'à 4 m) : un géant de pierre oublié en bord de chemin.

name: Dolmen de Perignagol (A)
description: Parcelle BC 441. Beau dolmen simple, de belle taille, avec deux dalles de support et une grande dalle de couverture, d'une forme curieuse. Dolmen simple orienté Az. 122, Dec. -21.
tldr: Dolmen simple et imposant, aux dalles curieuses : un vestige néolithique à contempler en pleine nature.

name: Dolmen de Peyrelebade (A)
description:
Dolmen simple en V, avec piliers, deux dalles de couverture, dalle de chevet et cairn de pierres sèches.
Dolmen simple orienté Az. 131, Dec. -27.
tldr: Dolmen en V avec cairn de pierres sèches : une architecture préhistorique rare et bien préservée.

name: Dolmen de Peyrelebade (B)
description:
Très dégradé, restes de trois dalles de piliers, au milieu d'un cairn éparpillé long de 20 m sur 11 m orienté au sud-est.
Dolmen simple orienté Az. 149, Dec. -36.
tldr: Dolmen dégradé au milieu d'un cairn de 20 m : une ruine mystérieuse à explorer en Causse Comtal.

name: Dolmen de Peyrelevade
description:
The dolmen of Peyrelevade of Salles-la-Source is one of the many dolmens present on the Causse Comtal. A restoration operation has allowed to give it back its original aspect. The furniture found during excavations attests to a long period of use covering practically the entire Copper Age

It should be noted that Homo Erectus was present in the commune of Salles-la-Source as attested by a flint biface dated between 100 and 120,000 years ago found on the Causse. At that time, it was alongside the first rhinoceroses and large primitive elephants (bones discovered in the Commune). This implies a
tldr: Dolmen restauré de Salles-la-Source : un voyage dans le temps sur le Causse Comtal, avec mobilier archéologique.

name: Dolmen de Saint-Antonin
description: Tumulus de 25 m sur 15 m, orienté est.
tldr: Découvrez un tumulus néolithique de 25 m, vestige mystérieux d'une civilisation ancienne, à explorer en silence.

name: Dolmen de Saint-Antonin ou de Farrals
description: Restes les dalles des piliers, 3 par côté, formant le couloir, le tout dans son tertre envahi par les ronces. Le tumulus mesure 23 m sur 8 m, orienté à l'est. Dolmen simple orienté Az. 109, Dec. -12.
tldr: Trois dalles dressées sous les ronces, dernier témoin d'un dolmen oublié, à chercher comme une énigme archéologique.

name: Dolmen de Saplous (A)
description: Dolmen très ruiné, caché dans un bouquet d'arbres. On distingue encore les deux supports latéraux, ainsi que la dalle de chevet.
tldr: Dolmen caché dans les arbres, ses deux supports latéraux émergent encore, comme un secret bien gardé.

name: Dolmen de Saplous (B)
description: Ce dolmen inclus dans un tumulus bien visible est en bon état. La dalle de couverture longue de 4 m est en place.
tldr: Dolmen intact sous un tumulus visible, sa dalle de 4 m toujours en place, témoin d'un lointain passé.

name: Dolmen de Sirandels
description: Joli petit dolmen sur le reste d'un tumulus.
tldr: Petit dolmen solitaire sur un tumulus résiduel, idéal pour une pause contemplative en pleine nature.

name: Dolmen de Surguières (A)
description: Dolmen très bouleversé, au sud-ouest du hameau de Surguières. Il subsiste quelques pierres dont un support de grande taille encore en place. Malheureusement ce monument sert de dépotoir pour des blocs de roche retirés des parcelles cultivées.
tldr: Dolmen bouleversé servant de dépotoir, un vestige maltraité à observer avec curiosité malgré tout.

name: Dolmen de Surguières (B)
description: Ce monument est ruiné : les supports sont inclinés et la dalle de couverture est brisée en trois fragments. Le dolmen a été transformé en abri de berger, par l'ajout de murettes de pierres sèches.
tldr: Dolmen ruiné transformé en abri de berger, mélange insolite d'histoire et de vie pastorale.

name: Dolmen de Surguières (C)
description:
Ce dolmen un peu ruiné, mais qui possède encore une dalle de couverture, a été aménagé en abri de fortune, et maintenant de poubelle des champs.
Dolmen simple orienté Az. 71, Dec. +15.
tldr: Dolmen aménagé en abri puis en poubelle des champs, un site à la fois poétique et désolant.

name: Domaine des Buis
description:
Domaine des Buis is located in northern Aveyron, in Entraygues sur Truyère (patois: Entre les Eaux) in the foothills of the Aubrac plateau, at the confluence of the Lot and Truyère rivers. On sloping, terraced hillsides.
The vines are planted between 240 and 400 meters above sea level on granitic soils, mainly sandy-loam. The estate's lowest plots border the Lot, benefiting from the river's influences. Water and confluence play an essential role in the cultivation of our vines, which I strive to vinify each year in the purest possible way.
The winegrowing history of this region shows the richn
tldr: Domaine viticole en pente douce, au confluent du Lot et de la Truyère, dans un cadre pittoresque.

name: Domaine le Verdus
description:
Le Verdus is one of the historical vineyards of the Marcillac appellation.
Gradually replanted since 2015, this human-sized estate, certified in organic agriculture, produces wines made using natural methods. Its soils composed of white sandstone and schist make it a unique terroir compared to the rest of the Marcillac appellation. The local grape varieties such as mansois (fer servadou) or roussellou express themselves in a particular way.

 Reception, sale and tasting by appointment at 06.83.36.05.17

tldr: Dormez dans une ferme historique offrant une vue imprenable sur les collines du Marcillac, entre Conques et Rodez.

name: Domaine Mas Floème
description:
Mas Floème ? Organic wines from southern Aveyron that speak to the land
Where the Tarn meanders between cliffs and causses, where soils speak as loudly as people, the Mas Floème estate cultivates a living vision of wine. At Saint-Rome-de-Tarn, in this unspoilt corner of southern Aveyron, Matthieu Blanc crafts organic wines that are profound and sensitive, born of a dialogue between earth, climate and passion.
Here, the vines grow on contrasting soils: fertile silts by the river, limestone scree on the heights, dark schist sliding down the slopes of Lévezou. Each plot, each orientation, each so
tldr: Découvrez des vins bio du Tarn, élevés dans le respect des sols et des paysages entre causses et gorges.

name: Domaine Matha

The main grape variety is the mansois, it is only exceptionally mixed and never more than 10%. the soil makes the difference by providing subtle nuances according to the location: limestone on the upper slopes, limestone scree on "rougier" mid-slope and "rougier" lower down.
tldr: Visitez un vignoble de 500 hectares cultivé en bio, où le mansois domine, entre Conques et Rodez.

To be discovered: ... the organic vineyard and natural wine of Conques with 15 acres of vineyards in total including 11 acres of red and 4 acres of white wine. These vines planted on the hillside in a soil of schist overlook the village of Conques. All the production is hand picked then the
tldr: Explorez un vignoble historique lié aux abbayes médiévales, où les vins de pays de l’Aveyron retrouvent leurs lettres de noblesse.

Contrary to the other panoramas of the Gorges, this one is built in a vertical and symmetrical way, making it devilishly singular. It is also a spot for observing vultures, several of them nest on the cliff to your left.

Ideal for a nature-filled break near Millau, the Eco Camping welcomes visitors to poetic and eco-friendly accommodation (huts, yurts, domes and nomad tents), and has 50 pitches in the forest, perfect
tldr: Dormez en cabane perchée dans la forêt du Larzac, au cœur d'un camping écolo insolite.

A quiet, natural, poetic place for a rejuvenating stay in a tent, yurt, dome or cabin... Enjoy the remarkable sites of the Aveyron, hikes in the heart of nature and the region's many cultural and sporting activities.

Housed in the South/South-East part of an old and typical farmhouse, you will be surrounded by an aromatic and flowery market garden, a mobile henhouse, vineyards and orchards. Bike rides and hikes from the cottage. Close to tourist places: Bournazel, Belcastel, Peyrusse-le-Roc, etc.
tldr: Explorez un jardin permaculturel et un éco-gîte familial au bout d'un hameau paisible.

Serenity and gentle living on our walking paths, as well as relaxation and care in our SPA (sauna, swimming pool) and meditation room. You can follow one-week immersive courses: you will learn to live in nature with your backpack, cultivate permaculture vegetable gardens, participate in the construction of projects on the territory...
tldr: Participez à un projet écologique et humain dans un écohameau aux sentiers apaisants.

Our electricity is 100% renewable, our dry toilets, our dirty water is treated by plants, our garden is organic. We are vegetarians and humans.

We cultivate the art of living simply and welcome all our guests with an open heart.

Inside, every room exudes wood and the sweetness of life: a large living room bathed in light, a fully equipped kitchen, three cozy bedrooms, and meticulous decoration that gives this house a singular soul. Everything is designed to make you feel instantly at home.

Outside, a vast park with trees and flowers surrounds the house, offering calm, privacy and an exceptional natural setting. From the terrace, you'll enjoy a spectacular view of the town of Millau and its famous viaduct?a rare and unforgettable panorama.
tldr: Séjournez dans une maison en bois chaleureuse, décorée avec soin, près de Millau.
