name: Forêt jardin du Landassou
description:
The garden forest, between nature and culture

Since 2013, a former artificial peerage, very poor in animal and plant species, is the place of a wild garden experiment, where I try with the minimum of interventions to develop a hybrid space, half-spontaneous, half-cultivated. I plant, I maintain the paths to facilitate the walk, but above all I welcome what wants to come. The spirit is that of Eric Lenoir's punk garden and Robert Hart's forest garden. You will discover the pleasure of walking comfortably but in the middle of wild grass, in a landscape that is meant to close in while keeping in
tldr: Explorez un jardin-forêt expérimental où nature et culture se rencontrent depuis 2013.

name: Forge de Laguiole (groupes)
description: The FORGE DE LAGUIOLE company was created to bring the Laguiole knife back to life in its birth place. The ENTREPRISE DU PATRIMOINE VIVANT (Living Heritage Company) label is a real reference to this. Here, each model is hand assembled, adjusted and finished. Great names are involved in our knife making: Philippe Starck, Ora Ïto, Andrée Putman, Hermès, Sonia Rykiel, ... great chefs such as Michel Bras and Anne-Sophie Pic dress their tables with them. The Forge de Laguiole can be visited in its entirety every day.
tldr: Visitez la forge de Laguiole, berceau du célèbre couteau, et plongez dans son savoir-faire artisanal.

name: Forge des Raspes
description:
Passionate about knives, Jonathan offers you quality, fully forged blades and handmade handles: fixed and folding knives, axes, chisels, planes, garden tools ...

My aim: to offer you ergonomic knives and tools that last over time. My forge and workshop are open, so don't hesitate to stop by.
We can study any specific request;

Coming soon: forging courses to help you make your own knives!
tldr: Découvrez des couteaux et outils forgés à la main dans un cadre authentique aux Raspes.

name: Forgeron du Larzac
description:
Thanks to his know-how and experience, Johann LEMIRE offers you quality products made from carbon steel.
Cutlery and wrought-iron work: knives, wrought-iron swords, gates, window grills, coffee tables...
Come and meet this old-fashioned blacksmith at the foot of Ste-Eulalie de Cernon, a magnificent Templar Hospitaller village, in a workshop over two centuries old. He'll be delighted to talk to you about his art!

Production of special orders and unique pieces from drawings
Organization of forging courses.
tldr: Découvrez des couteaux et grilles forgés à la main par un artisan passionné, dans un atelier où le feu et le métal racontent des siècles d’histoire.

name: Forges André DEBRU
description: Exhibition hall and gardens open all year for visits.
tldr: Explorez un hall d’exposition et des jardins dédiés à la forge, où le savoir-faire métallurgique se dévoile au fil des saisons.

name: Fort cistercien de St-Jean d'Alcas (groupes)
description:
Built in the 15th century to protect the local population from the turmoil caused by the Hundred Years' War, it remained until the French Revolution the symbol of the power of the Ladies of Nonenque, the neighbouring Cistercian nuns who had administered this territory since the 12th century.
            Guided tours of the Fort des Dames reveal an unusual history that challenges preconceived notions about the medieval period. From the cobbled streets to the ramparts and refuge rooms, visitors will discover more than just a cleverly planned defensive structure. It is also the story of pious, po
tldr: Visitez un fort cistercien du XVe siècle, dernier témoin du pouvoir des Dames de Nonenque, niché dans un cadre médiéval préservé.

name: FORTERESSE DE MALEPEYRE
description:
Between the village of La Canourgue and the Causse de Sauveterre, the rocky wall known as "La Forteresse" is a cliff of limestone rock in shades of beige and grey, several dozen metres high. It is nicknamed because of its position on the slope of a deep valley and its imposing size. The most spectacular view of this rocky formation is from the D46 departmental road,
which winds its way up the hillside to reach the Causse de Sauveterre
Source: DREAL Languedoc-Roussillon, April 2007.
tldr: Admirez une falaise de calcaire aux teintes changeantes, offrant un panorama saisissant entre causse et village de La Canourgue.

name: Fromagerie coopérative des Bergers du Larzac
description:
A few years ago, men and women decided to create their own cheese factory to promote their only wealth: sheep's milk.

20 producers from Larzac and the Levezou mountains have come together to create a range of sheep cheeses with character! For this our tommes are matured in a natural cellar with 4 levels underground, which gives them a unique taste and floral crust! These are some 26 cheeses, 9 of which are from organic farming.



 Direct sale.

name: Fromagerie de Saint-Affrique
description: When you enter the cheese factory, your olfactory senses will be activated. For cheese lovers or simply for discovery, Pascal will be there to guide you! A small grocery store with local products is also part of the universe. So be curious and push the doors of the Cheese Factory
tldr: Découvrez les secrets de fabrication du fromage de brebis avec Pascal, entre dégustations et produits locaux.

name: Fromagerie des Cabasses
description: La fromagerie des Cabasses is a traditional family cheese dairy located in Verrières and produces cheeses made from raw ewe's milk such as pérails, tomme and raclette de brebis. You can buy all these products directly at the cheese dairy!
tldr: Goûtez des fromages de brebis artisanaux, fabriqués à la main dans une fromagerie familiale depuis des générations.

name: Fromagerie du Griffoul
description:
We offer butter, milk, fromage frais, crème fraîche and faisselle.
For cheese, we offer tome, creamy square and brick.
 You can buy our products directly from the farm, or at the markets in:
- Salles Curan on Saturday mornings,
- Laissac on Tuesday mornings,
- Sévérac d'Aveyron on Thursday mornings
- Millau on Friday mornings
We are also present at the "Pays'en Direct" farm store, 2 rue des Moutiers, Rodez.
tldr: Achetez directement à la ferme beurre, faisselle et tomes de brebis, dans un cadre authentique en Aveyron.

name: Fromagerie du Mas
description: For 8 months of the year, thanks to the raw milk of their 320 Lacaune ewes, Karine and Stephan make their cheeses. It was in 1997 that everything began, during an initiatory trip to Quebec and especially during a meeting with two cheese enthusiasts. Tomme, peril, yoghurt, chocolate cream, curd...all the cheeses are made on the farm with raw milk
tldr: Dégustez des fromages de brebis au lait cru, fabriqués par Karine et Stephan dans leur ferme de l'Aveyron.

name: Fromagerie du Pré Claux
description:
Products processed on site: raw goat's milk specialties, charcuterie and meat products from free-range pork and goats.
Farm sales every Tuesday and Friday from 3pm to 5pm.
tldr: Découvrez des spécialités caprines et charcuteries fermières, vendues en direct à la ferme les mardis et vendredis.

name: Fromagerie du Salze
description: From January to August, we have for sale plain yoghurt or yoghurt with marmalade, soft curd, fresh cheese, curd cheese (or brousse) and almost all year round, ripened tome (depending on availability)
tldr: Achetez yaourts, brousses et tomes de brebis, produits toute l'année dans une fromagerie familiale de Saint-Izaire.

name: Fromagerie Fromabon
description:
Made exclusively from ewe's and goat's milk from the arid, chalky Larzac plateau, our melt-in-the-mouth, creamy cheeses and ripened tommes are crafted with respect and rigor for traditional methods. Fromabon is a family-run business that produces a wide range of artisanal cheeses, including lactic, soft, pressed and washed cheeses.
You can also taste and buy their cheeses:
- in their boutique
- at markets: Nant on Tuesday mornings from June to September, Montpellier (les Arceaux) on Saturdays, Ganges on Fridays, Mauguio on Sundays.
- on their website
tldr: Savourez des fromages crémeux et tommes affinées, issus du lait de brebis et chèvres du plateau du Larzac.

name: Fromagerie Jeune Montagne (Groupes)
description: Free visit of the Fromagerie (cheese production). You will see a film that goes back to the origins of Fromage de Laguiole AOC and Aligot de l'Aubrac. From a gallery you will be able to see the fabrication workshops! You will be impressed by the cellar with its generations of Fromages de Laguiole lovingly watched over. In the tasting area you will be offered Fromages de Laguiole at different stages of maturing.
tldr: Visitez la fromagerie de Laguiole et découvrez l'histoire du fromage AOP, avec vue sur la fabrication.

name: Fromagerie Les Artisous
description:
We welcome you to our cheese store in La Cavalerie. You'll find all our products, of course, but also other local products from Aveyron. Local cheeses. Groceries and cakes. Home-made ice creams. Organic sheep's yoghurt

Come and taste our cheeses on site and leave with a taste of local authenticity. Come and discover all our Larzac ewe's milk cheeses: soft, tome or fromage frais.

Home-made; direct sale or at the Gignac and Lodève markets on Saturday mornings
tldr: Dégustez fromages, glaces artisanales et produits locaux dans une fromagerie conviviale de La Cavalerie.

name: Gabriel Vuattier - artiste céramiste
description:
Gabriel Vuattier has been based at the Pôle des Métiers d'Art in Sauveterre-de-Rouergue since 2021.
Claiming an affinity with the aesthetics of art brut and modern art, her sculptures are inspired by images she gathers from popular objects, tales, symbols and childhood territories.
Her sculptural work rubs shoulders with her utilitarian and tableware pieces, which she produces in small series using porcelain colombins or plates.
Don't miss this colorful, whimsical and sweetly acidic work!
Follow Gabriel's workshop on Instagram
tldr: Admirez les sculptures céramiques de Gabriel Vuattier, mêlant art brut et modernité dans un pôle d'artisanat.

name: GAEC d'Ambias
description:
Located in the heart of the Aveyron not far from the Millau Viaduct, La Ferme d'Ambias has been raising dairy sheep, pigs and Aubrac cows in the open air for 6 generations.
They cultivate on their land the food to feed the animals in a natural and autonomous way and they made the choice of a reasoned agriculture. Come to buy the products directly at the farm, at the point of sale of La Cavalerie or on the markets!
tldr: Visitez une ferme multigénérationnelle près du Viaduc de Millau, avec élevage ovin, porcin et bovin en plein air.

name: GAEC d'Azinières

tldr: Achetez des produits frais de la ferme ou retrouvez-les au Marché Paysan de Millau, dans un cadre rural authentique.

The ewes used to make the sausages and merguez come from our farm, which is subject to the Roquefort PDO. In addition, we feed our animals without GMOs and without silage.
It is an HVE (High Environmental Value) farm.
tldr: Goûtez des lentilles et saucisses à base de lentilles, fabriquées à partir des légumineuses de la ferme.

name: GAEC de Terre Blanc
description:
We have been farming dairy sheep since 1993 to produce milk for the Roquefort cheese. With 380 sheep of Lacaune breed. In 2010 we chose to work in organic farming.

To correspond to the pastoralism, since 2012 we transhumance the herd on a communal estive above the village of Roquefort for 3 months under the supervision of the shepherd.

Since 2014 we raise organic laying hens. We have an approved packing center which allows us to sell our eggs in local stores and local communities.

Sales in stores: Biocoop, La Vie Claire, Epicerie Del Païs and Lou Passou Bio in between seasons.
tldr: Découvrez l'élevage ovin bio de brebis Lacaune pour le Roquefort, avec visite des troupeaux et dégustation.

A dot indicates your position on the map. When you move, the dot also moves and tells you if you are going in the right direction. A clue also helps you in your quest.
In Arvieu park in front of the town hall and continue on foot. Look for a small box that contains a "logbook" on which you will write the date of the day and your nickname. If there are small objects inside (sticky, ball...) you can take one of them provided you
tldr: Parcourez les villages d'Arvieu à la chasse aux trésors géolocalisés, une aventure ludique en pleine nature.

name: Hospitaler Tower And Commander's Grave

You can also visit the Commanders grave, which is set inside the church. It is actually the tomb of Commander Pénavayre of Salèls and is carved out of fine-grained sandstone rock, which was extracted from the surrounding quarries. The lid is ornamented with crosses, coats of arms and gothic inscriptions.

Michel Truchon learnt cooking in his mother's inn, and once his taste is done, he leaves Sauveterre to travel the country and compare looks and
tldr: Profitez d'une terrasse avec vue sur le village et la campagne, dans un salon spacieux séparé de la salle de restaurant.

description:

Dating from the 14th century, it stands at No. 10 Rue de Belvezet, at the corner of Passage de l’Hospice. It catches the eye with its typical architecture: half-timbered walls, wattle and daub sections, two levels of overhanging upper floors, narrow openings including an oval window to the south and a mullioned window to the north, and a raised entrance protected by the upper floor.

In July and August, the House of Jeanne hosts medieval-themed activitie
tldr: Visitez l'une des plus anciennes maisons d'Aveyron, nichée dans les ruelles médiévales de Sévérac-le-Château.

The practice of reusing items destined to be thrown away, in order to give them a second life. This process is part of a drive to reduce waste.

Our aim is to recover materials that are no longer in use, with the aim of creating new objects, by adding value to the materials.

name: La cité de Cransac entre mines, thermalisme et art contemporain
description:
Atypical is a fitting adjective for the history of the Cransac spa. The town has in fact had "3 lives".

As you stroll through the streets, you can step back in time to the first half of the 19th century, when Cransac was renowned for its thermal waters. The "water-drinking" curists were treated by the many springs and accommodated in the spa hotels. The industrial revolution and massive coal mining in the second half of the 19th century put an end to this spa activity. Gone was the small town with its tree-lined spa park, replaced by mine headframes, slag heaps, smoking chimneys, railway trac
tldr: Explorez une ville minière et thermale où mines, thermes et art contemporain racontent trois vies insolites.

Fancy a break? Enjoy the peaceful spaces nestled among the rocks, while the little ones have fun on the mini treetop adventure course!
Twinned ticket for La Cité de Pierres and the Aven Armand.
tldr: Explorez un labyrinthe de roches géantes en train, via ferrata ou sentiers, entre légendes et paysages grandioses.

This via ferrata first descends into a chasm to discover what is bellow the Grands Causses before climbing back up via ridges to the summit of this sumptuous landscape.
tldr: Visitez Montpellier-le-Vieux en petit train, accessible à tous pour admirer les chaos rocheux sans effort.

description:
Located in Saint-Côme-d'Olt, this early 17th-century farmhouse was completely renovated in 2022. La Combe aux Fées offers bed and breakfast accommodation with direct access to the surrounding valleys.
Wi-Fi access is available throughout the establishment. Each bathroom has a spacious walk-in shower. Numerous restaurants are located within an 8 km radius.
La Combe aux Fées is surrounded by superb sites and listed villages: Saint-Côme-d'Olt, Estaing, Conques...
After a day's hiking, kayaking on the Lot or discovering the local heritage, enjoy a drink and relax in the garden.

name: La Coulée de Lave
description:
The origin of this scree is the dismantling by erosion of a lava flow located on the crest of the hill, perched in an inversion of relief. Note the regular shape of the boulders (5 or 6 faces), due to the fact that these blocks are sections of basaltic prisms.
Beautiful viewpoint. Located 800 m before the Château de Roquelaure, this impressive field of stones, several hectares in size, is known in Occitan as "lo Clapas de Thubiès" and is lost in a forest of beech, oak and chestnut trees.
An educational panel will give you further explanations on site.

tldr: Admirez des blocs de lave aux formes géométriques rares, sculptés par l'érosion dans un paysage unique.

tldr: Plongez dans un studio vintage de 37 m², mini-galerie d'art où chaque détail raconte une histoire.

name: La croix de Gréponac et sa table d'interprétation
description:
This panorama tells a profound story: that of a territory sculpted by the Jurassic sea, then by centuries of agropastoralism that gave birth to drailles, dry-stone walls, lavognes and templar and hospitable farms. Here, nature and man still form a living cultural landscape, recognized for its exceptional heritage value.
Our eyes also glide over a rich natural environment, where dry grasslands, limestone ledges and Natura 2000 zones are home to prestigious birds of prey, bats, rare butterflies and endemic Causses flora. A fragile biodiversity, to be preserved by remaining discreet and following
tldr: Contemplez un panorama expliquant l'histoire géologique et pastorale du Rouergue, entre mer jurassique et drailles.

Walking or running along the paths of the devèze of Lapanouse de Cernon, you will be amazed by the many rare species. In this preserved place, you may be lucky enough to see the largest orchid in Europe: the Venus hoof!

tldr: Admirez en mai-juin un tapis coloré d'iris jaunes et d'anémones pulsatiles sur ce plateau sauvage.

tldr: Dégustez du miel et du pain d'épices artisanal produit par des abeilles adaptées à leur environnement.

tldr: Plongez dans la vie rurale du début du XXe siècle grâce à une ferme-musée immersive et authentique.

Our products are 100% raw milk, processed and matured on site. The milk is produced with 95% of the feed and minerals produced on the farm, and is 100% of French origin.
The animals are grass-fed, with most of their ration made up of fresh pasture.

With a length of 290 km, the Aveyron river crosses many different landscapes, forming gorges in the Ségala region. However, some of the riverbanks are easy to access and offer magnificent views of the wilderness.

The water then flows into Lac de Villefranche and is channeled through a 3.5 m-diameter penstock to the Pouget hydroelectric power station at Le Truel. name: Le Cirque de St-Paul des Fonts
description:
Did you know that?
This natural cirque is a high place of European botany, marked by the presence of Hippolyte Coste, nicknamed "the priest of flowers" who lived 30 years in Saint-Paul des Fonts. This eminent botanist is known for his "Descriptive and Illustrated Flora of France". The former presbytery of Canon Coste is now a free museum since 2008. The Hippolyte Coste space is dedicated to the life of this specialist and allows to measure the richness of the local flora. Botanical routes around the village have been set up to allow young and old to appreciate the fragility of this natural her
tldr: Explorez ce cirque naturel, haut lieu de botanique européenne, près de Saint-Paul-des-Fonts.

name: Le Liadou du Vallon
description:
DESCRIPTION:
The Liadou, which means "tying tool" in Occitan, was a simple, sturdy and functional tool like none we make today, a companion that every winegrower once carried in his pocket to break bread but also, and above all, to work in the vineyard: the Liadou was used to split the wicker branches used to tie the vines into a crown. Abandoned in the mid-twentieth century, it is now being revived.

name: Le pont de Belcastel
description:
Built in the early 15th century by Alzias de Saunhac, this magnificent bridge is a remarkable example of medieval architecture.
Originally, it enabled the inhabitants of the right bank to more easily reach the church of Sainte-Madeleine, built at the same time. But beyond its religious function, it played an essential role in facilitating exchanges between the two banks of the Aveyron, once naturally separated by the river.
With its elegant arches and typical structure, it perfectly illustrates the characteristics of medieval bridges.
tldr: Traversez ce pont médiéval du XVe siècle, chef-d'œuvre d'architecture enjambant l'Aveyron.

name: Le pont du Cayla à La Bastide l'Evêque
description:
This Gallo-Roman bridge over the River Aveyron was part of the road from Rodez to Cahors and before that of the old Roman road which was used to transport minerals from the mines of La Bastide. It was guarded by the nearby castle, occupied by the English during the Hundred Years' War. A round tower, part of the outside walls, is still visible. Close by were implanted three mills since the XVIe century. The church dedicated to the saints Abdon and Sennen is nowadays demolished. According to the legend, the bell tower was thrown in the river during the English wars…

SWIMMING IS PROHIBITED
tldr: Marchez sur ce pont gallo-romain vieux de 2000 ans, vestige historique au-dessus de l'Aveyron.

description:
As you drive along the road between La Cavalerie and Millau, the Rajal del Gorps, a site of rocky chaos, immediately catches your eye. Emblematic of the Larzac region for its history linked to the Larzac Struggle of the 70s and 80s (a major rally took place here), it is above all a natural area shaped by water and wind over 240 million years.
On foot, you'll enter the heart of typical Causse landscapes: vast expanses of dry grassland populated by boxwood and juniper, "ruiniform" rocks, a wide variety of flora, including many that only grow on the Causses, such as angel's hair, cardabella and s

name: Le Randonneur - Canoë Kayak
description:
We offer different courses to discover the Gorges du Tarn gently with family, or go for something more demanding.You will go down the Tarn River at your own rythm and will be able to admire the landscapes  or take the time to swim.

via ferrata, different courses for beginners or experienced will allow you to enjoy the magnificent landscapes of our beautiful region.

tldr: Hébergement à l'entrée de l'Aubrac, base idéale pour découvrir la région et ses paysages.

Set 50 meters above the Aveyron river, this defensive system, some 20 meters in diameter, was composed of several compartments, platforms and ditches, forming a veritable rampart against invasion. tldr: Découvrez les vestiges d'un fort du Ve siècle dominant une grotte mystérieuse, un site historique méconnu.

All around they grew roses. This place then took the name of "Campus Rosarium". Called in Occitan "Lou Rousio", it is now called "Le Rozier". Today only the church remains of the monastery.

name: Le Verger de Conques
description: In Conques, in the Aveyron region, the chestnut tree is an integral part of the landscape and local history. Abandoned since the early 20th century, chestnut cultivation can regain its place and provide healthy, locally sourced food. Since this heritage is close to my heart, I didn’t hesitate to take over a chestnut orchard in 2021* and have become a chestnut grower in addition to my other paid job. This 2-hectare orchard, planted 50 years ago, consists mainly of the Marigoule variety: a large-sized chestnut (which can be called a “marron”), with very few partitions (the two skins peel off ver
tldr: Explorez un verger de châtaigniers abandonné, témoin de l'histoire locale et de la renaissance de la culture castanéicole.

name: Le Viaduc du Viaur pour les déficients visuels
description:

Borrow these booklets from the tourist office in Naucelle or Sauveterre-de-Rouergue and enjoy an adapted sensory visit.
Quite a project: the tour and booklets were produced jointly by the Pays Ségali tourist office and AcceSens.
tldr: Parcourez le Viaduc du Viaur avec un livret tactile en braille et relief, accessible à tous pour une découverte sensorielle unique.

In the heart of Larzac, come and share an unforgettable family experience at this emblematic site steeped in history. Young and old are invited to immerse themselves in the medieval world of the tower through a fun and immersive visit. Disguised and equipped with their notebooks, children become real explorers: games, riddles and challenges mark out their route to discover the local heritage while having fun.
 
Two booklets adapted to different age groups (5-8 and 9-12) enable each child to enjoy the visit at his or her own pace. The ideal way to combine discovery, fun and immersion in the hea
tldr: Plongez dans l'univers médiéval du Larzac avec un carnet de visite spécialement conçu pour les enfants et leurs familles.

Restoration works have given this tower back its warrior physiognomy with its five storeys, its sentry walkway with machicolations and its adjoining buildings: the Knights' Logis (living quarters) and the Grange (barn). All these buildings enable permanent
tldr: Visitez la Tour Hospitalière du XVe siècle, symbole de l'histoire agro-pastorale du Larzac et de l'ordre des Hospitaliers.

I handcraft knives essentially Laguiole full handle as they were originally born from the peasant tradition. These are unique knives...exclusive, which are mainly made with regional materials without the slightest synthetic transformation, without waste but also without importation from overseas.
It is by reviving some forgotten models that I wanted to combine with the knives, legends, tales, or stories of the plateau of Aubrac. The first of them will be a horn knife that may have accompanied "Le voleur d'Alpuech", the robin des bois of Aubrac, a true story from the 18th century!
tldr: Admirez des couteaux Laguiole artisanaux, forgés à la main avec des matériaux locaux selon la tradition paysanne.

"Welcome to the Martin du Lézert website!
I'm Martin, the martinaire. I have to prepare a new order for an important customer. Unfortunately, I've lost the paper on which I wrote the name of the item. Can you help me find it? To do so, solve the 8 riddles in the booklet by following the swifts' tour.
During your visit, you'll discover the history of this place through the testimonies of the villagers who took part in its restoration."

name: Livret-jeu "Mystère au Bas Ségala" - La Bastide l'Evêque
description:
"Welcome to La Bastide-l'Évêque.
I am Gauthier Patras, son of a merchant from Villefranche-de-Rouergue. This morning in 1496, my father sent me here because he was to receive an important order for copper pairols*. But it never arrived.
I need to find the martinaire (the man who makes these pairols).
Will you help me?"

*copper pieces to be transformed into cauldrons
tldr: Plongez dans une intrigue médiévale en 1496 à La Bastide-l'Évêque avec ce livret-jeu historique.

tldr: Bibliothèque moderne à Saint-Affrique : livres, événements et ressources numériques pour tous les âges.

name: Médiathèque Moulin de la Culture
description:
The mission of the Plateau de Montbazens network of media libraries is to give everyone access to leisure, information, documentary research and lifelong learning. Access to media libraries and reading points and on-site consultation of documents are free, open and free of charge. To borrow documents, you must be a subscriber to the media library network.
Documents can be circulated between media libraries and reading points. The network regularly organizes cultural events.

name: Médiathèque-Ludothèque de Rodez
description: Located in downtown Rodez, the Médiathèque-Ludothèque is open from Tuesday to Saturday. Consultation of all documents is free of charge. A subscription is required for home borrowing.
tldr: Espace culturel ludique à Rodez : livres, jeux et ressources numériques en accès libre.

name: Medieval town of Sévérac-le-Château
description:
Labelled as a “Petite Cité de Caractère” (Small Town of Character – French heritage label), it is one of the largest medieval towns in the Aveyron region. Passing through one of its fortified gates is like stepping back in time. Once protected by ramparts, moats and four gates (two of which still remain), the town boasts remarkable architectural heritage: half-timbered houses, vaulted passageways, overhanging upper floors, spiral stair towers, and mullioned windows.
As you stroll through the narrow streets, you’ll discover the Romanesque fountain, the Church of Saint-Sauveur, the covered marke
tldr: Plongez dans l'histoire médiévale de Sévérac-le-Château, une cité fortifiée préservée.

name: Mélac castle
description: Mélac, "repaire" -fortified wealthy house- of the southern Rouergue built between the 14th and the 16th centuries by the feudal Gozon family. The castle forms a very contrasted ensemble because of its different architectural styles: exceptional interior courtyard with arcades supporting the galleries on two levels, 15th century watchtower with its original bombards, Renaissance round tower and its cupola storeys, vaulted guards room with rib tufa stone dating from the 14th century, large rougier sandstone fireplace, epic narrative about Dieudonné de Gozon, Grand Master of the Order of Saint Jo
tldr: Visitez Mélac, un château médiéval contrasté aux 14e-16e siècles, témoin de l'architecture féodale.

name: MÉLANIE ET GUILLAUME MILLAU ACTIVITES NATURE
description:
We are a couple of independent state-qualified instructors, from Millau, working in outdoor sports.
Come and share our passion with us, to discover the Grands Causses region in a different way, to climb, jump, crawl, slide, swim, have fun together! Our activities are adapted to all levels, from family discovery to major outings, from 5 years old for the easiest routes... We will choose your outing with you and we will go at your own pace.
tldr: Explorez les Grands Causses avec des professionnels : escalade, randonnée et sensations fortes.

name: Mets Racines
description:
Mets Racines is the second dining venue of the Fagegaltier family, conceived as a natural extension of Le Vieux Pont restaurant. Opened in June 2026, it offers simple, local and seasonal cuisine, reflecting our vision of sincere, generous and accessible gastronomy.
Its name pays tribute to Marcelle and Raymond Fagegaltier, our parents and grandparents, who played a key role in the development of our family business.

name: MICROPOLIS LA CITÉ DES INSECTES
description:
Here WAOUUH! is written in MINUSCULE.
New! In 2026, discover the invisible at Micropolis! Set off for an exceptional day out with your family in the heart of Aveyron, discovering insects, nature, and biodiversity.
Inside, meet over 40 living species from the four corners of the globe, watch the ballet of a thousand-colored butterflies in the tropical greenhouse, follow the parade of worker ants and witness the comings and goings of our foraging bees. Can you spot stick insects disguised as twigs, play with giant colorful insects and avoid the traps of carnivorous plants? Get ready for a change
tldr: Explorez l'univers fascinant des insectes à Micropolis, une aventure unique en Europe pour toute la famille.

name: MICROPOLIS LA CITÉ DES INSECTES (groupes)
description:
Nestled in the magnificent natural setting of Saint-Léons, Aveyron, the Insect City offers a unique adventure in Europe. It's the only place where parents and children can explore, marvel and enjoy a unique experience in the midst of MINUSCULES, animals that are full of surprises.
Let yourself be guided by one of our enthusiastic animators to better understand, love and protect these little creatures, often misunderstood but nonetheless indispensable to our planet.
Micropolis offers self-guided or guided tours, specially designed for groups of seniors, adults or children. A great opportunity t
tldr: Parc dédié aux insectes à Saint-Léons, offrant une expérience éducative et ludique dans un cadre naturel exceptionnel.

name: Miel et essaims de Claire Labbé
description:
I raise bees that produce honey.
I practice transhumance. In other words, I move my hives according to the flowering season, sometimes over long distances. Transhumance allows me to harvest different types of honey.
The different varieties of honey are differentiated by the time of harvest, the place of harvest and the dominant plants on the spot.
I take my hives to Cantal, Aubrac for two types of mountain honey, Gard for lavender and Aveyron like Firmi for Acacia, Causse Comtal for causse honey and of course the Conques area for Chestnut honey.
 My aim is to ensure that my bees produce qualit
tldr: Découvrez le métier de apiculteur avec Claire Labbé, qui pratique la transhumance pour des miels variés et savoureux.

name: Miellerie du Val de Serre
description: Bee keeping: slide show on the life of bees, visit the miellerie (honey production), honey tasting, pollen, sweets, gingerbread, mead, soaps. Exhibition of old hives, educational panels, photos, glass backed hive allowing observation of the bees at work. Fabrication of candles for children.
tldr: Visitez une miellerie à Pierrefiche : exposition d'anciennes ruches, dégustation de miel et produits dérivés, et ateliers pédagogiques.

name: Miellerie du Val de Serre (groupes)
description: Apiculture : diarama on the life of bees, visit of the honey factory, tasting of honey, pollen, sweets, gingerbread, hydromel, soaps. Exhibition of old hives, educational panels, photos, hive with window to observe the bees at work. Candle making for children.
tldr: Pour les groupes, explorez l'apiculture avec diaporama, visite de la miellerie et dégustation de produits à Pierrefiche.

name: Mika Pizza
description:
Travelling pizza truck several days a week.
Pizzas and drinks to take away all year round.
Dishes and decorations can also be hired for your events.
Tour :
- monday evening: place de la pharmacie du château
- tuesday evening: Place de la Salle des fêtes, Lavernhe
- thursday evening : St Martin de Lenne (2nd and 4th Thursday of the month)

- sunday evening: place de la mairie in Le Massegros (48).
tldr: Pizzas artisanales à emporter ou en livraison à Sévérac d'Aveyron, avec des recettes originales et des décorations pour vos événements.

name: Millau Activités Nature - Canyon
description:
Canyoning or aquatic trekking consists of descending a canyon or river using a variety of fun methods such as jumps (never compulsory), slides, swimming, abseiling?

We offer you a selection of the most beautiful canyons in our region, accessible to anyone (FROM 4 years of age) who is at least sporty, willing and motivated, and has no "uncontrollable" fear of water.

Safety, solidarity, pedagogy, cohesion... these are just some of the factors that will enable you to surpass yourself and achieve this exceptional adventure. Together, we'll choose your canyon or aquatic tour according to your lev
tldr: Pratiquez le canyoning ou l'aquatic trekking dans les gorges de Millau, une aventure sportive dans des paysages exceptionnels.

name: Millau Activités Nature - Escalade
description:
Climbing is one of the main activities in our region with world famous sites. The gorges of the Tarn, Jonte and Dourbie rivers will allow you to spend a sportive day in exceptional places and landscapes.

The activity is adapted to beginners in initiation cliffs (from 5 years old).

For the more adventurous, we are lucky enough to be able to offer you a large number of big routes of all levels (from beginner to expert) which will make you take the height (140 meters maximum)!

Come and discover our region in a different way, become a climber for a day or more, to progress and/or become autonom
tldr: Escaladez les falaises des gorges du Tarn ou de la Jonte, des sites mondialement connus pour leur beauté et leur défi.

name: Millau Activités Nature - Rando Rappel
description:
Two courses are available:
A Family route at Verrières (easy level) from age 4 in a very small, dry canyon with abseils of around 4 meters and a small rope zip line.
A discovery route in the village of Les Vignes (medium level) from age 8 upwards, with abseils of up to 30 meters, leading directly to the impressive boulder chaos of the Pas de Soucis in the Tarn gorges.


Ideal for discovering the region in a different way, venturing into unusual places that are inaccessible on foot, learning to abseil and enjoying the view from a great height
tldr: Descendez en rappel dans un petit canyon sec près de Millau, avec une tyrolienne pour les enfants dès 4 ans.

name: Millau Activités Nature - Spéléo
description: The Grand Causses region is a large limestone area where caving can be practiced in numerous caves. The caves or avens of our region are particularly suitable for learning caving in a natural environment: easy access, moderate depth, absence of extreme narrowness. It will be up to you to decide if you want a sporting outing, with abseils and rope climbs, or simply a fun and scientific discovery, for a half-day or a full day. There is something for everyone! From 6 years old, we will choose together your outing and we will go at your pace!
tldr: Explorez les grottes des Grands Causses en spéléologie, dans un cadre naturel idéal pour débuter.

name: Millau Activités Nature - Via Ferrata
description:
A via ferrata is a course built into a rock face, equipped with zip lines, cables, ladders, monkey bridges, footbridges...  The course is entirely secured by cable lifelines

More fun than hiking and less difficult than climbing, the via ferrata is ideal to test your apprehension of the void, to begin the practice of climbing gently, and especially to have fun together, with friends or family, on a playful course in an exceptional setting!

We propose 4 Via ferrata : Le boffi, Liaucous, La Canourgue, and those of Les Rousses next to the unavoidable canyon of the Cevennes, the Tapoul.
tldr: Grimpez une via ferrata équipée de ponts de singe et tyroliennes, plus fun qu'une randonnée classique.

name: Millau Aventure - Les Bateliers du Viaduc
description:
Get on board and discover the valley of the Tarn from the river as you would have imagined ...
All along the river, your guide tell you the history of the country, its traditions and curiosities, its geology, fauna and flora.
The boat trip starts in Creissels, a small medieval village of character near Millau.
Your boatman takes you on an 8 km adventure full of surprises! A beaver hut, a gray heron flight, shivering rapids, and you are under the two highest pillars in the world for a breathtaking and exclusive view of the Millau Viaduct.
At the end of the tour, you sail to the troglodyte villa
tldr: Découvrez la vallée du Tarn en bateau, guidé par un conteur qui partage l'histoire et les traditions locales.

name: Millau Aventure - Paddle
description: The first activity is all about relaxing, unwinding, and having fun on our lake, located within our leisure park. This peaceful setting allows you to enjoy paddleboarding along 800 meters of calm, current-free river. Many animal species also come here to rest, making it a serene and natural environment. Along the way, you can discover beautiful spots such as a waterfall and a beach, both easily accessible by Stand Up Paddle—much more conveniently than by swimming! We offer SUP boards for one or two people, as well as a large paddleboard that can accommodate up to six people, making it perfect
tldr: Pagayez sur un lac de 800 mètres en paddle, dans un cadre paisible et verdoyant.

name: Millau Aventure - Trottinettes Electriques Tout Terrain
description: A fun activity accessible to everyone, allowing you to explore outstanding landscapes in complete freedom. Join a guided tour for a unique experience combining nature, adventure, and excitement. Helmet, gloves, and scooter are provided. With a range of up to 50 km and a speed limited to 25 km/h, enjoy a comfortable and safe ride.
tldr: Explorez des paysages remarquables en trottinette tout-terrain électrique, guidé ou en liberté.

name: Millau Aventure- Canoë
description:
3 routes are available:

The Tarn Route and its Viaduct!
Estimated distance: 8 km, approximately 1 hour 30 minutes of paddling without breaks. Allow 2 to 3 hours if you're enjoying the trip at a holiday pace!
As you drift downstream, discover the Larzac cliffs, the troglodyte village of Peyre, and paddle beneath the famous Millau Viaduct.
Explore the Tarn Valley at your own pace by canoe or kayak!

The Dourbie Route and its Rapids!
Estimated distance: 12 km, approximately 2 hours 30 minutes of paddling without breaks. Allow 3 to 4 hours if you're taking your time and enjoying the scenery!
Navi
tldr: Pagayez sur le Tarn avec vue sur le viaduc de Millau, en 1h30 de descente tranquille.

name: Mille Ans de Traces en Aubrac
description:
The exhibition is divided into 4 spaces :
1 - Learn about the lives  of cervids on the Aubrac plateau with photos and detailed comments. Introduced for 40 years, the deer became king of the forest of Enguilhens.
2 - The resistance movement, during the Second World War.
3 - A farm in the XIth century, unique site in Europe, was reconstituted through a model.
4 - The former sacristy built on the vestiges of the  first church of the village.
tldr: Plongez dans l'histoire de l'Aubrac à travers les traces des cerfs, rois de la forêt depuis 40 ans.

name: Miramont Rock - Viewpoint and its indicator
description:
A strategic spot for Humans for millenia...

The Rock is at the heart of a huge celtic oppidum - dated back to the 2nd century BC - and built by the Rutènes, major people belonging to the free Gaul and allied to the all-powerful Arvernes. This oppidum is around 2000m long, and 1000m wide as a maximum. This dominant spot with steep slopes had control over the area, precisely where the Viaur and Ceor valleys meet.
Its location helped it become the settlement of one of the 12 baronies in the Rouergue during the Middle Age, with its castle - it still existed in early 15th century. It was protected
tldr: Contemplez un oppidum celte vieux de 2000 ans et un panorama à 360° depuis le rocher de Miramont.

tldr: Explorez une collection rare de céramiques anciennes, soieries et peintures chinoises dans un cadre insolite au Moulin de la Culture.

name: Musée Charles de Louvrié à Bes-Bédène
description:
Two exhibition rooms are dedicated to Charles de Louvrié, the French engineer who pioneered the jet engine (patents registered in 1863). Among the exhibits, models bring his inventions to life.
Other attractions include
the museum, which simulates a classroom from the 30s/60s, with magnificent school objects on display.
the ogival-style church built in 1112 (2 altarpieces from the 16th and 18th centuries and an exhibition of priestly vestments). The visit can be followed by a pleasant stroll to the "Pierre Branlante" or to the Roman granite bridge (13th century).
tldr: Découvrez les inventions pionnières de l'ingénieur Charles de Louvrié, père du réacteur à réaction, à travers des maquettes animées.

name: Musée de la Dragonnière
description:
Do you know the history of the village of Costes-Gozon? Push the doors of this small museum which will make you discover the legend of Dieudonné de Gozon, 27th Grand Master of the order of the Hospitallers of St. John of Jerusalem in the 14th century. Discover the history of the village through objects full of history that will guide you to the various archaeological sites of the village.

Admire the painting of "Dieudonné de Gozon's fight against the dragon", the original Menhir de Caumilhou statue, the inventory of the crosses of the village and many others!
Continue your escapade in Costes-
tldr: Découvrez la légende de Dieudonné de Gozon, Grand Maître des Hospitaliers, dans ce musée villageois méconnu.

name: Musée de la forge et de l'ancienne vie rurale
description: Located in the old smithy, the museum contains many different blacksmiths tools as well as the traditional tools of the rural world. In the past the smithy would have resonated with the clear hard sound of steel on steel while harrow and fork tines glowed in the fire; now, anyone who wants to appreciate the blacksmiths skills and admire the huge stock of tools which he needed to ply his trade can admire his craft. The smithy which contains the museum was itself built on the site of one of the two towers of the former castle of Lescure, which dated from the 11th century. After the French Revolu
tldr: Explorez l’ancienne forge de Lescure-Jaoul et ses outils de forgeron, témoins d’un savoir-faire rural disparu.

name: Musée de la forge et des anciens métiers de Belcastel
description:
A documented and attractive visit to share with the youngest.

The old forge, a 3 storey building each floor of about 45m2. First level: the forge master. Level 2: the craft of the blacksmith and the visit of an old furnished house. Level 3: the craft of fisherman and clog-maker and an exhibition of of wooden sculptures by the artist Pierre LERON LESUR.
tldr: Visitez l’ancienne forge de Belcastel, un bâtiment de trois étages où l’artisanat et l’histoire s’animent.

name: Musée de la forge et des anciens métiers de Belcastel (Groupes)
description:
Situated in the village, the house, once Fernand Moly's forge and the home of his entire family, is now houses all the old tools of the farrier, the blacksmith, the clog maker and the fisherman. Three trades practiced in Belcastel at the beginning of the twentieth century those disappeared today. Also, a collection of "sylvistructure" donated by Pierre Leron-Lesur, a naturalist artist, completes the visit of this old house.
Duration: 30 minutes (all year round by reservation). 

Price: 2 €/person (guide free)
Possibility of combining it with a visit to the village (total price €5/person).
tldr: Plongez dans les outils oubliés des métiers d’autrefois : forgeron, sabotier, maréchal-ferrant et pêcheur.

name: Musée de la Mine Lucien Mazars
description: Inaugurated in 1979, the Aubin Mine Museum retraces the history of the Decazeville coalfield through 3 rooms. Accompanied by a guide you will discover the men at the origin of the industrial revolution, the major events of these 150 years of mining and steel industry, the reality of the working conditions of the miners, the different jobs that men, women and sometimes even children had, and how they fought many times to obtain rights. Traditional miners' equipment, numerous tools, corporate flags and banners, archival documents, and an attractive museography invite you to relive this great ind
tldr: Retracez l’épopée minière du bassin de Decazeville avec un guide, entre machines et récits de mineurs.

tldr: Découvrez l’histoire industrielle du charbon à travers des objets et témoignages rares, guidé par des passionnés.

Musée de la Résistance

name: Musée de la vigne et de la mine
description:
This cultural place is located in the old vaulted cellars of the castle, currently the Town Hall of Saint Rome de Tarn. This museum restores the principal activities
mining and viticulture from 1900 to 1970. It was created by young teenagers with the help of the villagers, companies and the town hall. It is composed of two distinct parts: a large room representing the viticulture and the material of a clog maker and an annex room regrouping an old reconstituted mine.

The museum can be visited only on Tuesdays from 9:30 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. with a 20-minute free tour.
tldr: Explorez les caves voûtées de Saint-Rome-de-Tarn pour comprendre l’alliance historique de la vigne et de la mine.

name: Musée de Lincou
description: Museum, gastronomy "stone tables", art gallery. Mediaeval costumes possible.
tldr: Goûtez aux « tables de pierre », explorez des costumes médiévaux et admirez une galerie d’art dans ce musée éclectique.

name: Musée de Millau et des Grands Causses
opening_hours: Mo-Sa 10:00-12:00,14:00-18:00; Oct-Apr: Su off; Oct-Apr: PH off; May-Jun Su off; May 01 off; Jul-Aug: Mo-Su 10:00-18:00; Sep Mo-Su 10:00-12:00,14:00-18:00

name: Musée de Millau Grands Causses
description:
Paleontology: various fossils, including the famous elasmosaur skeleton.


Prehistory: abundant furniture from the Paleolithic to the Neolithic.

Archaeology: the largest collection of vases from the Roman Empire, including pieces from the Graufesenque workshops.

Skins and Gloves: a film retraces a specific know-how rich in ancestral traditions and modern techniques for transforming skins. A reconstructed workshop shows the manufacture of gloves for both haute couture and city wear.
tldr: Admirez le squelette d’élasmosaure et des milliers d’objets préhistoriques dans ce musée aux collections exceptionnelles.

name: Musée de Millau Grands Causses - MUMIG (Groupes)
description:
4 collections:

Prehistory: abundant furniture from the Paleolithic to the Neolithic periods.
Archaeology: the largest collection of vases from the Roman Empire, with pieces from the Graufesenque workshops.
An interesting complement to the Graufesenque archaeological site, also in Millau.
Skins and Gloves: a film retraces a specific know-how rich in ancestral traditions and modern techniques for transforming skins. A reconstructed workshop shows how gloves are made, from city gloves to haute couture.
A temporary exhibition
tldr: Découvrez fossiles, outils préhistoriques et poteries anciennes lors d’une visite guidée pour groupes passionnés.

name: Musée Denys-Puech (groupes)
description: Entirely renovated in 1989, the museum presents sculptures by Denys Puech as well as works by his friends, the Orientalist painter Maurice Bompard and the engraver Eugène Viala. The contemporary collection presents in rotation: sculptors - François Bouillon, Francis Mascles, Bernard Pagès, Carmen Perrin, Nicolas Sanhes - and painters - Cosme de Scoraille, Michel Cure, Rolino Gaspari, Paul Kallos - engaging an astonishing dialogue with artist of the past. Temporary exhibitions enable you to explore other aspects of contemporary creation. Outside the building, a monumental work christened "Integ
tldr: Contemplez sculptures, peintures orientalistes et gravures dans ce musée dédié à Denys Puech et ses contemporains.

name: Musée des métiers de la pierre et de la vie rurale
Musée des traditions populaires du Fel : Espace Marcelle Cayron
description:
This museum, about popular traditions of le Fel, offers a collection of objects, pictures and texts coming from the occitan dialect gathered by the inhabitants. One of its particularities : the wax press system. The daily life of the village is recounted here : vineyard, wine, sailing on the Lot, honey, wax, chestnut...
Visits possible all year round. Access on the ground floor for persons with reduced mobility.
tldr: Découvrez les objets et récits du Fel en occitan, une plongée dans les traditions locales méconnues.

name: MUSÉE DU CHARROI RURAL
description: Carts, transport, local crafts, agricultural tools and objects. Complete set of tools of local crafts. Audiovisual film. History and technology of the wheel and vehicles before motorisation (from animal-drawn vehicles to modern motorised vehicles. Evolution of the techniques and adaptations). Ethnology of the Ségala. Inaugurated in 1980, the museum occupies the old 19th century  church of Saint Firmin. This museum presents a complete collection of carts, solid wood wheels or iron banded wheels, horse drawn vehicles etc... The video film presents the fabrication of a wheel and the making of clo
tldr: Explorez l'histoire des charrettes et outils ruraux avant l'ère motorisée, un voyage technique et rural.

name: Musée du couteau de Laguiole
description: The Museum offers an unusual, unguided tour on the theme of the old-fashioned forge. History of knives from their origins to today. From Monday to Friday you can watch the famous Damaskus blades (multi-layered steel) being forged. You'll learn about the different knife-making trades, which are presented in the form of workshops of the time. There's an exhibition of thousands of cutting tools and forged objects used in former trades. A unique exhibition of our collection of Laguiole knives from their origin. The monumental sculpture of the biggest Laguiole in the world: 10 tonnes, 6 metres high
tldr: Plongez dans l'artisanat du couteau de Laguiole, de la forge à la lame damassée, en visitant une ancienne forge.

tldr: Découvrez l'histoire des couteaux de Laguiole et l'art de la forge dans un cadre authentique et vivant.

name: Musée Eugène Viala
description: Romantic and symbolist, he left after his death in Salles-Curan where he rests, a strong and rich work, impressive as much by its originality as by the quality of its manufacture. Precursor of the impressionist movement, he is also a great humanist and philosopher. Rich of the nature which he venerates, he expresses his native "Lévézou" with an unequalled passion to this day. Through his works, especially his etchings, he tells us his philosophy of being and his respect for life in all its forms. A statue in feet sculpted by the artist Marc Robert in 1957, inspired by a painting by the count R
tldr: Admirez les œuvres symbolistes et romantiques d'Eugène Viala, précurseur de l'impressionnisme en Aveyron.

name: Musée Jean BOUDOU
description: Documents on the work of the Occitan writer Jean Boudou - temporary exhibitions
tldr: Explorez l'univers de l'écrivain occitan Jean Boudou à travers ses documents et expositions temporaires.

name: Musée Joseph Vaylet - Musée du Scaphandre
description:
Musée des Arts Populaires. In the setting of the old church of Saint Jean (15th - 16th centuries) collections of art and popular traditions are presented as well as numerous objects concerning domestic life of bygone years.
These collections, brought together by Joseph Vaylet and then by the members of the eponymous association, are spread over 2 levels in an exceptional Gothic setting.

The Diving Museum

tldr: Visitez un musée insolite dans une ancienne église : objets domestiques, scaphandres et traditions populaires.

name: Musée Les Mémoires de Cransac
description:
Local history (mine and thermalism), social history, transformation of the landscapes, individual and collective memories, constitution of the archives of a collection, contemporary creation, so many facets which are approached in this museum through models, plans, photos, films, testimonies...

Discover also "la Triangulaire de Cransac", a contemporary work of art in homage to the history of the city.


The Museum Les Mémoires de Cransac is part of the circuit "Art in the public space in Aveyron".
tldr: Plongez dans l'histoire minière et thermale de Cransac, entre paysages transformés et mémoires collectives.

name: Musée Soulages (Groupes)
description: Pierre Soulages today is one of the most famous living French painters in the world. His work is presented in more than 110 museums throughout the world. The museum Soulages presents his works and temporary exhibitions of national and international scope. The concept of the museum is innovative in itself. It consists of 6000 m2 of dark red strong steel-covered volumes.  Drop-off area: Avenue Vistor-Hugo in Rodez
tldr: Découvrez les œuvres monumentales de Soulages, où l’art abstrait dialogue avec la lumière naturelle.

name: Musées des ardoisières
description:
The Musée des ardoisières features videos on the history of the church and the slate quarries, as well as exhibitions on two levels, including a reconstructed classroom and a model of the last slate quarrying site.
The 11th-century fortified church houses a statue of St. Barbara, patron saint of slate quarry workers.
Unfortunately, this site is not accessible to people with reduced mobility.
Possibility of a 9km hike from Anglars to discover this heritage. Free tour brochure and description.
tldr: Plongez dans l’histoire des ardoisières à travers maquettes, vidéos et une salle de classe d’autrefois.

name: Museum of the Ségala Agricultural Traditions
description:
12km away from Sauveterre-de-Rouergue, inside the Ségala Wildlife Park, this museum traces back the Ségala agricultural history through a way illustrating farm & breeding works from yesterday to today.
Thanks to stage settings, you can see how rye, chestnuts & potatoes were grown, & how "cantou" (traditional fireplace in South West of France) were built.
To keep the elders' memory alive!

You can only enter the museum by visiting the wildlife park.
tldr: Explorez l’évolution des techniques agricoles du Ségala, entre outils anciens et savoir-faire modernes.

name: My Home Farmer, la maison du safran et des aromatiques
description:
Welcome to La maison du Safran et des aromatiques, your destination for discovering the golden treasure of spices: saffron. We're passionate about this precious spice and its countless benefits, and we're dedicated to offering our customers the finest saffron in the world.
Our history
Myhomefarmer was born of a passion for sustainable agriculture and authentic flavors. We cultivate saffron with care and respect, using traditional methods that preserve the purity and quality of each stigma. Our adventure began in the sunny fields of our region, where each crocus sativus flower is harvested by h
tldr: Découvrez la culture du safran, une épice rare et précieuse, et ses usages culinaires et thérapeutiques.

tldr: Offrez-vous une pause détente avec des massages bien-être certifiés pour une relaxation profonde.

name: Nature et Sensations - Rando Aqua et Canyoning
description:
Come and discover the canyons in the heart of the Cévennes, while having a great time. The activity is accessible to all, with different levels of canyoning.
The Bramabiau canyon is available from age 9. With its many jumps of ever-increasing height and large slides, it's a canyoning experience in a wild, unspoilt environment. It's a great activity for families, or for those new to the sport.
The Tapoul canyon is more challenging. It's accessible from the age of 12. As you progress, I propose a number of jumps and obstacles up to 10 meters high. You'll then have the choice of going down with t
tldr: Descendez les gorges du Bramabiau en canyoning, une aventure accessible à tous les niveaux.

name: Nature et Sensations Escalade
description:
Take the height by leaving for the adventure to discover the climbing in natural environment on the cliffs around Millau. The numerous sectors will satisfy young and old alike: initiation or improvement climbing, in the shade or in the sun, there is something for everyone and for all levels.

You will learn the basics of climbing (safety, evolution on the rock, descent). It's the perfect activity to surpass yourself, or to bask in the sun!
From 4 years old.

Take even more height with the big route! Go alone or in couple with an instructor for an exceptional half day. The numerous routes of at
tldr: Grimpez en pleine nature sur les falaises de Millau, avec des parcours adaptés aux débutants comme aux experts.

name: Nature et Sensations Via Ferrata
description:
The via ferrata is halfway between hiking and climbing. A good way to discover the rock and the beautiful views from the summits. Go equipped with your harness, your safety lanyard, your pulley and your helmet. Take advantage of your instructor's supervision to immerse yourself in an exceptional environment.

Are you afraid of heights? Don't panic, the blue course is less impressive. If you are sporty or want a challenge, go for the red course! The best part? The courses are totally flexible according to the level and the desires of each one thanks to the easy and difficult courses which cross
tldr: Marchez sur les parois rocheuses de Millau avec une via ferrata, pour des vues spectaculaires sans expérience requise.

name: Naucel'Fripes
description:
Naucel'Fripes is a second-hand store run by volunteers.
It enables you to consume differently by giving a second life to your clothes.
Open to all, at low prices, you can find articles for men, women, children and babies!
Open on the 1st and 3rd Saturdays, and on the last Wednesday of each month!
tldr: Fouillez une friperie solidaire pour chiner des vêtements à petits prix et donner une seconde vie aux textiles.

name: Naucelle Outdoor Aquatic Area
description:
In the heart of the former sauveté of Naucelle, are waiting for you 4 pools, 1 diving board, 100 deckchairs, 2 solaria & 1 snack-bar.
More than going to the swimming pool, this aquatic area offers activities to please everyone!
For more information, click here (website in French).
Groups & camps : please, make an appointment with the manager.
_________________________________________________________________

The pools are not equiped with adapted facilities, you will need the help of your mates.
tldr: Profitez d’une base aquatique avec piscines, plongeoir et snack, au cœur d’un cadre historique préservé.

name: Naucelle pour les déficients visuels
description:
With the help of your smartphone, guided by local artist Jean Boudou, embark on an audiodescription walk through the narrow streets of Naucelle.
Quite a project: the tour was produced jointly by the tourist office and AcceSens.
Also nearby: Sauveterre for the visually impaired and the Viaur Viaduct for the visually impaired.
tldr: Découvrez Naucelle autrement avec une balade audio-guidée par un artiste local, pour voir la ville avec les oreilles.

NayracTour is a free, modern treasure hunt for families, friends and even individuals, all year round! You use your smartphone to solve an investigation in different parts of Nayrac.
To get started, simply take your smartphone and visit our website www.app.nayractour.fr. There, you can choose the route of your choice and embark on an exciting investigation.
The app is easy to use, and at each stage of your journey you'll need to :

- Find the hidden QR-Code. Use the app's built-in QR-Code scanner to scan it quickly.

tldr: Résolvez des énigmes en famille ou entre amis avec une chasse au trésor moderne à Nayrac, accessible toute l'année.

name: Nécropole wisigothe du Sabel
description: The "Espace du Sabel" offers an ideal path because all the way along your walk you will be able to appreciate tombs and sarcophagus, dolmens, ancient dwellings... to learn while benefiting from the vestiges of a site occupied by man since Palaeolithic times. This area turns into a walk of approximately 13km around the village of Costes-Gozon, discovering historic and cultural heritage, notably concerning the Gozon family.
tldr: Promenez-vous parmi des tombes wisigothes, dolmens et habitats anciens pour un voyage archéologique en pleine nature.

name: Netto
description:
Discovering local flavors
This supermarket combines the essentials of everyday shopping with a commitment to local produce. Alongside the major brands, you'll find a selection of specialities from Aveyron and the surrounding area.
From cheeses and charcuterie to seasonal produce and artisanal know-how, the brand celebrates local producers and short distribution channels, offering quality products that are rooted in the region.
Shopping here also means supporting the local economy, while discovering the gourmet riches of Aveyron.
For opening days and times, visit the store web page.
tldr: Supermarché mettant en avant les produits locaux d'Aveyron, pour allier courses et découverte des saveurs régionales.

name: Noailhac
description:
Outside the city, but on the way to Santiago de Compostela, the Chapel of St. Roch, which is depicted as a pilgrim with the bumblebee and shells, was particularly invoked during plague epidemics and, around the 15th century, it took the place of Santiago in many churches and chapels once dedicated to the Apostle of Spain.
Today, the establishment of agricultural activity remains fundamental for the municipality, which has about twenty farms: mixed farming, pastures, vineyards, cattle, sheep, goat and pig breeding.
tldr: Chapelle Saint-Roch, invoquée contre les épidémies, ornée de symboles de pèlerinage sur le chemin de Compostelle.

name: Oratoire de Romette
description:
The 16th century oratory, covered by a pyramid shaped roof, shelters a beautiful limestone cross. Formerly it was also used as a courthouse. The adjacent 19th century church replaced an old medieaval sanctuary and was rebuilt in 1895. It has a 15th century wooden statue of the Virgin.
Nearby, you'll also note some of the ancient graves of the cemetary as for example, the vicar named Foulquier who worked for more than 50 years for Romette parish.
tldr: Découvrez un oratoire du XVIe siècle à toit pyramidal abritant une croix en pierre, ancien tribunal médiéval.

name: OSP un oeil sur le passé. Découverte de technologies anciennes
description:
In an air-conditioned, PRM-accessible 180 m2 building, 220 everyday objects have been brought together. Music, photos, cinema, radios, printing, small technologies, "What's it for, how does it work, history", the answer on a guided tour. Everything works.
With more than 220 objects, from 40 donors/lenders, mainly representing means of communication, measurement and small-scale domestic manufacture, there's something for everyone, whether it's acquiring knowledge, admiring the ingenuity of our elders or contemplating noble objects with a touch of nostalgia... Enthusiastic guides accompany visit
tldr: Explorez 220 objets du quotidien anciens : radios, appareils photo, machines à écrire... et leur fonctionnement.

name: Padel
description:
Straight from Spain, Padel is a racket sport derived from tennis, squash and badminton. Padel is sure to win you over, thanks to its conviviality, accessibility and playful spirit.

name: Paia Bowl
description: Aloha! Discover our various signature Poké, lovingly concocted from freshly prepared ingredients. At Paia Bowl, we're committed to bringing you the best Poké, so you can experience the authentic flavors of Hawaii and California in every bite. You can also personalize your Poké in a variety of ways, on Paia Island there's something for every taste and color:) We are what we eat!
tldr: Dégustez des pokés frais et colorés, préparés avec des ingrédients locaux et de saison.

name: PAIN À L'ANCIENNE
description:
Every Tuesday in July and August, from 11am to 5pm, Jean-Baptiste, a trained baker, enjoys working with flours to produce authentic, tasty breads. With flours from the nearby Moulin à Vent de la Borie, our ancient wood-fired oven will sublimate his work and produce exceptional bread.

Depending on when you arrive, you can help him knead the dough, heat the oven, put the bread in the oven or take it out. In all cases, he'll be happy to discuss his work and his breads with you.

You can come for the whole day, alternating visits with the major stages in the bread-making process, or go out to tas
tldr: Découvrez le pain artisanal cuit au feu de bois chaque mardi en été, avec des farines locales.

Welcome to Ferme de Roquecanude!

Here you'll find a wide range of quality products!
Our small, organic, free-range pig farm enables us to offer you fresh meat parcels, terrines in a variety of flavors, as well as our dried meats, sausages, coppa and lonzo.

Our young herd of free-range Highland Cattle will soon enable us to offer you meat of excellent nutritional quality, similar to that of bison, low in cholesterol and rich in omega fatty acids.

In the bakery, you'll find a number of different organic breads, made by us from ancient cereals grown on our land and transformed into flour on th
tldr: Goûtez des charcuteries bio issues d'un élevage porcin en plein air et nourri à la glandée.

name: Panat
description:
A picturesque village on a rocky outcrop, Panat is dominated by its castle.
The castle is private and cannot be visited. Mentioned as early as 1062, the foundations, the walls and the vaults of the lower floor of the present castle date from the Middle Ages. It was modified in the 16th century, then at the beginning of the 18th century. Strange iron gargoyles decorate the façade
Adjacent to the castle, one can see the ruins of a Romanesque church.
tldr: Admirez les vestiges d'un château médiéval perché sur un piton rocheux, vue imprenable.

name: Panorama de la Confluence à Entraygues sur Truyère
description: Access from the Route d'Aurillac: Park at the lookout, then take the footpath that starts in the woods.
tldr: Contemplez la confluence du Lot et de la Truyère depuis un belvédère accessible à pied.

name: Panorama depuis la Vierge de Vermus à Espalion
description:
It takes a bit of effort to reach the Madonna, which culminates after an hour's walk and an ascent of around 200 metres. But what a view from up there!
Situated on the route of Saint Jacques de Compostelle, you can reach the summit by taking the small tarmac road that leaves the Espalion canoe-kayak base in the direction of Saint Côme d'Olt.
Start on foot from the Perse church parking lot in Espalion.
tldr: Grimpez jusqu'à la Vierge de Vermus pour une vue à 360° sur Espalion et ses alentours.

name: PANORAMA DU POINT SUBLIME
description:
Located at 870 m of altitude, the classified site of the "Point Sublime" is one of the places in the gorges of the Tarn the most frequented. Located on the Causse de Sauveterre, the Point-Sublime is a belvedere which offers to the visitors the spectacle of these marvellous ochre cliffs plunging in the emerald waters of the Tarn.
At the foot, more than four hundred meters below, the Tarn makes a right angle turn and this 'caprice' allows the visitor to take in the gorges in enfilade, and towards the east, and towards the south. Opposite, the steep ledges of the Méjean causse give the final touc
tldr: Surplombez les gorges du Tarn depuis un point culminant à 870 m, paysages à couper le souffle.

name: PANORAMA DU ROC DES HOURTOUS
description:
In a pastoral and wild environment, the owners of the site open the doors of the Roc des Hourtous and offer you an exceptional landscape.
On the edge of the Causse Méjean, the viewpoint is drawn below the narrowest part of the Gorges du Tarn : Les Détroits.

You will be able to observe the flight of the vultures, to admire the splendid sunsets around a good small dish on the terrace of the Rock.
tldr: Découvrez un panorama sauvage et préservé depuis le Roc des Hourtous, au bord du Causse Méjean.

name: Panorama over the Viaur Viaduct
description:
Let this construction of genious carry you away...

Between Aveyron & Tarn, in the heart of the Ségala, the Viaur Viaduct & its 3,800 tons of steel, seems to lay down, as light as a feather, on the hillsides of the Viaur Valley. 

It is a remarkable metal work of the engineer Paul Bodin : steel girders, arches, a million of rivets... This aerial lace is 166m high & 460m long, with a 220m-wingspread central arch.

You will be amazed by the harmony between technique & nature.
... & its innovative technique!
The Viaur Viaduct was subject to an architecture competition in 1887, open to engineers:
tldr: Émerveillez-vous devant le viaduc de Viaur, géant d'acier suspendu entre Aveyron et Tarn.

tldr: Admirez Estaing et les gorges du Lot depuis un virage discret offrant une vue imprenable.

name: Panorama sur la vallée du Lot depuis le château de Roquelaure

Recommended access via the D664 road from Le Clapas de Thubiès.
For those wishing to reach this panorama as part of a longer hike, we recommend this one: 21-Le-clapas-de-Thubies.pdf
tldr: Profitez d'une vue panoramique sur la vallée du Lot depuis les ruines du château de Roquelaure.

tldr: Contemplez la vallée du Lot depuis Notre-Dame des Hauteurs, avec tables de pique-nique à disposition.

name: Panorama sur les gorges du Lot depuis Fombillou au Nayrac

In addition to the spectacular view of the gorge, you'll find a beautiful landscape that takes on a variety of colors depending on the season. A great place to return to time and again!
To get there, follow the hiking trail "Le chemin des vignes depuis Crussac" (info on the Nayrac commune website) - Distance: 13.21 km - D+: 411 m / D-: 417 m.
tldr: Observez les gorges du Lot depuis Fombillou, un spot aux couleurs changeantes selon les saisons.

Parc animalier Le Saint Hubert

Just a few minutes from Rodez, the Parc animalier Le Saint Hubert offers a unique wildlife experience in an unspoilt natural setting. Located in Montrozier, on the edge of the Palanges forest, this park invites visitors to experience a close-up immersion with the animals in an authentic, verdant environment.
The park extends over almost 28 hectares of meadows and woods, home to over 150 European wild animals in semi-liberty: European stags, Japanese deer, Asian fallow deer, Corsican mouflons and wild boar. Here, the animals evolve i
tldr: Observez la faune sauvage dans un cadre préservé, à deux pas de Rodez.

name: Parc AquaVagues Millau
description:
The Parc AquaVagues Millau, white water stadium is an artificial river arm on which a team of specialists does everything possible to offer you customized experiences.
Discover the white water !

We develop with our instructors of the training courses of discovery, improvement, challenges multi supports: rafting, hydrospeed, kayak, dragon boat, stand up paddle... Face the waves to the doors of Millau!
You can also go at your own pace by renting the equipment and accessing the white water stadium independently, always with our advice.

Duration of the activity : from 1h30 to 2h.

name: Parc aventure Le Saint Hubert
description:
Parc aventure du Saint-Hubert: a fun activity in the trees near Rodez
Just a few minutes from Rodez, the Parc aventure du Saint-Hubert offers an original activity in the heart of nature, ideal for a family vacation or weekend outing. Located in the heart of a natural wooded estate in Montrozier, this park offers a fun experience accessible to all, combining tree games, sensations and moments of relaxation.
Unlike a traditional accrobranche course, the Saint-Hubert adventure park uses a system of giant suspended nets, enabling visitors to move through the trees without the need for a harness. V
tldr: Grimpez dans les arbres pour un parcours aventure en pleine nature près de Rodez.

description:
Whether a military building or a castle of convenience, the Dovecote has undergone many changes over the centuries. It takes its name from the two dovecotes used to breed pigeons at the time. Today, Paul and Edmond de La Panouse open their estate to the public to share their history and pass on their knowledge of ancestral customs.
For thrill-seekers, book your Auto-Psy escape game here (not recommended for under-18s): https://escape.chateauducolombier.fr/auto-psy/

Need a refreshing gourmet break? The castle store offers drinks and snacks.
tldr: Explorez un château médiéval aux deux colombiers, témoin de siècles d’histoire.

> Depart from Place des Arcades, at the well (the Qr code
tldr: Écoutez l’histoire de Sauveterre-de-Rouergue en famille, version adulte ou enfant, avec des élèves locaux.

name: Parcours "Oreilles en balade" au Viaduc du Viaur
description:
This railway viaduct, inaugurated in 1902, is synonymous with a revolution in the Ségala region. It linked the departments of Aveyron and Tarn (between Tauriac-de-Naucelle (12) and Tanus (81)). The arrival of the train led to the development of trade and, in particular, the arrival of lime, which gave a major boost to Segali agriculture: wheat and corn replaced rye.
This technical feat (listed as a historic monument), designed by Paul Bodin, can be admired from three different vantage points, each equipped with QRcodes to be flashed, giving you access to some fascinating local anecdotes!

name: Parcours "Oreilles en balade" sur la commune de Quins
description:
In Quins, start your walk directly at the orientation table overlooking Ségala. Listen to the audio document from the Rieupeyroux chapel, which explains the Ségala region, and then listen to the one about Sauveterre de Rouergue, which you can make out in the distance. You'll understand why artisans settled there in the first place.
Once you've listened to the anecdotes and admired the landscape, head off to visit two chapels: Saint Vincent de Lugan, a Romanesque chapel that has been restored several times, and Saint Clair de Verdun, a pre-Romanesque chapel listed as a historic monument.

tldr: Découvrez le Ségala en écoutant des récits audio depuis une table d’orientation et une chapelle.

name: Parcours d'orientation dans le Canyon de Bozouls
description:
Download the route maps and find the markers positioned at various points along the canyon. An original idea for a fun, sporting and outdoor activity for the whole family!
Three different routes are proposed, each with three levels of difficulty (a symbol to discover for level 1, a mystery word for level 2 and a punch for level 3).
Start at Place du Caminol (next to Espace Denys-Puech).
Maps are also available from the town hall reception and the Bozouls tourist information office.
tldr: Trois parcours variés dans le Canyon de Bozouls : fun, sportif et familial, avec des cartes à télécharger.

name: Parcours d'orientation de Camboulas
description:
Discover Camboulas, in Lévézou, differently..

Adaptable according to your level of sporting practice (easy or average), the permanent circuit of orienteering of Camboulas is addressed to the competitors who will try to carry out the best performance, or with the walkers who will benefit from the landscape surroundings and the local inheritance.

You will find on this course 15 markers. Each one is equipped with a clip which allows you to prove, within the framework of the activity, that you have found the right marker.



This practice requires to have an orientation map in your possession, w
tldr: Orientez-vous à Camboulas, entre Lévézou et Pont-de-Salars, avec des circuits adaptés à tous les niveaux.

name: Parcours d'orientation de la Nécropole wisigothe du Sabel
description:
In a frantic orienteering race, discover the Visigothic tombs and ancient habitats thanks to the QRcodes and explanatory panels of the orienteering course of the hamlet of Pinsac aux Costes-Gozon.
Ready to take up the challenge?
tldr: Course d’orientation insolite : explorez des tombes wisigothes et des habitats anciens via QR codes et panneaux.

name: Parcours d'orientation de St-Beauzély
description:
On a 1.5 km family trail, initiated by Lou-Anne Czaplicki and the village leisure centre, follow the white arrows and go in search of the animals scattered around the village!
You can park on the Alain Peyrefitte square (grocery store square), the start is at the corner of the school, the route makes a loop allowing you to return to your vehicle
Count on about 45 minutes of fun discovery!
The leaflet of the route can be printed in order to fill in the boxes associated with the animals hidden in the streets of the village!
tldr: Sur 1,5 km, partez à la recherche d’animaux disséminés dans le village de Saint-Beauzély.

name: Parcours de l'ancienne voie ferrée Bertholène-Gabriac-Bozouls-Espalion
description:
This 22 km path between Bertholène and Espalion offers a variety of landscapes and views of our beautiful heritage, including the calvary at Gabriac, the château at Calmont d'Olt and Tholet, as well as panoramic views over the Causse and the Lot valley.
The final section, between Bozouls and Espalion (gently downhill in this direction, and uphill in the opposite direction), takes you through several tunnels and viaducts.
Distance between villages: Bertholène - Gabriac - Bozouls: 11 km / Bozouls - Espalion: 11 km.
Possible departure points: Parking de l'ancienne gare in Bozouls (at the equestri
tldr: 22 km de voie ferrée désaffectée à parcourir : paysages, patrimoine et points de vue remarquables.

name: Parcours de Santé de Coussergues
