name: Parcours ludique "Randoland à Camboulazet"
description:
What does the game involve?
The Randoland circuit cards are designed as a treasure hunt for families, and especially for children.
The clues collected along the way on architectural and natural heritage elements encourage children to observe and search to solve the enigmas suggested. In short, it's a fun way to get out and learn!
How to play the game?
Simply download the form corresponding to your child's age (4-6; 7-9; 10+) from the Town Hall website www.camboulazet12.fr or below.
A paper version is available from Camboulazet town hall (during office opening hours) or from the tourist office
tldr: Randoland à Camboulazet : chasse au trésor familiale pour découvrir le patrimoine architectural et naturel.

name: Pareloup Pilot'

Excursions in a motorboat with a captain, or a trip in a luxury "Pontoon Boat" (without a boating license), be your own Captain! (8 berths)
The jet-skis and boat run on bioethanol. All activities are supervised by state-qualified instructors
+ 10 1-seater paddles
+ 5 2-seater kayaks (rental by the hour, half-day or day)

Individuals, families

description:
Take advantage of your vacations or weekends to get your coastal or river boat license! Training in 1 day in a classroom, 2 hours of individual boat driving (training without exam), e-learning via Codes Rousseau, and passing the theoretical exam on the day of your choice, in the post office of your choice (everywhere in France).
Easy and useful, from 16 years old, the boating license allows you to navigate freely on closed lakes and the sea (coastal license) and/or on lakes, rivers and streams (river license).
tldr: Obtenez votre permis bateau en une journée : formation théorique et pratique sans stress.

You are now on your way to discover the shores of Lake Pareloup: visit the impressive Retenue, the Snake Island and finally, the Bird Island, the most natural and wild of the islands of the lake. These islands are only accessible by boat!

Don't forget your fishing licence, on sale at the Tourist Office 5km from the lake or at the Cave Gély in Sévérac town center.
Fishing in 2nd category, equipped pontoons, float-tube, no-kill zone, etc.
A beach is available, and a food-truck is open in season to satisfy your hunger. Swimming is supervised in summer.
Sanitary facilities, volleyball court, fitness trail and picnic tables.
tldr: Pêchez le black bass dans un lac profond de 5,80 m, idéal pour les amateurs de sport.

name: Point de vue de la tour ornithologique
description:
The Puech de Flauzins observation tower overlooks the Viaur valley and is a major attraction for observing bird migrations, where numerous species can be seen (geese, cranes, bondreys, bee-eaters, etc.). The North-South migration runs from August 15 to the end of October, and the South-North migration from early March to around April 15.
The 12-metre-high tower also offers a 360° view of the Viaur valley and Ségala landscape, and a better understanding of how man has shaped this environment over time.
tldr: Tour d'observation des oiseaux migrateurs dans la vallée du Viaur, un spot unique en Aveyron.

tldr: Vue imprenable sur les grands causses et dolmen de Peyrelevade, un site préhistorique et naturel.

tldr: Table d'orientation à Modulance : des Pyrénées aux monts du Cantal, un panorama à 360°.

name: Pont de Comencau
description:
The bridge's name derives from "Combacaud", meaning "combe-chaude", a name given to well-exposed land in the hollow of the valley.
A solid architectural structure that has withstood the onslaught of the Aveyron River!
The forty-meter bridge is built of schist and rests on 4 semicircular arches. A separate arch on the left bank once spanned the old mill canal. Built in an unspoilt landscape, it displays a number of old-fashioned features: piers with triangular forebays and rectangular hindbays, the latter barely marked.

description: Ancient priory of the Order of Grandmont, founded at the end of the 12th century. Built according to the rules of the Grandmontains. The church has no belfry and posses a unique nave with a barrel vault, it is lit by four Romanesque windows in the semi-circular choir. the ensemble is composed of a cloister, a square chapter house with Romanesque vault and triple arched door, a common room and a dormitory.

name: Prieuré du Sauvage
description:
It was sold as national property during the Revolution. Part of it, including the church, was used as a stone quarry. The conventual part was used as a wine cellar until the end of the 19th century, and then collapsed. Since 1993, an association "Les amis du Prieuré du Sauvage" has partly restored it and tries to bring it back to life through visits and festive and cultural events.
This site is private. Visits are organized on request and during the Heritage Days.

Permanent photo exhibition on site.
tldr: Découvrez les vestiges d'un prieuré médiéval transformé en carrière, puis en cave à vin à Druelle Balsac.

description:
A former volcano rising to 864 metres, the Puech de Buzeins offers a magnificent panorama towards Aubrac and Lévézou
To find your way around, use the orientation tables. A path from the village of Buzeins allows you to reach the top of this puech.
tldr: Montez au sommet de ce volcan éteint pour un panorama à 360° sur Aubrac et Lévézou.

name: Puech du Kaymard
description:
The Puech du Kaymard culminates at 707 meters of altitude and offers a 360° panorama on the region of the valley of Marcillac and by clear weather up to the Mounts of Cantal, the plateau of Lévézou.
Accessible from Majorac by a path (1km)
tldr: Admirez un point de vue à 360° sur la vallée de Marcillac et, par temps clair, les monts du Cantal.

name: PUECHGUIRAL Jeannine
description:
In Salmiech: between the Lévézou Lakes and the Tarn Valley, in the countryside, near Rodez, in the heart of the Ségala, this gîte opens its doors to you for stays with family or friends.

You will enjoy the beautiful sunny days to take your meals on the terrace (28 m²)

On the garden side, the closed ground (2000 m²) will be a beautiful space of games for the children or to relax you in the shade of the big trees.

Detached house, in the village, not overlooked, with owner's apartment in the basement, independent entrances.

name: PUEL William Sculpture
description: Showroom open all year round by appointment.
tldr: Visitez l'atelier de sculpture de William Puel sur rendez-vous toute l'année.

name: Pumptrack
description:
Accessible to all, young and old, whether on bike, scooter, rollerblade or skateboard.
Rules and regulations :
-> Helmets must be worn by all users.
-> Minors using the mogul course are under the responsibility of their legal guardians.
tldr: Testez ce circuit ludique en vélo, trottinette ou roller, accessible à tous les niveaux.

name: Pumptrack
description:
Pumptrack with a City Stadium, a real playground for young people. Near the soccer field and the village hall.
Rules :
-> Helmets must be worn by all users.
-> Minors using the pumptrack are under the responsibility of their legal guardians.
tldr: Amusez-vous sur ce pumptrack près du terrain de foot et de la salle des fêtes.

name: Pumptrack
description:
Two pumptrack circuits installed on the Laubarède playground in Bezonnes, as well as a city-park and a leisure-sports course.
Rules and regulations:
-> Helmets must be worn by all users.
-> Minors using the moguls pitch are under the responsibility of their legal guardians.
tldr: Deux circuits de pumptrack et un parcours sportif-loisirs à Bezonnes pour s'amuser en famille.

name: Pumptrack
description:
This track, which is over 180 m long, comprises a series of challenging humps and turns.
The name of this track featuring raised turns and humps refers to the “bending-pushing” movements carried out on the bike through the combined action of legs and arms. This pumping action performed on hollows and humps allows the cyclist to gain speed without pedaling. 
This facility is available with free access and is adapted to all levels of proficiency, from young children with their balance bikes to the most experienced riders.
This track is part of a plan aimed at the development of urban sporting ac
tldr: Affrontez ce parcours technique de 180 m avec bosses et virages relevés pour riders confirmés.

name: Pumptrack - piste BMX/VTT
description:
Some points of the rules..:
the mogul field is open from 9am to 9pm, and is not supervised,
minors use the mogul field under the responsibility of their legal guardians,
access is forbidden in rainy weather, snow and at night.

Helmets must be worn by all users,

civil liability insurance is strongly recommended,

it is advisable to respect the other users, the vegetation of the site and the quietness of the neighborhood, ?
tldr: Entraînez-vous sur ce circuit BMX/VTT de 9h à 21h, non surveillé mais sous votre responsabilité.

name: Pumptrack Mathis
description:
On a surface of nearly 6,000 m², 3 levels of tracks are proposed:

> A 75-meter-long green run, accessible to beginners and totally independent,
> A 165-meter-long blue run for intermediate skiers,
> A 110-meter-long red run for advanced skiers.  
A 30-space parking lot is available in front of the facility.
tldr: Trois niveaux de pistes (75m à 165m) pour progresser en trottinette ou VTT sur 6 000 m².

name: Pure Aubrac
description:
Pure Aubrac offers you a range of cold-saponified soaps, solid shampoos, skincare creams and accessories for your skin care and bathroom. Our formulations are free from palm oil, to help preserve our planet.
Every product we make reflects our commitment to purity, sustainability and excellence. Discover a range that celebrates the richness of our terroir and natural well-being.
tldr: Fabriquez maison des savons et cosmétiques naturels, sans huile de palme, à Laguiole.

name: Puy de Wolf
description: The slopes of the Puy de Wolf are home to rare and original plants because the rock itself is rare: its serpentinite formed in the earliest times on Earth and by nature not at all suited to plants. Certain species are endemic. At the summit, a viewpoint indicator and a beautiful panoramic view.
tldr: Explorez ce volcan aux pentes uniques, couvert de plantes rares adaptées à sa roche serpentinite.

name: Pymsports - Descente en Trottinette tout terrain
description:
A 2-hour ride in complete safety
Whether you’re a beginner or an expert, riding alone or in a group: explore the Causses region in Aubrac, starting from St. Geniez d’Olt, on an all-terrain scooter. There’s something for everyone!
You’ll be accompanied by a qualified instructor (BEES mountain biking certification)


From July 8 to July 26 and from August 3 to August 30: Wednesdays, departing at 9 a.m. and 2 p.m., 3-hour activity (1 hour for travel and setup + 2 hours of pure activity)
And from July 27 to August 2: Thursdays, departing at 9 a.m. and 2 p.m., 3-hour activity (1 hour for travel and
tldr: Descendez les causses de l'Aubrac en trottinette tout-terrain, encadré ou en autonomie.

name: Pymsports, accompagnement trottinette électrique
description: Mountain bike hire per half day, whole day or more/ hire of mountain bikes and children's trailer. Small repairs to bikes (punctures, changing a chain, adjustments...). Mountain bike guide.
tldr: Explorez les sentiers du Nord-Aveyron en trottinette électrique, avec guide ou en autonomie, et profitez des paysages à votre rythme.

name: Pymsports, accompagnement trottinette tout terrain
description:
Activity description
Whether you're a beginner or an expert, an individual or a group, discover the Nord-Aveyron region (from Entraygues or St Geniez) on an all-terrain scooter. Downhill scootering is practiced on trails. You'll be accompanied by a qualified instructor who will introduce you to this activity for the whole family. Mountain bikes available for hire on reservation.
Several formulas:
- Discovery/family formula: 10km ride, 1h30 to 2h downhill. Accessible to all, the only prerequisite being the ability to ride a bike. To find out more: see the PDF description.
- 3 sporting formulas
tldr: Découvrez le Nord-Aveyron en trottinette tout-terrain, du débutant à l’expert, pour des sensations fortes en pleine nature.

name: Quartier de Combes et Eglise ND des Mines (groupes)
description: Brick faced, this church's choir contains mural paintings in orange and blue tones, paying homage to the difficult work of the miners. The stained glass windows were crafted by the monks from the abbey of En Calcat. Permanent recreated display of the baby Jesus in a manger originally built in a mine gallery. Listed Historic Monument.
tldr: Admirez les fresques murales bleues et orange de cette église, hommage poignant au labeur des mineurs dans un quartier de briques.

name: Quelle Vue, Chalet des Mazes
description:
The layout allows you to enjoy the exceptional view at any time of day.
A little extra: a private, covered terrace adjoining the chalet.

? Independent chalet with +++ view
? Air-conditioned
? Double bed with linen and towels included (bedding (hotel quality), changed early August 2023)
? Private terrace
? Ideal location for visiting Aveyron: 15 minutes from Espalion, 15 minutes from Estaing, 20 minutes from Laguiole and the Aubrac plateau
? Parking nearby
tldr: Savourez une vue exceptionnelle depuis ce chalet indépendant, terrasse couverte incluse, pour un moment paisible en pleine nature.

name: Quiles Annie
description:
The villa has a wooden terrace of 20 m² with garden furniture. Inside the kitchen-living room of 30 m². The kitchen is equipped with dishwasher, microwave, induction cooker, traditional oven, combined refrigerator and freezer
Bedroom 1 : bed 120 and bed 90
Bedroom 2 : bed 140
1 TV in the living room and 1 TV in bedroom 1. Ironing board with steam iron. Electric coffee maker
The house is located at 30 mn from Rodez and 50 km from Millau. Many activities including fishing and water sports.

name: Ranch du Lévézou -  Maison d'hôtes Coeur de Bastié
description:
I offer 1h, 2h or half-day rides, with a maximum of 5 riders, the aim being to share an experience in the heart of nature. If you're comfortable at a walk, trot or canter, our paint horses will be delighted to show you their skills, both in the forest and across the plains and mountains that surround us: 360° panoramic views with Aubrac in the background or the Pyrenees Orientales. Not forgetting another walk along the Viaur to cool off. We make our way up and down the slopes, taking in a wide variety of panoramic views.
Whether you're a seasoned rider, a family or a group of friends, with or
tldr: Montez à cheval ou en attelage sur les chemins du Lévézou, en petit groupe pour une balade nature immersive et conviviale.

name: Rand'Oc Aventure
description: Hiking is a perfect balance between effort, observation of the natural environment and meetings at the crossroads. As a mountain leader, my challenge is to offer this balance, for a day, in a friendly and simple atmosphere. The mountain guide proposes an atypical hike with an itinerary adapted to his clients. Away from the crowds of tourists and guidebooks, the guide leads the hike on a chosen theme: fauna, flora, culture, orientation, night adventure... discovery, adventure, history, curiosity: Escape !
tldr: Randonnez en montagne avec un guide, alliant effort, observation de la nature et rencontres, pour une journée équilibrée et conviviale.

name: Rando accompagnée en VTT électrique à quatre roues (quadbike)
description:
Discover Bozouls, its landscapes and heritage, on an AE 4-wheel mountain bike (Quadbike).
Electric assistance to limit effort. No noise to get closer to nature.
Innovative, supervised rides. Minimum 4 people, maximum 5.
Family outings (slow tourism). Various stops along the way to help you discover the site.
You can also follow the old railroad line from Bozouls to Espalion. A "return trip" that highlights the superb scenery, and the charm of passing under the tunnels and viaducts used by the hike.
Possibility of fitting a child seat (2/5 years) on the Quadbike
Possibility of following with an
tldr: Explorez Bozouls en quad électrique 4 roues, silencieux et assisté, pour une immersion nature sans effort et des paysages à couper le souffle.

name: Rando Semi-nocturne de Jouqueviel aux infournats
Randonnée : le circuit des pins
description:
From the village square, set off to explore the landscapes of the South Aveyron. After a few kilometers offering impressive views of the Raspes du Tarn, a first stop is necessary in the hamlet of Auriac to stroll among the remains of its castle.
After your short break, take the road on the edge of a pine forest and keep an eye out for the silhouette of the Millau Viaduct which will be revealed in the distance... Continue your way, intoxicated by the smell of pine trees, to the viewpoint of the village of St-Rome-de-Tarn before going back down to the village among the faïsses (name given to the
tldr: Partez du village de Saint-Rome-de-Tarn pour une rando de 12 km à travers les Raspes du Tarn et les paysages du Sud Aveyron.

name: Randonnée à dromadaire - Ferme de la Blaquière
description: The nice and friendly dromedary caravan will lead you along the paths at a pace that lets you fully enjoy the Causse's varied attractions. It is possible to set up a bivouac camp making 2 day rides in the region possible. The farm offers different accommodation possibilities: natural campsite and gîte caussenard which makes the organisation of such activities easier for groups who want to visit the area. The rides are essentially within the Aveyron but would be possible elsewhere too.
tldr: Promenez-vous en dromadaire sur les chemins du Causse, à un rythme lent pour profiter des paysages et des bivouacs possibles.

name: Randonnée à dromadaires - Ferme de la Blaquière  (groupes)
description: The "Ferme de la Blaquière" is a family farm where the Castanier family will be happy to welcome you. In the heart of the Parc Naturel Régional des Grands Causses, staying in our gîte or on our campsite, come and discover the activities of the  Ferme de la Blaquière: farm produced cheese sold, rides on dromedaries and numerous activities around the farm, the gîte or the campsite...
tldr: Découvrez le Parc des Grands Causses à dos de dromadaire, avec bivouac ou gîte, pour une immersion nature et familiale.

name: Randonnée accompagnée d'un âne
description:
Discover the trails of the Bozoulais region on a guided group hike lasting about 2 hours in the company of the horses. 
Before departure, the animals will be prepared, groomed, and brushed.
It’s important to make a reservation, as the number of families is limited.
For more information, call 06.87.23.80.82.
Children over 5 years old are not allowed to ride the donkeys.
tldr: Randonnez 2h en groupe avec un âne préparé pour vous, pour une balade nature douce et pédagogique en compagnie des chevaux.

name: Randonnée accompagnée en VTT électrique à 4 roues (quadbike) dans le canyon de Bozouls
description:
Discover Bozouls, its landscapes, and its heritage on a 4-wheel electric mountain bike (quad bike).
Electric assist makes the ride easier. No noise, so you can get as close to nature as possible.
Innovative, guided tours. Minimum of 4 people, maximum of 5 people.
Family-friendly tours (slow tourism). Along the route, there are various stops to help you better explore the area.
You can also ride along the old railway linethat runs from Bozouls to Espalion, on Saturdays at 2 p.m. (reservations required at 06 87 03 81 19). This “round-trip” highlights stunning scenery and the charm of passing thr
tldr: Explorez le canyon de Bozouls en quad électrique 4 roues, silencieux et assisté, pour une découverte immersive de ses paysages et patrimoine.

name: Randonnée accompagnée en VTT électrique à 4 roues (quadbike) sur l'ancienne voie ferrée Bozouls-Espalion
description:
Activity supervised by a sports instructor.
With the Quadbike (a 4-wheel mountain bike with electric assist), you’ll be able to explore the entire length of the old railroad track between Bozouls and Espalion. It’s a different way to ride—more stable thanks to its four wheels and less strenuous thanks to its electric assist—allowing you to explore this area and take the time to observe its remarkable flora and fauna. Family tours, in groups of up to 5 people. With its %AB nearly reclined %BB seating position and %AB airplane-style handlebars %BB, you’ll enjoy riding down the descents, up the c
tldr: Suivez l’ancienne voie ferrée entre Bozouls et Espalion en quad électrique, pour une balade nature et historique sans effort.

tldr: Parcourez le Tarn en quad avec 3 parcours au choix : panoramas, nature et détente, encadré par des professionnels pour des sensations sûres.

name: Randonnée Street-Art au cœur de la Forêt
description:
Parking lot near the Cransac-Les-Thermes spa. The loop starts on a path behind the spa. Arrival at the same point via another path. The route has been designed with accessibility in mind, with paths suitable for most visitors and a low gradient. The trail is suitable for all ages (5 to 77), and takes 2 hours to complete.
The order in which the works are displayed has been designed to create a coherent narrative, in keeping with the theme of Artemis and the relationship between art and nature. However, visitors are free to follow the trail in any direction they wish.
Protecting the environment
tldr: Balade artistique en forêt avec des œuvres de street-art accessibles à tous, près des thermes de Cransac.

name: Randonnées avec des ânes : Au Fil des Raspes
description:
Affectionate, smart, and determined, the donkey is the ideal hiking companion. It carries your gear for the day and knows how to win everyone over: from the children it can carry to the teens it inspires, it adds a whole new dimension to your hikes!
* Poulguières–St. Etienne loop via Le Coudol, Ambias, and Le Grès, returning via the GR736 through Les Raspes
* Children ages 3 to 8 can ride on the donkey’s back under your supervision: please bring a riding or bicycle helmet (if possible)
* No technical difficulty, but everyone must wear closed-toe shoes. Please also bring your own picnic lunch a
tldr: Hissez-vous en randonnée avec un âne, compagnon patient et attachant pour porter vos affaires.

description:
Quel bonheur de séjourner dans ce refuge au coeur d'une forêt de châtaignier enchanteresse dans le Parc Régional des Grands Causses. Le chant des oiseaux, le vent dans les arbres, le ruissellement du ruisseau en contre bas vous berceront assurément. L'accès ne se fait qu'à pied, en longeant un sentier,  à environ 200 m d'une petite route de campagne et 500 m de notre lieu d'habitation.
Nous souhaitions restaurer cette maisonnette de façon écologique, il est composé d'une seule pièce d'environ 25 m2, l'ambiance est cosy et en harmonie avec les lieux où règne une bonne énergie. L'intérieur est s
tldr: Dormir en forêt de châtaigniers, bercé par le chant des oiseaux et le murmure des ruisseaux dans les Grands Causses.

description:
Camping de la Cavalerie invites you to enjoy a unique experience, combining nature, comfort and originality.
Here, adventure takes on a whole new dimension thanks to our unusual accommodations, designed for lovers of disconnection, charm and change of scenery:
Refuge des Nomades: warm immersion in a poetic, nomadic world, 3 single beds (shared sanitary facilities in the campsite)

tldr: Dormir dans des hébergements insolites en pleine nature, entre confort et originalité, au camping de la Cavalerie.

description:
Sonia, Damien and their team are welcoming you the whole year with prepared and fresh food.
A few steps away from the Roquefort's caves where the cheese is refined, you can try our « Aiguières Salad ».
Don't miss the occasion to enjoy our beef from the Aubrac race with Roquefort sauce or our steamed apple tripoux.
On request, we offer you our evening meal service, for groups from 25 to 40 people.
Order online your favorite meal and come to pick it up in our structure thaks to our click and collect service.

Then try our homemade desserts, including the famous chocolate fondant, or choose from among the thousand (or so) flavors of ice cream.
Various beers on tap and a selection of local and regional wines are served in this restaurant with a guinguette spirit

name: Rêve Aveyron
description:
At Rêve, time stops for a moment. And this is reality, literally. It all starts when you cross the monumental bridge, which is also the entrance to the estate. In your own lodge you think you are far from the world.

You come to Rêve to create beautiful moments and memories with your lover, your best friends or your beloved family. Here you come to slow down for a moment and to savor those intense moments.

If you like 'real' authenticity, the discovery of an original cuisine, character, a beautiful story, and a touch of aesthetics, Rêve will surely seduce you.
tldr: Traversez un pont monumental pour entrer dans un domaine où le temps s’arrête, entre réalité et rêve.

name: Rêve Aveyron : Glamping Dôme
description:
This lodge makes your stay at Rêve even more special. For you, a beautiful spot in the forest has been selected where you and your travel group can immerse yourself in nature in the most luxurious form.

tldr: Dormez sous un dôme de luxe en pleine forêt, pour une immersion totale dans la nature.

name: Rêve Aveyron : La Fermette
description:
La Fermette is a charming old farmhouse, carefully decorated in a retro spirit: floral wallpaper, vintage tiles, exposed beams and pastel colors evoke the warmth of vacations, ripe fruit and pies cooling gently on an open windowsill.
All around you: a living garden where ducks roam, chickens bustle about, sheep graze in the orchard and the rolling landscapes of the Roquefort region stretch to the horizon. Here, every day is an invitation to slow living: reading under a lime tree, bathing in the river or savoring local produce as an aperitif after a hike.
The house has three bedrooms, all taste
tldr: Découvrez une ferme rétro aux couleurs pastel, où l’ambiance des vacances d’autrefois vous enveloppe.

name: Rêve et Rando
description:
Nathalie, a graduate of a Brevet d'Etat d'Accompagnatrice Moyenne Montagne, will take you to discover her region on foot, by bike or snowshoe.
The hikes are possible by the day, half-day or in star stay with accommodation in gîte.
tldr: Partez en randonnée guidée avec une accompagnatrice en moyenne montagne pour explorer les paysages de l’Aubrac.

name: Rêve et Rando (groupes)
description:
Nathalie, who holds a state diploma as a mid-mountain guide, will take you on a tour of the region on foot, bike or snowshoe.
Hikes are available by the day, half-day or as a star-rated tour with accommodation in a gîte.
tldr: Organisez une sortie en groupe avec une guide diplômée pour des randonnées pédestres, à vélo ou en raquettes.

name: Rêve et Rando - Randonnée pédestre

tldr: Marchez sur les sentiers de l’Aubrac avec une accompagnatrice expérimentée pour des paysages préservés.

name: Rêves d'Aubrac
description:
Authentic Gîte in the heart of Aubrac ? Ideal for families and friends
Located in a hamlet on the outskirts of the village of Saint-Chély d?Aubrac, this charming character house, a renovated farmhouse, can comfortably accommodate up to 10 people (ideally 6 to 8 adults).
A peaceful, natural setting
The gîte benefits from a privileged location, offering breathtaking views over the surrounding countryside and a peaceful environment, perfect for recharging your batteries with family or friends. Close to a farm, you'll appreciate the charm of nature and absolute peace and quiet. With a respectful n
tldr: Séjournez dans une ferme rénovée en plein cœur de l’Aubrac, idéale pour familles et amis.

name: Ricard Alice - Ferme d'Hermilix (groupes)
description: At the origin of Roquefort, before maturing of the cheese in caves, there's the sheep's milk and a whole process: that of the breeder. Six Pay de Roquefort breeders offer you the occasion to visit their farms. You will be able to visit their sheep barns, see their lambs, perhaps see them being milked and in any case taste Roquefort in their beautiful caussenard setting. It will also be the occasion to share their daily life at the pace of the sheep, between tradition and modernity. Here are three different ways of discovering their farm, their activity, their lives, ... and their passion for R
tldr: Visitez une ferme de brebis Roquefort et découvrez les secrets de la fabrication du fromage avant l’affinage.

name: Richard Calvet - Gîte plain pied
description:
Sunny and comfortable, flat equipped in the countryside at 1,5km from the town center.
1 fully equipped kitchen with microwaves, washing machine. 1 living room, tv, wifi. 1 bedroom with 1 bed 140 and 1 bed 90. 1 bathroom with shower. Separated wc. Terrace, garden. Pets allowed.
tldr: Logez dans un gîte ensoleillé à 1,5 km du centre, équipé pour un séjour confortable en campagne.

name: Richard Calvet - Gîte Richard
description: 1 kitchen with microwave, dishwasher, washing machine. 1 living room with tv, dvd, wifi, sofa. 1 bedroom with 1 bed 140 and 1 bed 90. 1 bathroom with shower. Terrace, garden. Pets accepted.
tldr: Profitez d’un gîte rénové avec terrasse et jardin, idéal pour un séjour en famille ou entre amis.

name: RIGAL "La GRANGE"
description:
Treat yourself to a relaxing getaway, as a family or as a couple, in an ideal setting. Discover the many hiking and mountain-biking trails nearby.
Nestled in the heart of Aveyron, this house opens the doors to the region's must-see sites: Aubrac, Conques, Millau and its majestic viaduct, Bozouls, Rouergue, the Lévezou lakes, and much more.
Take advantage of a charming courtyard with a dining area and a sitting area for socializing. All comforts are at hand: bed linen, towels and tea towels are provided. Available all year round for an unforgettable stay!

tldr: Passez un séjour détente en pleine nature, avec accès à des sentiers de randonnée et VTT à proximité.

Maison indépendante située dans un écrin de verdure au milieu des près et à proximité de Saint Geniez d'Olt et d'Aubrac (3kms)
Cette maison de 2 niveaux est composé au rez de chaussée d'une cuisine avec four, plaque induction, lave vaisselle
Au niveau supérieur, 2 chambres avec lit en 140x190, 1 chambre avec 2 lits superposés en 90x190, une salle de bain avec lave linge et un wc indépendant.
À l'extérieur, terrasse.
Nos amis les bêtes ne sont pas admis.
tldr: Détendez-vous dans une maison indépendante entourée de prairies, à 3 km de Saint-Geniez-d’Olt.

This independent single-storey gîte adjoining another gîte is located on the farm that the owners will be happy to show you around.
The American kitchen opens on the living room, it is perfectly equipped with its cooking plate, the electric oven, the microwave and the dishwasher.
The living room is very warm with its back wall painted in red and the apparent stones which frame the bay window. The sofa bed and television invite you to relax.
There are 2 bedrooms, one with a 140cm bed and the other in a nice apple green with a 90cm bed. There is a shower room.
The washing machine common to both
tldr: Logez dans un gîte moderne attenant à une ferme, où les propriétaires vous feront découvrir leur exploitation.

The American kitchen is equipped with dishwasher, oven, microwave ... and of course you can watch your favorite shows on TV. The bathroom is modern with a glass tile shower and a washbasin on the cabinet.
This vacation rental has 2 bedrooms: one with a bed in 140 and the other with 2 beds i

name: ROC DU SERRE
description: The Roc du Serre reveals an incredible viewpoint over the village of La Malène, in the foreground of a landscape sinking into the Tarn gorges on the horizon.  When choosing your composition, keep the Tarn as a landmark, it shows the path to take.
tldr: Admirez un panorama vertigineux sur les gorges du Tarn depuis ce rocher emblématique de La Malène.

name: Roc et Canyon
description: Roc et Canyon has been a specialist in outdoor sports activities in Millau (Aveyron) for over 35 years.

name: Roc et Canyon (groupes)
description:
Roc & Canyon specializes in the design, organization, and execution of your trips and programs. Wide choice with our twenty or so activities.
Our strengths:
37 years of experience, in-depth local knowledge, expertise built on a passionate and certified team, and top-quality equipment.

name: Roc et Canyon - Canoë Kayak et Stand up paddle
description:
The Gorges de la Dourbie – a wild river, both family-friendly on the shorter routes or more thrilling with plenty of rapids.
5 km & 8 km routes (family-friendly)
13 km route (sporty)

The Tarn Valley – a calmer river, offering a scenic paddle through Millau with a passage under the famous Millau Viaduct.
9 km & 12 km routes (family-friendly)
17 km route (combining both rivers in one descent)
Different yet complementary, these routes let everyone find the “river to their paddle”, offering the chance to explore two stunning sites at your own pace.
Types of boats available:
Kayak: 1 seat
Canoe: 2
tldr: Descendez les gorges de la Dourbie en canoë ou paddle, entre rapides et eaux calmes, pour une aventure familiale ou sportive.

name: Roc et Canyon - Canyoning avec ou sans cordes
description:
River trekking (canyon without ropes or abseiling) offers all the fun of canyoning, but in a 100% playful and accessible version! Set off on an adventure through stunning natural landscapes.
👉🏼 Minimum age: 8 years
👉🏼 Minimum weight: 25 kg
👉🏼 Swimming ability required
👉🏼 Short hike to reach the start of the canyon (and walk back after the activity)
👉🏼 All obstacles (slides and jumps) can be bypassed along the riverbanks
👉🏼 Ideal activity for families!

Canyoning is for adventure and adrenaline lovers! A bit more technical than aquatic hiking, it’s the perfect way to push your limits while havi
tldr: Explorez les canyons de la région en version ludique, sans matériel technique, pour une immersion totale dans la nature.

name: Roc et Canyon - Escalade / Rappel Géant
description:
Climbing – Beginner / Advanced Levels & Abseiling:
Climb using your hands and feet while being safely secured with a rope.
The Dourbie, Jonte, and Tarn Gorges offer an abundance of climbing spots for beginners, experienced climbers, and experts alike.
Several options are available:
Bouldering (up to 4 meters high)
Cliff climbing (5 to 30 meters)
Multi-pitch routes (2 to 6 pitches)

Climbing – Key Info:
Minimum age: 6 years old
Suitable for all levels
Duration: around 2.5 to 3 hours
All necessary equipment provided

Abseiling – Key Info:
Minimum age: 12 years old
Suitable for everyone
Duration:
tldr: Grimpez les falaises des gorges du Tarn ou de la Jonte, encordé ou en rappel géant, pour une expérience verticale inoubliable.

name: Roc et Canyon - Le Vallon des tyroliennes / Parcours Aventure
description:
The “Vallon des Tyroliennes” – A spectacular playground for all ages!
Perfect for anyone who wants to explore between rocks and cliffs, this adventure combines aerial bridges and via ferrata, fully customizable to your level and expectations.
Located in the heart of the Gorges de la Dourbie, your journey begins by crossing the river on a zip line — and that’s just the start! Several zip lines, ranging from 40 to 300 meters, guarantee a thrilling experience.
This aerial course is led by qualified and experienced instructors.
👉🏼 Suitable for everyone (beginners or advanced)
👉🏼 Minimum height: 13
tldr: Sautez d'arbre en arbre sur des tyroliennes et ponts de singe dans un décor spectaculaire entre rochers et falaises.

name: Roc et Canyon - Paintball / Swap Archery
description:
Paintball and Swap Archery are games of cunning, strategy, courage, precision — and a bit of imagination too.
Armed with paintball markers, a jumpsuit, a mask, and protective vests, you’ll play in a natural outdoor setting where you’ll need to use the terrain — rocks, trees, dips, and any natural hiding spots — to outsmart the opposing team.
Several game modes — such as Capture the Flag, Last One Standing, Panic Ball, or No-Limit — will throw you into wild situations where your 300 paintballs will definitely come in handy! Two hours of playtime.
Enjoy the activity with family, friends (bachelo
tldr: Affrontez vos amis au paintball ou tir à l'arc en mode swap dans des paysages naturels adaptés aux stratégies.

name: Roc et Canyon - Raft / Hotdog (mini-raft)
description:
Rafting – Mini Raft: the type of inflatable boat used depends on the water level in the rivers.
The activity is supervised by a qualified and experienced instructor who ensures both safety and fun throughout the trip. The navigation takes place in the Gorges de la Dourbie (upstream from Millau), in a stunning natural setting.
🚣‍♂️ Rafting: inflatable boat for 6–8 people
🚣 Mini-raft (hot-dog): inflatable boat for 1–2 people
👉🏼 Suitable from 11 years old
👉🏼 Swimming ability is required
👉🏼 Duration: about 2.5 to 3 hours
👉🏼 Transport included from our activity base to the departure point
tldr: Défiez les rapides du Tarn ou de la Dourbie en raft ou mini-raft, encadré par des professionnels pour allier sécurité et sensations.

name: Roc et Canyon - Spéléologie
description:
Caving is all about discovering hidden wonders.
Spectacular and full of surprises — these mysterious underground spaces remain some of the last unexplored frontiers on Earth. The Grands Causses region alone counts more than 2,000 known caves… and who knows how many are still waiting to be found?
The activity is accessible to everyone, from beginners to experts, with several levels available to match your expectations.
Explore the heart of the Earth by walking through vast galleries, discovering underground lakes, and admiring unique rock formations — all in comfortable conditions.
You’ll be fu
tldr: Plongez dans les entrailles de la Terre pour découvrir des grottes secrètes et des paysages souterrains mystérieux.

name: Roc et Canyon - Via ferrata, accompagnement et location de matériel
description:
The Via Ferrata is a really complete activity. These vertical adventures on the vertiginous balconies start with an approach walk during which we get to know the site, we appropriate the odours, the sounds, learn about local stories, a culture... during which a certain ambience is created.
Then, it is a safe, supervised and aerial course. Path on a cliff with different kinds of help: ramps, bars, nets, bridges or hanging bridges...
tldr: Grimpez les parois équipées de via ferrata dans les gorges, avec encadrement ou location de matériel pour tous niveaux.

name: Roc et Canyon - VTT et E-bike
description:
The package most often chosen is climbing up onto the Causses in a minibus (with the mountain bikes in the trailor!) saving the paths across the Caussenards plateaux and the down hill sections into the gorges for mountain biking. That said, other more hardened will choose to climb onto the Causses on mountain bikes, with an instructor or on their own, flat out or having breaks along the way, on marked tracks or finding their own way... In short, the possibilities are numerous and for you to choose!
New: day and in-service training of Enduro ATB. And very soon: travelling stays with electric En
tldr: Parcourez les plateaux du Causse en VTT ou E-bike, avec des descentes techniques et des paysages à couper le souffle.

name: ROC SAINT GERVAIS
description:
On the heights of the hamlet of Les Douzes, at the top of the rocky outcrop of Roc Saint Gervais, discover a magnificent panorama over the Jonte Gorges.

The site is surmounted by a cemetery adjoining a chapel on the edge of the Causses Méjean and dominates the Jonte Gorges by one hundred and thirty metres.
tldr: Contemplez un panorama exceptionnel sur les gorges de la Jonte depuis ce rocher surmonté d'un cimetière isolé.

name: Roc Saint-Jean et Sentier d'interprétation
description: In the Middle Ages, an impregnable fortress stood on the Roc Saint-Jean peak. This building was razed to the ground in 1629 by order of Richelieu. An interpretation trail has been set up with a belvedere overlooking the Gorges des Raspes du Tarn. Since then, you will admire one of the most beautiful panoramas of the region and discover its tales and legends.
tldr: Suivez un sentier d'interprétation sur les ruines d'une forteresse médiévale et découvrez l'histoire du Roc Saint-Jean.

name: Roc'Aubrac - école d'équitation Western
description:
Western riding is a gentle and light way of riding in which a real "man-horse" complicity is born: riding, riding lessons, boarding, dressage, training, breeding.
All levels - all ages
Become the cowboy in you!
tldr: Montez à cheval à la manière western, dans un cadre authentique, pour une expérience équestre conviviale et complète.

name: Rocagel Pierre Vétérinaire Ostéopathie
tldr: Découvrez les soins ostéopathiques pour chevaux proposés par un vétérinaire spécialisé à Laguiole.

name: Rocher champignon  de Peyrelevade
description:

For some, it would be a chaos formed following a diaclase [episode during which a rock splits without the disjointed parts moving away from each other].
For others, it would be a megalith, that is to say a rocky assembly built by the hand of the man, in order to serve as place of worship.  
Pagan altar or simple geological formation, both possibilities are possible.

tldr: Découvrez ce rocher aux allures de champignon géant, vestige géologique unique en Aveyron.

description: Le ménage doit être fait en fin de séjour

description: Independent kitchen, dishwasher, gas cooker. Living room: sofa bed and television. 1 bedroom (1 bed in 140) and 1 bedroom (2 beds in 90). Bathroom, WC. Washing machine. Ground, garden furniture, barbecue. Central heating.

name: Rolande Besson
description: Chalet at the edge of the woods, facing the slopes. Kitchen area, living room with fireplace, mezzanine with a 140 cm bed, 80 cm beds in the living room. Bright veranda. Direct access to skiing, snowshoeing and hiking trails. Unobstructed view of the slopes.

name: Roman Fountain of Vors
description:
Why ?
2000 years ago, the Romans had an aqueduct built to supply Segodonum (Rodez) with water from Vors catchment area.
It meandered over 30 km to avoid ravines and hills, and went up little by little on an arcade succession : remains of 133 piles were discovered, with the last one at 20 meters high.
Through gravity flow, a series of several small lead or terracotta pipes supplied fountains, wash-houses, thermae and even some inhabitants (with a fee of course!).
In the village of Vors, you can find an inspection hole that was used to check the good condition of the pipeline : there was one hol
tldr: Admirez cette fontaine romaine de 2000 ans, vestige d'un aqueduc antique de 30 km.

name: ROMY'S WORKSHOP: LEATHER PROCESSING- TRAINING COURSES AND EDUCATION
description:
All year round, Romy's workshop provides three options of training.
-One day training course: you'll make your own sandal or leather item (purse, small handbag)
-Two days training course: design, creation and finish of your handbag (model of your choice).
-Week training course: Detail and prices on request.
tldr: Apprenez l'artisanat du cuir en fabriquant votre propre article lors d'un atelier créatif.

name: Ronnette
description:
Renovated T2 apartment for rent.
In a quiet residence, this 38 m2 apartment for 2 people is located on the 1st floor (2x7 steps separated by a landing). It is furnished and equipped for your comfort.
Within a 1-km radius, you'll find the Centre Thermal, a large nature park, pharmacy, medical center, bakery, restaurant, physiotherapist, intermarché, tobacconist, casino...
and in the surrounding area, many of the tourist villages for which Aveyron is famous!

description:
This bright and modern apartment has a 14m2 terrace, a fully equiped kitchen (microwave, coffee machine, toaster, kettle), a bathroom with italian shower and washing machine. Parking in a closed courtyard.

In a quiet neighbourhood, facing the Rodez National Stud Farm, you are at a few meters from a bus stop and at 5 min walking from the Soulages museum, the cinema and the historic center of Rodez.
Sheets and towels included (20 euros fee)
Cleaning fee of 25 euros : optional 
Animals not allowed.

name: Roquefort La Pastourelle
description:
Come and meet our milk producers to their place, in their sheepfold, where they will be pleased to welcome you and share their cheese and passion.
Free visit of the farms all year round by simple booking: 06 87 59 54 16 (ferme de Galamans) - 05 65 99 85 39 (ferme des Vignots). 
La Pastourelle cheese on sale at the Fromagerie de Saint-Affrique and the Halles du Majestic in Saint-Affrique.
tldr: Rencontrez des producteurs de lait et dégustez leur Roquefort directement à la ferme.

name: Roquefort Le Vieux Berger
description:
Guardian of ancestral know-how, Maison Combes has been making Roquefort Vieux Berger for 3 generations using the same traditional and traditional techniques.

Since 2012, Maison Combes has been labeled "Entreprise du Patrimoine Vivant", in recognition of its French craftsmanship.
tldr: Découvrez un Roquefort artisanal fabriqué depuis 3 générations avec des méthodes traditionnelles.

Original creations and moments of creativity around handicrafts, not to be missed!
tldr: Créez des pièces uniques en feutre lors d'un atelier artisanal guidé par une experte.

name: Rose Garden in Sauveterre de Rouergue
description:
Abandoned at the end of 19th century, the former cemetery became a rose garden in 2010 on the initiative of painter Barthélemy de Josy Mai-Andrieu's, with the help of the villagers and the district of Sauveterre-de-Rouergue.

Climbing roses, rosebushes… Around 140 plants were planted. They added bucolic charm to this place where you can see a cross, a stela and sarcophagus, stone elements that remember us the former use of the site.

Carry your visit on thanks to the tourist map.
To the attention of people with reduced mobility :
The bastide is suitable for manual and electric wheelchairs. In
tldr: Flânez dans un jardin de roses né d'un ancien cimetière, entre histoire et botanique.

description:
Close to farm buildings, on 2 levels, in the hamlet of Trémouilles, this independent gîte consists of 3 bedrooms upstairs (3 beds 140, 1 bed 100). A shower room. A kitchen (dishwasher, washing machine), a living room (sofas, fireplace). Electric auxiliary heating
Enclosed courtyard (120 m²), garden furniture, barbecue, portico, tourist tax.

name: Roselyne Blanc Bessière
description: Glass work and ceramics studio where I show my work and that of other artists, creative designers in themed exhibitions in December and summer (July-August) The rest of the year, the studio is open by appointment on  06 86 57 75 12.
tldr: Explorez un atelier de verre et céramique mêlant créations locales et expositions thématiques.

name: Rosine SINGLA - H12G005699

The inside, recently renovated, is bright, cocooning atmosphere with smooth pastel colours.
Guesthouse adjoining the owner's house (independant entrance), on 3 levels, at the border of the village, in the countryside. 1 bedroom with a 140 bed, 1 mezzanine bedroom with two 90 beds, bearing/relax-corner with one 90 sofa-bed, bathroom, corner-kitchen/living room with sofa and TV/DVD, laundry room with dishwasher and washing machine, central heating system, private terrace and garden, private parking, garden furniture and grill.

name: Sénergues
description:
The beautiful square tower, made of granite, was built in the 14th century, during the Hundred Years' War, to defend itself from the "English" and bands of plunderers. The architectural bases of the castle (private property) are from the end of the 15th - beginning of the 16th century.
the present church, rebuilt and enlarged by Antoine de Rousselet (coat of arms on the entrance door), dates, for the most part, from the 16th century.
Some elements of a primitive building have been reused : lamp-ends, tabernacle and baptismal basin in granite. Its stained glass windows are the work of Father Ep
tldr: Admirez une tour médiévale en granit du XIVe siècle, vestige de la guerre de Cent Ans et des brigands.

More than 120 species are listed with the help of small signs bearing, in addition to the name in French, Latin and Occitan, the main characteristics of the plant. A unique wealth of flora in the region...

tldr: Parcourez un sentier botanique pour identifier plus de 120 plantes typiques de l'Aveyron.

Thirteen of the flowers and shrubs appear in the application and give information on family, genus, common names, uses and photos: big-leaved linden, chelidoine, small periwinkle, holly, beech, walnut, meadow hogweed, black elder, Ven
tldr: Découvrez la flore locale sur un sentier ombragé menant à un ancien moulin près de Micropolis.

name: Sentier d'interprétation du bois du Bruel - Vabre-Tizac
description:
THE BRUEL WOOD
The 16 ha Bois du Bruel is a remarkable and singular entity. Located at a geological boundary, it contributes to connect the forest frameworks of the Serènes valley, Vabre (granitic) and Jaoul (schist). Through a playful and interactive trail, Pic Noir, the mascot of the forest, will accompany you to discover the three functions of the forest: social and cultural, ecological and economic.
Four discovery stations and twelve medallions line the Bois du Bruel trail to learn while having fun.


Vabre-Tizac
(Loop of 1.2 km / about 1 hour)

information : 05 65 81 13 94
tldr: Découvrez un bois unique à la frontière géologique, reliant deux vallées forestières distinctes.

tldr: Panorama à 360° sur les vallées et le château de Panat, avec tables de pique-nique.

tldr: Visite guidée des vestiges d'un château féodal, avec escalade sur des escaliers taillés dans la roche.

The building which has an octagonal bell tower is visible from a great distance, and you can't miss it from wherever you might come. tldr: Découvrez cette tour du XVe siècle, symbole de l'histoire des Hospitaliers du Larzac et de l'agro-pastoralisme local.

She'll show you around her organic, agro-forestry plot and the picking areas on the farm. Whether wild or cultivated, her "simples" will reveal some of their secrets, and you'll discover their properties and uses, as well as the main ways of extracting their active ingredients.

On-site, you'll also be able to buy products made by a Witch on the Roof from the plants you've discovered: jellies, hydrolats, mother tinctures, oils, salts, jams, etc.

It also ensures the safety of 15 neighboring communities through several interconnections, including the towns of Rodez and Villefranche-de-Rouergue and the SMAEP of Montbazens-Rignac. tldr: Appartement contemporain avec vue dominante sur Rodez, à 10 min à pied du musée Soulages.

This village is located at the crossroads of Aubrac and Causses, territories on which are remarkable sites (Gorges du Tarn, Aven Armand...) and exceptional places (Viaduct of Millau, Cellars of Roquefort, Museum Soulages...)

description:
Situated in the direct proximity of the Lot valley, this site is visible from the A75 motorway at La Canourgue. It consists of limestone slopes and natural caves.
It is one of the main wintering sites of the Great Rhinolophe with between 40 and 75 individuals. Only 4 main sites
are known in Languedoc-Roussillon.
Source: Muséum National d'Histoire Naturelles, Natura 2000 network, June 2006.
tldr: Site naturel de falaises calcaires et grottes, visible depuis l’A75, refuge hivernal pour des espèces rares.

tldr: Découvrez l’artisanat de la vannerie avec Hubert, dernier passeur de ce savoir-faire ancestral sur le Causse Méjean.

name: VASE DE CHINE

On the footpath of the Cornice Trails, on the Causse Méjean, two astonishing monoliths can be seen: the Vase of Sèvres and the Vase of China. The latter overlooks the sumptuous Jonte gorges, enough to make you dizzy. Its size is impressive and offers a simply remarkable spectacle on the heights of the gorges.

Below the emptiness and the dizzying gorges of the Jonte; above the vultures describing circles; opposite, on the Causse Méjean, the magnificent Vase de Chine.
tldr: Sur le Causse Méjean, admirez deux monolithes spectaculaires : le Vase de Chine dominant les gorges de la Jonte.

name: VASE DE SEVRES
description:
At the beginning of the Gorges de la Jonte, erosion has sculpted strange shapes on the limestone ledges. One of them became famous: the "Vase de Sèvres".

Numerous hikes starting from Le Rozier or Causse Méjean overlook the dizzying gorges of the Jonte. On the way, you will see a monolith in the shape of a vase, dominating the heights of this canyon. Certainly flown over by vultures, the Vase de Sèvres is a must during this breathtaking hike.
tldr: Érosion sculptant la roche : le Vase de Sèvres, curiosité géologique au départ des Gorges de la Jonte.

name: Vestiges du château de Beaucaire
description:
The site of Beaucaire (Belcayre in Occitan which means beautiful rock, beautiful fortress) offers a strategic position to watch over the communication routes in the valleys of Dourdou and Créneau. The castle appears in texts in the 12th century and successively belonged to various powerful families of Rouergue before being progressively abandoned from the 18th century.
Beaucaire is a remarkable example of the military architecture of the Middle Ages in Rouergue of which there are only few traces left. One can still admire part of the 14th century enclosure and the base of the keep tower.

howe
tldr: Explorez les ruines du château de Beaucaire, perché sur un éperon rocheux, offrant une vue stratégique sur les vallées du Dourdou et du Créneau.

name: Visite commentée de La Bastide l'Evêque
description:
In the heart of the Pays d'art et d'Histoire des Bastides du Rouergue, this modest bastide was built in 1280 by Raymond de Calmont, bishop of Rodez. It overlooks the Aveyron gorges and the Lézert valley, where copper was beaten by numerous hammer mills in the Middle Ages. This foundation is linked to the presence of silver deposits and abundant forests.
This characterful village has preserved its geometric layout, typical of bastide architecture, with the central square featuring the church of Saint Jean Baptiste, with its typical porch bell tower in pink granite.

When visiting Bastide l'Évêq

The village of Rieupeyroux (rivo petroso) is set in the granite and schist landscapes of the Ségala region, where vast open plateaus are interrupted by valley bottoms and the rivers that feed the Viaur and Aveyron.

A village of legend?

A legend was born at the highest point (804m), occupied by the chapel of Modulance. Only true Rieupeyrousains know it? the famous legend of the giant Gargantua.

Like Villeneuve-d'Aveyron and Naucelle, Rieupeyroux has its origins in a sauveté (salvita) dating back to Roman times. The village grew up around a Benedictine church and monastery founded by the Abbe
tldr: Parcourez un village granitique du Ségala et ses paysages préservés entre plateaux et vallées.
