Tour lasts approx. 2 hours.

Seasonal country dress for a stroll through the vineyards.

Groups of 6 or more, maximum 15 people.

Groups of up to 30 people can be accommodated (visit adapted to suit)

Rates: 12? for groups of less than 10 people / 10? for groups of 11 people or more
tldr: Découvrez l'histoire du vin de Marcillac avec une sommelière, entre vignes et dégustation sur un domaine viticole.

name: Visite et goûter à la ferme - Les Chèvres de Coubisou
description:
We raise our goats in a setting conducive to simple pleasures and discovery. With their milk, we offer a wide range of traditional, innovative and fresh products?
You can find us in our farm store and at the Espalion market on Friday mornings, and at the Bozouls market on Thursday mornings, where we sell cheese, yoghurt and goat charcuterie. In July and August, we also offer ice creams, crêpes and charcuterie at night markets in Espalion, Estaing, Millau and Séverac, and at festive events.
tldr: Dégustez des produits fermiers à base de lait de chèvre et goûtez à l'ambiance authentique d'une ferme auboise.
address: 2402 route de la vallée du Lot

name: Visite guidée "Le Viaduc du Viaur grandiose"
description:
A link between the Aveyron and Tarn departments, the Viaduc du Viaur is first and foremost a daring project by engineer Paul Bodin.
A true technical feat, featuring the new technologies of the time, this railway bridge, linking the steep banks of the Viaur, is also incredibly beautiful. The white metal structure blends beautifully with its natural surroundings, the deep, wild Viaur valley.
460 metres long, with a 220-metre arch balanced 116 metres above the riverbed, this elegant and innovative steel construction surpassed even Gustave Eiffel's design.
From different vantage points on the viad
tldr: Admirez le Viaduc du Viaur, chef-d'œuvre d'ingénierie du début du XXe siècle, lors d'une visite guidée immersive.

name: Visite Guidée - Le Don du Fel - Poterie du Don
description:
At once a production workshop, a European gallery and now a training center, the Don du Fel is firmly established on the international map of contemporary ceramics. More than ever, with its 55,000 visitors a year, the Don du Fel remains "an absolute must" in the whole region. Ceramic workshops for amateurs organized over several weekends (for dates, visit www.ledondufel.com).
Guided tours of the studio on Tuesday mornings in July and August for individuals (all year round by prior arrangement for groups).
Visit to the store and Art Gallery: free admission all year round.
tldr: Découvrez la poterie contemporaine au Don du Fel, un lieu unique mêlant art, formation et galerie internationale.

name: Visite guidée : La Cathédrale de Notre-Dame (groupes)
description: Cathedral (13th - 16th centuries), remarkable for its exceptional dimensions and its history (construction spread out over 300 years, belfry burnt down, western façade that was part of the ramparts and belonged to a château fort (castle)). Visit that ends with the discovery of the Bishop's courtyard with a superb view of the belfry (one of the most beautiful in France).

name: Visite guidée : Le centre historique et la cathédrale (groupes)
description: Rodez through the ages. Cathedral, bishop's palace (exterior), 14th, 15th and 16th century listed houses. For all details and information contact the Office de Tourisme du Grand Rodez.
tldr: Découvrez les trésors médiévaux de Rodez : cathédrale gothique, palais épiscopal et maisons à colombages du XVe siècle.

name: Visite guidée : le musée Fenaille (groupes)
description: Museum conserving rich collections of archaeology, art and history. The museum is renowned for its exceptional ensemble of statue-menhirs - sculpted 5000 years ago, they are the oldest monumental statues known in western Europe. The museum's circuit retraces the history of the Rouergue from the first man (300000years ago) to the 17th century. It is organised around four main themes: the statue-menhirs, ancient Rodez, the Rouergue in the Middle Ages, the 16th century and the Renaissance. Numerous tools to help your visit and enable a personalised approach to the collections using models, drawin
tldr: Admirez les mystérieux statue-menhirs, sculptures vieilles de 5000 ans, uniques en Europe.

name: Visite guidée d'Entraygues-sur-Truyère
description:
Every Thursday, Jacques, a volunteer guide with a passion for history, introduces visitors to the history and architectural riches of Entraygues since the early Middle Ages, when its ramparts were considered among the most powerful in Europe.
Visit the remains of the ramparts, the old port, the hospital, the castle, the confluence and its rivers, and the manor houses.
tldr: Plongez dans l'histoire médiévale d'Entraygues-sur-Truyère avec un guide passionné et ses remparts oubliés.

name: Visite guidée d'Estaing
description: By reservation only. Maximum of 20 people. Duration: 1 hour and 30 minutes. Meet in front of the tourist office.

name: Visite guidée de la bastide royale de Sauveterre-de-Rouergue
description:
What's the attraction of this tour? It's to let you appreciate the preserved history, the strong identity that emerges from the narrow streets dating back to the 13th century, the harmony of the arches and half-timbered houses. It's also to familiarize you with the personality of this village, which has been forged around its arts and crafts.
Practical details
- Tour duration: 1h15
- Min. 10 people
- A deposit of 30% is required on reservation.
- Meeting point: in front of the tourist office
If you would like a more elaborate and detailed tour of the bastide's history, or with a specific theme
tldr: Flânez dans une bastide du XIIIe siècle, préservée et harmonieuse, où chaque rue raconte une histoire.

name: Visite guidée de la bibliothèque patrimoniale Joseph Vaylet
description:
For adults and children %E0 aged 12 and older, accompanied by an adult. Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes.
By reservation only through the tourist office: 05 65 44 10 63.
Presented by the Friends of Joseph Vaylet, in partnership with the Comtal, Lot, and Truyère Community of Communes.
The library is located on the first floor; there is no elevator, so it is not accessible to people with limited mobility.
tldr: Explorez une bibliothèque ancienne aux trésors cachés, présentée par des passionnés locaux.

name: Visite guidée de la centrale hydroélectrique d'Ambialet
description:
It is in the heart of Ambialet that the 5th hydroelectric power station of the Saut du Tarn factory was built in 1913. 
It can be visited on summer, from 9 on july to 26 september on tuesdays and thursdays at 11 am.
tldr: Visitez une centrale hydroélectrique historique de 1913, nichée au cœur d'un village pittoresque.

name: Visite guidée de la cité et du château de Sévérac (groupes)
description:
DESCRIPTION

Built on a mound over 800 m high, the castle has watched over its medieval town for almost ten centuries. To get there and appreciate the site, follow your guide through the town's beautiful winding streets.
You'll then climb up to the castle, enjoying the remarkable view over the Aveyron valley. Once you've reached the château, your guide will take you on a tour of its history and architecture. During this tour, the chapel and kitchen, usually closed to the public, will be accessible to you.
Sévérac-le-Château has been a place of life since Neolithic times, and has a rich history
tldr: Montez à 800 m d'altitude pour explorer un château médiéval dominant un village préservé depuis dix siècles.

name: Visite Guidée de Millau (groupes)
description:
Let us take you back to Roman times, when La Graufesenque's sigillated pottery was exported as far away as Pompeii, and to the excellence of its glove-making tradition and its megisserie, which made it prosper.
Since 2000, the "Ville et métiers d'Art" label has highlighted the expertise of its craftsmen, and since 2011, the "Ville d'Art et d'Histoire" label has recognized the town's rich cultural heritage.
Our partner guide will take you on a tour of the town's historic monuments: Belfry, Halles, market square, town houses...
Guided cultural walking tour through the heart of the old town. 1h30
tldr: Retracez l'âge d'or de Millau : poteries romaines exportées jusqu'à Pompéi et savoir-faire unique en ganterie.

name: Visite Guidée de Peyre (groupes)
description: Discover the architecture and history of this troglodyte village through its cobbled streets and its unique fortified church, listed as a Monument Historique. Built into the rock, the church has been extensively altered and fortified over the centuries. Surprise, Peyre also offers one of the best views of the Millau Viaduct!
tldr: Découvrez Peyre, village troglodyte aux ruelles pavées et son église fortifiée sculptée dans la roche.

name: Visite guidée de Saint Geniez d'Olt (groupes)
description: For individuals, every Tuesday from June to September  - by booking on 05 65 70 43 42 - For groups, visits by booking throughout the year. Duration : 1h30 to 2h.

name: Visite guidée de Sainte Eulalie d'Olt (groupes)
description: Guided visit of the main monuments: Church (indoor+outdoor) - Village (half timbered or not with Lot stones and lauzes roofs) - 15th century castle (outdoors) - Renaissance townhouse (1564) - Ecole Communale turned Petite Ecole d'Art (Crafts) and the 17th century Marcel Boudou Museum - Arts pole created in  2002. Very floral village, listed Prettiest Village in France. Group visits can be extended with a crafts demonstration. Duration: 1h30 approximately.
tldr: Parcourez Sainte-Eulalie-d'Olt : église, château du XVe siècle et maisons Renaissance en pierre de Lodez.

name: Visite guidée de Villecomtal
description: Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes. Meet in front of the Tourist Information Center. No reservation required.
tldr: Promenez-vous dans Villecomtal, village médiéval aux maisons à colombages et toits de lauze.

name: VISITE GUIDÉE DÉGUSTATION
description:
Accompanied by a guide, come and discover the history of this village with its colorful heritage, while enjoying tasty tastings of local produce.
Reservations essential on 04 66 48 88 08, places limited
Departure from in front of the tourist office.
The date of this event has been fixed in advance, but may be subject to change between now and the summer season.
tldr: Dégustez des produits locaux en découvrant l'histoire colorée de Massegros et ses richesses patrimoniales.

name: Visite guidée du Château d'Estaing
description:
On a guided tour, explore the upper floors all the way to the top of the tower, including the seigneurial chapel (15th century), the modern chapel (1929), and the family parlor…
Duration: approximately 1 hour and 30 minutes. Registration required.

Discover this Historic Monument and its remarkable surroundings, overlooking the village and its Gothic bridge spanning the Lot River, on the Way of St. James. Built beginning in the 11th century, the former residence of the d’Estaing family—now owned by the VGE Foundation—bears witness to history from the knight Tristan d’Estaing tothe exhibition “

name: Visite guidée du Château de Calmont d'Olt
description:
Travel back to the feudal era of lords, knights, fortified castles, and the Hundred Years’ War during this tour, which is sure to surprise you by revealing many details about the largely misunderstood period known as the Middle Ages. 
Building a castle—both in terms of logistics and architecture—is a complex undertaking. The heritage restoration projects taking place at Calmont d’Olt as part of the Union Rempart preserve the legacy left to us by medieval builders. Follow in the footsteps of the lords of Calmont d’Olt as you explore the castle’s two defensive walls, the upper courtyard, and the
tldr: Plongez dans l'univers méconnu des seigneurs et chevaliers du Moyen Âge au château de Calmont d'Olt.

name: VISITE GUIDÉE DU CHÂTEAU DE SAINT SATURNIN
description:
Guided tour of the Château de Saint-Saturnin every Thursday at 2.30pm! Come and discover the history of this 13th-century castle, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Reservations required on 04 66 32 83 67
Payment and meeting point in front of the château
Price: 5?
Exceptional visits (outside normal times) possible for groups - please contact us in advance.

name: Visite guidée du château de Saint-Côme-d'Olt
description: Meet in front of the Saint C%F4me town hall.

name: Visite guidée du marché aux bestiaux de Laissac
description: Every Tuesday morning, climb into the observation room that overlooks the 1600 animals and discover the workings of the biggest market in the south of France (market with a European clientèle). In the summer, a video is shown. A traditional market in the streets of Laissac also takes place on Tuesday mornings.
tldr: Observez le plus grand marché aux bestiaux du sud de la France, avec 1600 animaux et une clientèle européenne.

name: Visite guidée du marché aux bestiaux de Laissac (groupes)
description: Every Tuesday morning, climb into the observation room that overlooks the 1600 animals and discover the workings of the biggest market in the south of France (market with a European clientèle). In the summer, a video is shown. A traditional market in the streets of Laissac also takes place on Tuesday mornings.

name: Visite guidée du Marché Ovin
description: Every Monday morning, (Tuesday when Monday is a public holiday), the sheep market attracts breeders from the region as well as numerous buyers from neighbouring départements. It starts at 9.30am with lambs, sheep at 10am and young lambs at 10.30. The establishment of this market in 1992 necessitated the construction of a suitable  building. The quotations are registered weekly and serve as a national reference. 11Am quotation meeting.
tldr: Assistez à l'ambiance unique d'un marché ovin historique chaque lundi matin, cœur battant de la vie pastorale aveyronnaise.

name: Visite Guidée Histoire de la ganterie (groupes)
description:
Why gloves in Millau? Answer this famous question with the help of our guide, who will introduce you to the megisserie (tannery specialized in lambskin) with a walking tour of the emblematic sites of the town center: Place Foch, the 19th-century Halles, the Pégayrolles mansion, Rue de la Saunerie, Maison du Peuple? Immerse yourself in the world of skin, gloves and haute couture.
 The tour includes a visit to the town museum to watch a film about working in a megisserie (a tannery that processes lamb skins), and a visit to a gantier workshop to appreciate the skills of the cutters and gantieres
tldr: Plongez dans l'artisanat gantier millavois : tanneries, savoir-faire et histoire locale à travers une visite guidée.

name: VISITE GUIDÉE LES VIGNES
description:
Guided tour of Les Vignes.
Come and discover this charming little village in the hollow of the Gorges du Tarn, on the banks of the river.
Call 04 66 48 88 08 to book.
Meet in front of the tourist office at 10:30 am, free admission.

name: VISITE GUIDÉE NOCTURNE DE LA CANOURGUE
description:
Discover La Canourgue in a different way, with a night-time guided tour that takes you back in time to the town?s darker past. For the general public.
Departure from the tourist office at 9pm.
Admission: 5? adults and 3? children, free for children under 12.
Reservations required.
 The date of this event has been fixed in advance, but may be subject to change between now and the summer season.
tldr: Découvrez La Canourgue la nuit, entre légendes urbaines et patrimoine éclairé par la lune.

name: VISITE GUIDÉE NOCTURNE DES VIGNES
description:
Night-time guided tour of Les Vignes.
Come and discover this charming little village in the hollow of the Gorges du Tarn, on the banks of the river. Remember to bring a flashlight!
Call 04 66 48 88 08 to book.
Meet in front of the tourist office at 8:00 pm, free admission.

name: Visite guidée VIP du Beffroi de Millau (groupes)
description:
Picture this: it's late afternoon, and you've spent an emotionally-charged day walking, hiking, sightseeing?
What better way to round off the evening than with an original aperitif?
Start by climbing the maze of 210 steps in the Tour des Rois d?Aragon, then the Belfry above. Our guide will tell you all about the history of the building, symbol of the beating heart of our town. Watch out for the sound of the bells, which will make the walls vibrate as you pass.
Once at the top, catch your breath: a 360° view over the roofs of the old town and the horizon awaits you!
All this energy will soon be
tldr: Terminez votre journée par une montée au Beffroi de Millau, vue panoramique et apéritif original en hauteur.

name: Visite libre de Coussergues
description:
Coussergues is an atypical village with 2 bell towers.
To see :
-Bell tower
-Fountain-Lavoir
-Roman bridge
-Chapel of the 7 Sorrows
-Mill of Mafres
You can walk along the Serre river and you will notice a nice roman bridge.
A 2.4km route, punctuated with enamelled lava plaques, will allow you to discover the heritage and history of the village.
tldr: Explorez Coussergues, village atypique aux deux clochers, ses lavoirs et son pont romain au fil de la rivière.

name: Visite libre de Cruéjouls
description:
Cruéjouls is distinguished by its atypical feudal castle made up of four imposing round towers which frame a very small main building. The church, classified as a Historic Monument, has some Romanesque parts.
Heritage to discover :
-Castle of Cayla
-Fountain of Briounas
-Barn buttresses at the Grantarelle
While walking through the streets of the village and thanks to enamelled lava plates, you will discover a lintel with a blacksmith's sign, gargoyles, a wash-house...
tldr: Admirez le château féodal de Cruéjouls, ses quatre tours rondes et son église romane classée.

name: Visite libre de Gaillac d'Aveyron et de Gagnac
description:
Between the Lévézou and the Causse de Sévérac, discover the pretty village of Gaillac d'Aveyron as well as Gagnac which is attached to the commune since 1830.
To see :
-Bridge-mill
-Turret
-Church
-Fortified houses
-Watering place and fountain
-Mullioned windows on barn
As you walk through the streets of the village, enamelled lava plaques will enlighten you on the history of these villages.
tldr: Flânez entre Gaillac d'Aveyron et Gagnac, villages de caractère entre Lévézou et Causse.

name: Visite libre de Laissac
description:
Discover the lively market that takes place in the center of the village. The foirail of Laissac hosts a cattle and sheep market every Tuesday morning. The modernity of these installations contrasts surprisingly with the old quarters which formerly constituted "le Château", a fortified complex whose tower still remains.


A 1,6km walk will make you appreciate :
-20th century Art Nouveau house
-Castle of Maquefabes - old mill
-Railway station
-Porch
-Fountain - griffoul
tldr: Vivez l'effervescence du marché hebdomadaire de Laissac, où tradition pastorale rime avec modernité.

name: Visite libre de Palmas
description:
Palmas was, from the Middle Ages to the Revolution, a seigniory of the Bishops of Rodez who owned a powerful castle and established a bridge there. The village saw many disputes between the bishop and his neighbors, the Lords of Sévérac, often protestants.
As you walk through the streets of the village, you can admire :
-Presbytery - 4-sided tower
-Vestiges of the castle enclosure
-Solignac house - Remains of the castle
-Porch from 1815
-Well of the village
tldr: Remontez le temps à Palmas, ancienne seigneurie épiscopale marquée par ses conflits médiévaux.

name: Visite libre de Saint Geniez d'Olt
description:
Plaques affixed to the monuments will help you to better understand our history
To see: the cloister and the Augustinian chapel, the parish church, the Talabot monument, which dominates the city, the quays of the Lot, and the facades of the 17th century private mansions.
Guided tours are offered by the Tourist Office all year round, upon reservation, for groups and from June to September for individuals
tldr: Parcourez Saint Geniez d'Olt à travers ses monuments : cloître, chapelle et Talabot veillent sur l'histoire.

name: Visite libre de Sainte Eulalie d'Olt
description: to see: Church (inside + outside) - Village (half-timbered houses or not with pebbles of the Lot and roofs in lauzes) - Castle XVème (outside) - Private mansion of Renaissance period (1564) - Communal School become Small School of Art (Artisans) and the Museum Marcel Boudou - "la Grange des Arts" Artistic Pole created in 2002. A very flowery village, classified "Plus Beau Village de France", guided tours are offered by the Tourist Office all year round, by reservation, for groups and from June to September for individuals
tldr: Sainte Eulalie d'Olt séduit par ses maisons à colombages, son château Renaissance et son église médiévale.

name: Visite libre de Sévérac l'Église
description:
Sévérac l'Église is of very ancient origin, its name comes from "Severi Ager" field or land of Severus, Roman general.
A fortified castle was located on the site of the church demolished in 1900, it was surrounded by a ditch of which traces still remain.
To see :
-Alley under the porch
-Church
-The griffoul
-Quadrangular tower, vestige of the fort
-Washhouse
-Farm with character house and dovecote
-Master's house
tldr: Sévérac l'Église révèle son passé romain et son château fort disparu, entre légendes et pierres.

name: Visite libre de Vimenet
description:
Two round towers mark the corners of the enclosure. There are also two entrance porches. Along the alleys and dead ends, you will discover old stalls, sculpted stones, a sundial?
To see:
-Calvary and bread oven
-Porch of Valat
-House with tower
-Vaulted fountain
-Fortifications
-Remarkable farmhouse


The association "L'eau et la Pierre" offers guided tours on request for groups.
tldr: Vimenet surprend avec ses deux tours rondes, ses porches sculptés et son calvaire paisible.

name: Visites guidées du Musée du Scaphandre - Musée Joseph Vaylet
description:
Activities offered to visitors with a museum admission ticket.
This provider is a partner in the "Pass'Avantages en Terres d'Aveyron" program, which allows you to take advantage of discounts. Find all the information HERE.
tldr: Plongez dans l'histoire du scaphandre au musée Joseph Vaylet : innovations et explorations sous-marines.

name: Visites-jeu de piste "Seconde nature"
description:
The visit takes us on a journey between the real, the virtual, the strange and the supernatural: sounds, lights, materials and movements constantly alter our perceptions.
Investigation?
What has happened in this strange maze? Something is latent! A call to understand, to explore, to slip into the shoes of a detective.
The treasure hunt invites you to follow audio and visual clues as you investigate a metaphorical universe full of surprises.
The adventure doesn't stop there: all summer long, performances, concerts and workshops extend the SECOND NATURE experience.
Plastic installations: Nicolas
tldr: Résolvez une énigme entre réel et virtuel lors d'une visite-jeu de piste sensorielle à La Cavalerie.

name: Visitez  Prévinquières
description: This village kept its medieval charm and history which you can learn about in its streets. Indeed, this fortified medieval village, set high above the river Aveyron still bears parts of its fortification from the Hundred years war when the English took over the region. You can still see its three gates which regulated the comings and goings of the inhabitants as well as the square tower alongside the south gate. Despite these fortifications, the village fell to the English in 1376 and had to be ransomed by the Count of Armagnac. It has kept several old houses and the ruins of the little castle
tldr: Prévinquières vous transporte au Moyen Âge : village fortifié, ruelles pavées et vue sur l'Aveyron.

name: Visitez Cassagnes-Bégonhès
description:
>>>> Use the map to find your way around (see image).
Etymology :
The name Cassagnes derives from the Gallic word cassanus, meaning "oak". Bégonhès comes from the name of the De Bégon family, a representative of which was granted the Carolingian viguerie* of which Cassagnes was the chief town.
*Initially the seat of a civil and criminal jurisdiction rendered in the name of the count or viscount.
Its origins :
The castle built on the rocky promontory above the Céor river around the year 1000 is the origin of the viguerie.
When Rouergue became part of the French Crown in 1271, Cassagnes became t
tldr: Cassagnes-Bégonhès, entre chênes gaulois et histoire familiale, un patrimoine à arpenter.

name: Visitez La Bastide l'Evêque
description:
Founded in 1280 by Bishop (Evêque) Raymond de Calmont, La Bastide was built on a granite plateau overlooking the Aveyron gorges, where copper was worked in water powered forges (martinets). The village is full of character and has retained the traditional layout of a bastide (fortified walled town): parallel streets crossed at right angles by lanes (carreirous). The church of Saint John the Baptist, with its bell tower in pink granite dominates the central square.
Amateur historians will be astonished by the diversity and richness of the built heritage: nearby you'll find the “martinet” de la
tldr: La Bastide l'Evêque, bastide médiévale fondée en 1280, où cuivre et gorges de l'Aveyron s'entremêlent.
address: départ de la visite de l'office de tourisme

name: Visitez La Capelle-Bleys
description:
Hikers won't be bored with the remarkable alternating agricultural and wooded sceneries. At 728 meters high, the Puech of the Goat offers a great panorama of the Segala plateau

The mainly agricultural activity has maintained its wooded fields. Many farms produce the famous “Veau d'Aveyron et du Ségala » and by this, carry on an ancient farming savoir-faire; Something not to miss !

What to see in the village and nearby

On the square, the beautiful building from the XIXth century which was formerly the presbytery was transformed into the Douzoulet, a charming and authentic restaurant/bar.

Ne
tldr: Grimpez au Puech de la Chèvre à 728 m pour un panorama exceptionnel sur le Segala, entre bois et terres agricoles.

name: Visitez La Salvetat Peyralès
description:
As its name suggests, La Salvetat is a former "sauveté" or place of refuge, founded in the 12th century . The pope Eugene the third confirmed the rights of the Rodez chapter on La Salvetat by a bull from 1147. 

In the beginnings of the sauveté, every inhabitant received a patch of land to build their own house in the protected perimeter. The chapter which was the sauveté's lord received the taxes for the ownership of these lands. The village was fortified during the Hundred Years' War and some traces of the walls still exist as we can see with the St Anthony' Gate and the village' plan.  The
tldr: Découvrez une sauveté médiévale fondée au XIIe siècle, refuge historique confirmé par une bulle papale.

name: Visitez Laguiole, capitale de l'Aubrac et des couteaux
description:
Stroll through the streets of houses with thick, dark basalt walls, protecting the inhabitants from the harshness of winter. From the Place de la Mairie, head for the old quarter with its ancient storefronts and famous "bombecul" street! Then a short climb to the highest point of the village.
Originally, the village of Laguiole (pronounced "laïole") was built around a small relief chapel. This was replaced by the 17th-century church, built on the site of the now-defunct fort. From this esplanade, you can enjoy a 360° view of the Aubrac plateau!
Discover Rue du Valat, where the history of Lagui
tldr: Flânez dans le vieux Laguiole, entre maisons en basalte et ruelles pavées, berceau des célèbres couteaux.

name: Visitez Lescure Jaoul
description:
To all the tourists and hikers ! Lescure Jaoul is the spot for you! After visiting the traditional smithy museum, discover the Jaoul and the Viaur gorges, marvelous spots carved in shale. 

In this village, you'll find a heritage full of history, astonishing treasure and natural beauty. First and foremost, learn about the history by discovering the Cadoule Chapel dedicated to St-Amans

Then, near Flauzins, you'll reach the belvedere overlooking the Viaur valley and the famous “Cheval du Roi” which is a granitic rock lying on the ground. 

More than just a historical heritage, Lescure Jaoul als
tldr: Visitez la forge traditionnelle puis explorez les gorges du Jaoul et du Viaur, sculptées dans le schiste.

name: Visitez Moyrazès
description:
A site prized for a long time...
The discovery of two polished flint axes in the vicinity of Moyrazès testifies with certainty to the probable residence of a certain population in the Neolithic period (5000 to 3000 BC) or in the period closer to the Bronze Age (1800 to 1100 BC).
Several testimonies of the Gallo-Roman period have also been found: the remains of two Roman roads, the creation of farms or "villas". One of the two roads links Rodez to Bordeaux via Cahors, the other also crosses the Segala from east to west, also linking Rodez and Villefranche, but passing further south, via Rieupey
tldr: Admirez deux haches polies néolithiques, preuves d'une occupation humaine il y a plus de 5000 ans.

name: Visitez Rieupeyroux
description:
Carved into the schism and granite landscapes and set on wide plateaux lies the village of Rieupeyroux, forged by its heritage and legends.

It is at the highest point of the village where the Modulance Chapel sits that a legend was born. A legend that only true inhabitants know about but you'll know soon too :  the famous Gargantua myth !
Like Villeneuve-d'Aveyron and Naucelle, Rieupeyroux was first a sauveté (salvita) dating from the Romanesque era. The hamlet developed around a church and a Benedictine monastery founded by the abbey Saint-Martial de Limoges.

name: Visitez Saint Chély d'Aubrac
description:
An essential stop-off point for several long-distance hiking trails, tourism is one of the activities that keeps this small Aveyron village alive. Its heritage is strongly linked to pilgrimage, with the church and the Pont des Pèlerins (Pilgrims? Bridge) the main witnesses. Don?t hesitate to come and visit Saint-Chély-d?Aubrac, its atmosphere is sure to charm you!
The Pont des Pèlerins, a landmark monument!
The bridge dates back to the 14th century and spans the Boralde de Saint-Chély at the bottom of the village. On the parapet, you can admire the beautiful stone cross bearing a bas-relief de
tldr: Suivez les chemins de pèlerinage vers Saint-Jacques-de-Compostelle, entre Aubrac et paysages préservés.

name: Visitez Tayrac
description:
This charming village was once a 13th century bastide, surrounded by walls and ditches, at the time a dependency of the lordship of Castelmary, which itself was under the authority of the bishop of Rodez.
With the passage of time, agricultural activity moved up out of the valleys towards the plateaux and while the population of Castelmary slowly declined, that of Tayrac became more and more significant. The people were principally farmers, but there were numerous other trades in the village: blacksmith, weaver, clogmaker, wheelwright, tinsmith, joiner, tailor, dressmaker………..

tldr: Explorez les vestiges de la bastide du XIIIe siècle, entourée de douves et liée à l'évêque de Rodez.

name: Visitez Vabre-Tizac
description:
The fort of Vabre Tizac is a closed square that connects to the Church's square by a vaulted door dating back to XII-XIVth century. 

The history of Vabre Tizac takes us back to Middle Age. Vabre once was a seigneurial fiefdom that also served as a refuge for villagers. Houses were built as a rampart around an oval-shaped square. All openings led to this square. At the foot of theses ramparts were built gaps that are still visible nowadays. 

Nearby, you'll see the Bleyssol cross, erected at the end of the XVth century and on which we can find the Virgin and Child as well as a “Pietà”.
